text: SIN AK'SIN Jesus Christ David okkuai' Abraham okkuai' un'ix o sĭnaks' oaiĕxĕsts.
text_for_embed: Matthew 1:1 — SIN AK'SIN Jesus Christ David okkuai' Abraham okkuai' un'ix o sĭnaks' oaiĕxĕsts.

text: Abraham ikuyiu' Isaac; ki Isaac ikuyiu' Jacob; ki Jacob ikuyiau' Judas ki omu' pappiipix;
text_for_embed: Matthew 1:2 — Abraham ikuyiu' Isaac; ki Isaac ikuyiu' Jacob; ki Jacob ikuyiau' Judas ki omu' pappiipix;

text: Ki Judas ikuyiu' Phares ki Zara, Thamar ipau'kaiĭmmiuax; ki Phares ikuyiu' Esrom; ki Esrom ikuyiu' Aram;
text_for_embed: Matthew 1:3 — Ki Judas ikuyiu' Phares ki Zara, Thamar ipau'kaiĭmmiuax; ki Phares ikuyiu' Esrom; ki Esrom ikuyiu' Aram;

text: Ki Aram ikuyiu' Aminadab; ki Aminadab ikuyiu' Naasson; ki Naasson ikuyiu' Salmon;
text_for_embed: Matthew 1:4 — Ki Aram ikuyiu' Aminadab; ki Aminadab ikuyiu' Naasson; ki Naasson ikuyiu' Salmon;

text: Ki Salmon ikuyiu' Booz, Rachab ipau'kaiĭmmiuaie; ki Booz ikuyiu' Obed, Ruth ipau'kaiĭmmiuaie; ki Obed ikuyiu' Jesse;
text_for_embed: Matthew 1:5 — Ki Salmon ikuyiu' Booz, Rachab ipau'kaiĭmmiuaie; ki Booz ikuyiu' Obed, Ruth ipau'kaiĭmmiuaie; ki Obed ikuyiu' Jesse;

text: Ki Jesse ikuyiu' David omŭx'nin'a; ki David omŭx'ina ikuyiu' Solomon, annŏk' ake'uŏk itom'itomiuŏk Urias man'itotsipokaiĭmmiuaie;
text_for_embed: Matthew 1:6 — Ki Jesse ikuyiu' David omŭx'nin'a; ki David omŭx'ina ikuyiu' Solomon, annŏk' ake'uŏk itom'itomiuŏk Urias man'itotsipokaiĭmmiuaie;

text: Ki Solomon ikuyiu'. Roboam; ki Roboam ikuyiu' Abia; ki Abia ikuyiu' Asa;
text_for_embed: Matthew 1:7 — Ki Solomon ikuyiu'. Roboam; ki Roboam ikuyiu' Abia; ki Abia ikuyiu' Asa;

text: Ki Asa ikuyiu' Josaphat; ki Josaphat ikuyiu' Joram; ki Joram ikuyiu' Ozias;
text_for_embed: Matthew 1:8 — Ki Asa ikuyiu' Josaphat; ki Josaphat ikuyiu' Joram; ki Joram ikuyiu' Ozias;

text: Ki Ozias ikuyiu' Joatham; ki Joatham ikuyiu' Achaz; ki Achaz ikuyiu' Ezekias;
text_for_embed: Matthew 1:9 — Ki Ozias ikuyiu' Joatham; ki Joatham ikuyiu' Achaz; ki Achaz ikuyiu' Ezekias;

text: Ki Ezekias ikuyiu' Manasses; ki Manasses ikuyiu' Amon; ki Amon ikuyiu' Josias;
text_for_embed: Matthew 1:10 — Ki Ezekias ikuyiu' Manasses; ki Manasses ikuyiu' Amon; ki Amon ikuyiu' Josias;

text: Ki Josias ikuyiu' Jechonias ki o mu' pap piipix, annik' ito'toŏpikau Babylon;
text_for_embed: Matthew 1:11 — Ki Josias ikuyiu' Jechonias ki o mu' pap piipix, annik' ito'toŏpikau Babylon;

text: Ki ot'sitotos au Babylon, Jechonias ikuyiu' Salathiel; ki Salathiel ikuyiu' Zorobabel;
text_for_embed: Matthew 1:12 — Ki ot'sitotos au Babylon, Jechonias ikuyiu' Salathiel; ki Salathiel ikuyiu' Zorobabel;

text: Ki Zorobabel ikuyiu' Abiud; ki Abiud ikuyiu' Eliakim; ki Eliakim ikuyiu' Azor;
text_for_embed: Matthew 1:13 — Ki Zorobabel ikuyiu' Abiud; ki Abiud ikuyiu' Eliakim; ki Eliakim ikuyiu' Azor;

text: Ki Azor ikuyiu' Sadoc; ki Sadoc ikuyiu' Achim; ki Achim ikuyiu' Eliud;
text_for_embed: Matthew 1:14 — Ki Azor ikuyiu' Sadoc; ki Sadoc ikuyiu' Achim; ki Achim ikuyiu' Eliud;

text: Ki Eliud ikuyi u' Eleazar; ki Eleazar ikuyiu' Matthan; ki Matthan ikuyiu' Jacob;
text_for_embed: Matthew 1:15 — Ki Eliud ikuyi u' Eleazar; ki Eleazar ikuyiu' Matthan; ki Matthan ikuyiu' Jacob;

text: Ki Jacob ikuyiu' Joseph, Mary om'i, annok ipau'kaiĭmmiuŏk Jesus, anĭstau Christ.
text_for_embed: Matthew 1:16 — Ki Jacob ikuyiu' Joseph, Mary om'i, annok ipau'kaiĭmmiuŏk Jesus, anĭstau Christ.

text: David otsĭs'tsits'unoauai Abraham itsipuk' sŭpokosĭnimotseiiau ke'pitappiiau nĭssekoputtsi; ki ot'sitotosau Babylon omats'ĭstsits'unoauai David mats'itsipuksŭpokosĭmmotseiiau, matsĭsse'koputtsi; Christ omats'ĭstsits'unoauai ot'sitotosau Babylon mats'itsipuksŭpkosĭmmotseiiau matsĭsse'koputtsi.
text_for_embed: Matthew 1:17 — David otsĭs'tsits'unoauai Abraham itsipuk' sŭpokosĭnimotseiiau ke'pitappiiau nĭssekoputtsi; ki ot'sitotosau Babylon omats'ĭstsits'unoauai David mats'itsipuksŭpokosĭmmotseiiau, matsĭsse'koputtsi; Christ omats'ĭstsits'unoauai ot'sitotosau Babylon mats'itsipuksŭpkosĭmmotseiiau matsĭsse'koputtsi.

text: Jesus Christ, otsipokai'isĭnni ŭn'niniitsiu: Annik' Mary, Jesus oksĭs'tsi, Joseph otak'okemattŏsaie itop itappi'inai, otse'kosatsok Atsĭm'istaaw.
text_for_embed: Matthew 1:18 — Jesus Christ, otsipokai'isĭnni ŭn'niniitsiu: Annik' Mary, Jesus oksĭs'tsi, Joseph otak'okemattŏsaie itop itappi'inai, otse'kosatsok Atsĭm'istaaw.

text: Joseph om'i mokŏm'motsitappiu, ki matsitsitau'ats mŏk'aiitsĭnnikŏttŏsaie; osĭme'tsitan mŏksisĭm'ianĭstŭpskoŏsaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 1:19 — Joseph om'i mokŏm'motsitappiu, ki matsitsitau'ats mŏk'aiitsĭnnikŏttŏsaie; osĭme'tsitan mŏksisĭm'ianĭstŭpskoŏsaie.

text: Ki otai'ksĭmstatosaie, Satsit, Ap'ĭstotokiuăoto'tokatatsĭs otsipopŏk'toakaie ki otan'ikaie, Joseph, David okku'i, pinstŭnnos Mary kŏk'okemattosi, otse'kosatsok Atsĭm'iStaaw.
text_for_embed: Matthew 1:20 — Ki otai'ksĭmstatosaie, Satsit, Ap'ĭstotokiuăoto'tokatatsĭs otsipopŏk'toakaie ki otan'ikaie, Joseph, David okku'i, pinstŭnnos Mary kŏk'okemattosi, otse'kosatsok Atsĭm'iStaaw.

text: Ki ai'aksipokaiĭmmiuaie okku'yi, ki kitak'anĭstsĭnnikŏttau Jesus: tŭkkă, otsitappim'ix otsauum'itsitappi'isuauĕsts aiakitaikŏmotse'piuax.
text_for_embed: Matthew 1:21 — Ki ai'aksipokaiĭmmiuaie okku'yi, ki kitak'anĭstsĭnnikŏttau Jesus: tŭkkă, otsitappim'ix otsauum'itsitappi'isuauĕsts aiakitaikŏmotse'piuax.

text: Itŭn'nitsiuaie mŏk'itsenŭpanĭstŏsi Ap'ĭstotokiuă otse'poawsĭsts, otsipropheti itotse'poawsĭnĕsts, ki an'ĭmai,
text_for_embed: Matthew 1:22 — Itŭn'nitsiuaie mŏk'itsenŭpanĭstŏsi Ap'ĭstotokiuă otse'poawsĭsts, otsipropheti itotse'poawsĭnĕsts, ki an'ĭmai,

text: Satsik, mokŏk'iake ai'akopitappiiu, ki ai'aksipokaiĭmmiuaie okku'yi, ki ak'anĭstsĭnnikŏttsiauaie Emmanuel, ito'kĭsasattop Ap'ĭstotokiuă ipokai'tappiĭmmau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 1:23 — Satsik, mokŏk'iake ai'akopitappiiu, ki ai'aksipokaiĭmmiuaie okku'yi, ki ak'anĭstsĭnnikŏttsiauaie Emmanuel, ito'kĭsasattop Ap'ĭstotokiuă ipokai'tappiĭmmau.

text: Joseph otsipuawk'si otso'kani, ŭn'niitsitappiiu Ap'ĭstotokiuă oto'tokatatsĭs otan'iipiaie, ki ito'tuyiuaie otokem'an:
text_for_embed: Matthew 1:24 — Joseph otsipuawk'si otso'kani, ŭn'niitsitappiiu Ap'ĭstotokiuă oto'tokatatsĭs otan'iipiaie, ki ito'tuyiuaie otokem'an:

text: Ki ototom'okkuyi otsauomai'pokaiĭsaie matpoksokamiu'atsaie: kinitsĭn'nikŏttsiuaie JESUS.
text_for_embed: Matthew 1:25 — Ki ototom'okkuyi otsauomai'pokaiĭsaie matpoksokamiu'atsaie: kinitsĭn'nikŏttsiuaie JESUS.

text: JESUS otai'pokaiisi Bethlehem, auŏsĭn'ĭm Judæa, annists'ĭsk ksĭstsiku'ĭstsk, Herod otsĭtsĭnaiipi, Satsik, mokŏk'ietappix umut'autstsipi apinŏk'kuyi itsipuk'sipuiau Jerusalem,
text_for_embed: Matthew 2:1 — JESUS otai'pokaiisi Bethlehem, auŏsĭn'ĭm Judæa, annists'ĭsk ksĭstsiku'ĭstsk, Herod otsĭtsĭnaiipi, Satsik, mokŏk'ietappix umut'autstsipi apinŏk'kuyi itsipuk'sipuiau Jerusalem,

text: An'iau, ŭnan'ŏk manipok'auŏk Jews otsĭn'aimoaiauaie? Tŭkkă, annim' apinŏk'kuyi stai'tappiosi nitsĭno'ŭnan okŏkatosim, ki nimut'otopĭnan nŏk'itauatsĭmmimmŏsĭnan.
text_for_embed: Matthew 2:2 — An'iau, ŭnan'ŏk manipok'auŏk Jews otsĭn'aimoaiauaie? Tŭkkă, annim' apinŏk'kuyi stai'tappiosi nitsĭno'ŭnan okŏkatosim, ki nimut'otopĭnan nŏk'itauatsĭmmimmŏsĭnan.

text: Herod omŭx'ina otokh'tsĭsaie, otap'itsi-tanaie, ki Jerusalem ĭstokŏnai'tappix ikŏno-nokap'aitsitamiuax.
text_for_embed: Matthew 2:3 — Herod omŭx'ina otokh'tsĭsaie, otap'itsi-tanaie, ki Jerusalem ĭstokŏnai'tappix ikŏno-nokap'aitsitamiuax.

text: Ikŏnaumoi'piŭsax omŭk'atoiapiekuax ki ai'sĭnakix, sŭppoŏttsesattsiuax Christ mŏk'itsipokaiipiaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 2:4 — Ikŏnaumoi'piŭsax omŭk'atoiapiekuax ki ai'sĭnakix, sŭppoŏttsesattsiuax Christ mŏk'itsipokaiipiaie.

text: Ki an'ĭstsiauaie, Bethlehem, Judæa ĭstauŏsĭn'im, ŭn'nimaie; ŭn'anĭstappi prophet osĭn'aksĭn;
text_for_embed: Matthew 2:5 — Ki an'ĭstsiauaie, Bethlehem, Judæa ĭstauŏsĭn'im, ŭn'nimaie; ŭn'anĭstappi prophet osĭn'aksĭn;

text: Ki ksĕsto'a Bethlehem, Judæa ĭstauŏsĭn'im, kimats'inŭkstsipuaua, Judah ĭstsĭn'ax; Nin'auŏk, ksesto'a ak'itsĭstauasiu ki osto'i ai'akaukŏkitsĭmau nitsitappim'ĭx Israel.
text_for_embed: Matthew 2:6 — Ki ksĕsto'a Bethlehem, Judæa ĭstauŏsĭn'im, kimats'inŭkstsipuaua, Judah ĭstsĭn'ax; Nin'auŏk, ksesto'a ak'itsĭstauasiu ki osto'i ai'akaukŏkitsĭmau nitsitappim'ĭx Israel.

text: Herod, sĭmi'nikŏtŭssax mokŏk'ietappix, sokap'sŭppoŏtsesattsiuax otsokap'ĭnŏkuyisaie kŏkatosi.
text_for_embed: Matthew 2:7 — Herod, sĭmi'nikŏtŭssax mokŏk'ietappix, sokap'sŭppoŏtsesattsiuax otsokap'ĭnŏkuyisaie kŏkatosi.

text: Ki itŭpŭt'okŏttsiuax Bethlehem; kian'iu, kŭkko' sokap'apsŭmmok pokau'ŏk; ki ikonoainoeniki, itŭm'ŭtskĭtsĭnikokĭk nŏk'itsitotosi nŏk'it a tsĭm mĭm mosi.
text_for_embed: Matthew 2:8 — Ki itŭpŭt'okŏttsiuax Bethlehem; kian'iu, kŭkko' sokap'apsŭmmok pokau'ŏk; ki ikonoainoeniki, itŭm'ŭtskĭtsĭnikokĭk nŏk'itsitotosi nŏk'it a tsĭm mĭm mosi.

text: Otokh'tsĭsau omŭxina otan'iipiaie, itsĭs'tapuiau; ki satĭsk, anni'isk kŏk'atosiĭsk otsitsinoauaiĭsk umut'autstsipi apinŏk'uyi otsitom'akoaiauaie, ki otai'totosi inŭk'sipokai ot'sitaupipiaie itots'iketsipuyiuaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 2:9 — Otokh'tsĭsau omŭxina otan'iipiaie, itsĭs'tapuiau; ki satĭsk, anni'isk kŏk'atosiĭsk otsitsinoauaiĭsk umut'autstsipi apinŏk'uyi otsitom'akoaiauaie, ki otai'totosi inŭk'sipokai ot'sitaupipiaie itots'iketsipuyiuaie.

text: Otsĭnno'ŏssauaie kŏk'atosi, eks'kamŭk otse'tametŭksuaii.
text_for_embed: Matthew 2:10 — Otsĭnno'ŏssauaie kŏk'atosi, eks'kamŭk otse'tametŭksuaii.

text: Ki otaitsipĭs'sau nap'ioyĭs, Mary oksis'tsi ipĭnnu'yiauaie pokai'ĭsk, ki ĭnnĭssi'iau, ki itatsĭm'mĭmmiau: ki otaipasuk'ĭnĭssauĕsts otakomŭtskotuksuauĕsts, ĭssak'okotsiauaie gold ki frankincense ki myrrh.
text_for_embed: Matthew 2:11 — Ki otaitsipĭs'sau nap'ioyĭs, Mary oksis'tsi ipĭnnu'yiauaie pokai'ĭsk, ki ĭnnĭssi'iau, ki itatsĭm'mĭmmiau: ki otaipasuk'ĭnĭssauĕsts otakomŭtskotuksuauĕsts, ĭssak'okotsiauaie gold ki frankincense ki myrrh.

text: Ap'ĭstotokiuă papaukŏkianĭstcsax mŏkstaiskĭto'tosau, noke'tsi moksokui itŭp'akaiiau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 2:12 — Ap'ĭstotokiuă papaukŏkianĭstcsax mŏkstaiskĭto'tosau, noke'tsi moksokui itŭp'akaiiau.

text: Ki otau'mattosau, satsĭk, Ap'ĭstotokiuă sto'tokatatscs papauta'atsiuaie Joseph, an'ĭsitouaie, Nipuat', ki mattos'au pokau' ki oksĭs'tsi ki ikŭm'itappoat Egypt, ki stau'pit ki kĭtak'otŭmanĭsto; tŭk'kă, Herod ai'akapsŭmmiuaie inŭk'sipokau mŏks'enitŏsaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 2:13 — Ki otau'mattosau, satsĭk, Ap'ĭstotokiuă sto'tokatatscs papauta'atsiuaie Joseph, an'ĭsitouaie, Nipuat', ki mattos'au pokau' ki oksĭs'tsi ki ikŭm'itappoat Egypt, ki stau'pit ki kĭtak'otŭmanĭsto; tŭk'kă, Herod ai'akapsŭmmiuaie inŭk'sipokau mŏks'enitŏsaie.

text: Otai'puawksi, sepiai'akotuyiuax inŭk'sipokau ki oksĭs'tsi ki Egypt itŭp'itappoiau:
text_for_embed: Matthew 2:14 — Otai'puawksi, sepiai'akotuyiuax inŭk'sipokau ki oksĭs'tsi ki Egypt itŭp'itappoiau:

text: Ki itau'piuaie otai'ĭnsaie Herod, mŏksenŭp'anĭstosi Ap'ĭstotokiuă otse'poawsĭn, otsiprophet i totsi'uaie, Egypt, ŭn'nimaie nitsĭt' ŭtŭmmau noko'a.
text_for_embed: Matthew 2:15 — Ki itau'piuaie otai'ĭnsaie Herod, mŏksenŭp'anĭstosi Ap'ĭstotokiuă otse'poawsĭn, otsiprophet i totsi'uaie, Egypt, ŭn'nimaie nitsĭt' ŭtŭmmau noko'a.

text: Herod, otai'noŏsax mokŏk'ietappix otap'apĭstotoyĭsax, eks'kaiĭstsetŭkkiu, ki itŭp'otokŏttsiuax (otsen'nakemix) Bethlehem ki sa'akapotsim, ai'stokistuyimix sŏk'umappix ikŏn'ainĭttsiauax; kŭttaistoki'stuyimix sŏk'umappix mat'okŏnainittsiauax, umut'otsksĭnippi otsokap'sŭppoŏtsesattŭsax mokŏk'ietappix.
text_for_embed: Matthew 2:16 — Herod, otai'noŏsax mokŏk'ietappix otap'apĭstotoyĭsax, eks'kaiĭstsetŭkkiu, ki itŭp'otokŏttsiuax (otsen'nakemix) Bethlehem ki sa'akapotsim, ai'stokistuyimix sŏk'umappix ikŏn'ainĭttsiauax; kŭttaistoki'stuyimix sŏk'umappix mat'okŏnainittsiauax, umut'otsksĭnippi otsokap'sŭppoŏtsesattŭsax mokŏk'ietappix.

text: Itŭm'enŭpanĭstomaie Jeremy prophet otse'poawsĭn otan'ipi,
text_for_embed: Matthew 2:17 — Itŭm'enŭpanĭstomaie Jeremy prophet otse'poawsĭn otan'ipi,

text: Epo'awsĭnni itsĭk'kitokhtsip Rama, asain'sĭnni ki aiĭm'motseisĭnni ki omŭkoyesĭnni, Rachel o'kosix itau'asŭniu ki matokuikiawpĭketŭkkiu'ats, tŭkkă, itsen'iau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 2:18 — Epo'awsĭnni itsĭk'kitokhtsip Rama, asain'sĭnni ki aiĭm'motseisĭnni ki omŭkoyesĭnni, Rachel o'kosix itau'asŭniu ki matokuikiawpĭketŭkkiu'ats, tŭkkă, itsen'iau.

text: Herod otse'ĭnsi, sat'sĭk, Ap'istotokiuă oto'tokatatsĭs Joseph otsipapau'takaie, Egypt otsitai'tappiisaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 2:19 — Herod otse'ĭnsi, sat'sĭk, Ap'istotokiuă oto'tokatatsĭs Joseph otsipapau'takaie, Egypt otsitai'tappiisaie.

text: An'ĭstsiuaie, Nipuat'ki mattos'au inŭk'sipokau ki oksĭs'tsi, ki itŭp'itappoat Israel istau'ŏsĭnĭm; tŭk'kă ini'au anniks'isk ap'ŭssummiiskaie otsipai'tappiisĭnni.
text_for_embed: Matthew 2:20 — An'ĭstsiuaie, Nipuat'ki mattos'au inŭk'sipokau ki oksĭs'tsi, ki itŭp'itappoat Israel istau'ŏsĭnĭm; tŭk'kă ini'au anniks'isk ap'ŭssummiiskaie otsipai'tappiisĭnni.

text: Ki itsipuau ki aiako'tuyiuax pokau'a ki o ksĭs'tsi, ki Israel ĭstauŏsĭn'im ito'to.
text_for_embed: Matthew 2:21 — Ki itsipuau ki aiako'tuyiuax pokau'a ki o ksĭs'tsi, ki Israel ĭstauŏsĭn'im ito'to.

text: Ki otokh'tsĭssi Archelaus otau'atsuaiitsitapai'naiisi un'ni otsĭn'naiisĭnni, ĭsstŭn'ĭmaie mŏk'ĭttapposaie; ki Ap'ĭstotokiuă otsipapauanĭstosaie, Galilee itanĭs'tŭpitappo:
text_for_embed: Matthew 2:22 — Ki otokh'tsĭssi Archelaus otau'atsuaiitsitapai'naiisi un'ni otsĭn'naiisĭnni, ĭsstŭn'ĭmaie mŏk'ĭttapposaie; ki Ap'ĭstotokiuă otsipapauanĭstosaie, Galilee itanĭs'tŭpitappo:

text: Ki akapioyis, Nazareth anĭstau, ito'to kiitoko'yiu; mŏkenŭpanĭstosaie prophetix otan'iipiax, akanĭstai'nikŏttau Nazaren'aikuŭn.
text_for_embed: Matthew 2:23 — Ki akapioyis, Nazareth anĭstau, ito'to kiitoko'yiu; mŏkenŭpanĭstosaie prophetix otan'iipiax, akanĭstai'nikŏttau Nazaren'aikuŭn.

text: ANNISTS'ISK ksĭstsiku'ĭstsk John Baptist ito'to Judæa istoksĭs'tapiksŏkkui, itŭs'-ksĭnimatstokiu,
text_for_embed: Matthew 3:1 — ANNISTS'ISK ksĭstsiku'ĭstsk John Baptist ito'to Judæa istoksĭs'tapiksŏkkui, itŭs'-ksĭnimatstokiu,

text: Ki an'iu sauai'tsitak, spots'im ĭstsĭn'naiisĭnni aststsiu'.
text_for_embed: Matthew 3:2 — Ki an'iu sauai'tsitak, spots'im ĭstsĭn'naiisĭnni aststsiu'.

text: Am'auk annŏk' matap'piuŏk Isaiah prophet an'iu Nitsităppiuă ksĭstapitauosĭnim sokse'puyiu, Sŭppoatsĭstotokh'sattoat Nin'a oksokui, oksoku'ĭsts mokŏm'otstsĭsests.
text_for_embed: Matthew 3:3 — Am'auk annŏk' matap'piuŏk Isaiah prophet an'iu Nitsităppiuă ksĭstapitauosĭnim sokse'puyiu, Sŭppoatsĭstotokh'sattoat Nin'a oksokui, oksoku'ĭsts mokŏm'otstsĭsests.

text: Ki John, Camel oku'yĭsts, itsĭs'totosiu, ki ĭstsikŏp'okui itsep'siu; ki otso'ŏssĭnĕsts tsikatsix ki namap'iniu.
text_for_embed: Matthew 3:4 — Ki John, Camel oku'yĭsts, itsĭs'totosiu, ki ĭstsikŏp'okui itsep'siu; ki otso'ŏssĭnĕsts tsikatsix ki namap'iniu.

text: Jerusalem istokŏnai'tappix otokŏnitota'akax, ki Judæa ĭstokŏnai'tappix, ki Jordan ĭstauŏssĭn'im ĭstokŏnai'tappix mat'okŏnitautaakax.
text_for_embed: Matthew 3:5 — Jerusalem istokŏnai'tappix otokŏnitota'akax, ki Judæa ĭstokŏnai'tappix, ki Jordan ĭstauŏssĭn'im ĭstokŏnai'tappix mat'okŏnitautaakax.

text: Ki nie'tŭktai Jordan (an'istop), otsĭt'ŭstapinopiax, ki otsauum'itsitappiisuĕsts aiinŭp'anĭstomiauĕsts.

text: Puksipĭp'potomĭniki kitak'iksĭstomŭtskotŭksĭnni natoi'apioyĭs, ki ĭsksĭnĭm'ĭniki kixokoa kĭtsĭs'tsĭmmok,

text: Kinet'oopspi itsuyĭsseeniki, sauau'tos ki mĭs'tŭpapiksĭstsĭs: ŏkh'siu tŭks'kŭma mŏk'saiĭnakuaiĭssi koŏpspi, ŏkstaiĭs'tupapiksĭs kostŭm Gehenna.

text: Ksŏk'kum pini'tŭpŭtauŭnik; itsĭssuikau'piu: Jerusalem pini'tŭpŭtauŭnik; tŭkka Omŭx'ina ot'akapioyimaie.

text: Mŏksisĭmĭs'si kitaumŭts'kotŭksĭnni; ki Kĭn'a, aisĭmmiŭs'sŭppiuŏk, kitaksĭnnoam'sakinosŭk.

text: Ki atsĭmoi'ikainoeniki pinet'omanĭstsĭk aiksĭstap'okŏmotsitappikasix: otŭk'ometsĭmanoaiau mŏkauatsĭmoiikasau otsitai'puyisau natoi'apioyists ki moksoku'ĭsts itsi'kokeĭsts, matap'pix mŏksĭnnu'yĭssau. Kitau'mŭnĭstopuau, sakino'sattaiau.

text: Ki Ksĕsto'a, a'tsĭmoiikainiki, ĭstsipi koko'ai, okĭm'ĭniki, a'tsĭmoiikamĭs kĭn'a ai'sĭmmiapsiuă; ki kĭn'a, aisĭmmiŭs'sŭppiuŏk, kitaksĭnnoam'sakinosŭk.

text: Pinet'omanĭstsik, tŭkka Kin'oau ĭsksĭnĭm'ests kitsipu'ĭnakitsipists kitsauomauan'ĭstopi.

text: Ŭnanĭsto'tos Kitotŭmap'sĭnni: spots'im Kitsitsi'tan kanĭs'tutsipi, annom' ksŭk'kum nokŭt'anĭstutsit:

text_for_embed: Matthew 7:26 — Ki annŏk' aiokh'tsĭmiuŏk annists'isk nitse'poawsĭstsk, ki matsĭstutsim'atsĕsts aks'istutsiu mattsapsĭn'ai, annŏk' itokhit'okoĭskauŭk spŏts' ikui:

text: Ki ai'sotau, ki ai'sauksikĭmskau, ki ai'sopu, ki annik' nap'ioyĭs itot'sŭppu; ki ĭstokhopi'u; ki omŭk'o otsĭs'tokhopiisĭnni.
text_for_embed: Matthew 7:27 — Ki ai'sotau, ki ai'sauksikĭmskau, ki ai'sopu, ki annik' nap'ioyĭs itot'sŭppu; ki ĭstokhopi'u; ki omŭk'o otsĭs'tokhopiisĭnni.

text: Ki ŭn'nitsiu, Jesus otaiksĭste'poattosĕsts annists'isk epo'awsĭstsk, matap'pix skaie'tŭkkiau otsksĭnĭmats'tŭksĭnni;
text_for_embed: Matthew 7:28 — Ki ŭn'nitsiu, Jesus otaiksĭste'poattosĕsts annists'isk epo'awsĭstsk, matap'pix skaie'tŭkkiau otsksĭnĭmats'tŭksĭnni;

text: Ototŭmap'sĭnni itŭs'ksĭnĭmatsiuax, ki sĭnak'ix manĭstŭs'ksĭnĭmatsawpiax, matŭsksĭnĭmatsiu'atsax.
text_for_embed: Matthew 7:29 — Ototŭmap'sĭnni itŭs'ksĭnĭmatsiuax, ki sĭnak'ix manĭstŭs'ksĭnĭmatsawpiax, matŭsksĭnĭmatsiu'atsax.

text: OTSĬN'NĬSAATOSSI nitum'mo akai'tappiii itopokiuo'iauaie
text_for_embed: Matthew 8:1 — OTSĬN'NĬSAATOSSI nitum'mo akai'tappiii itopokiuo'iauaie

text: Ki, satsĭk, nĭnuau leper otsittotaakaie ki otsĭt'atsĭmmĭmmokaie, Id otsĭt'anikaie, Nin'a, atsi'tatomĭniki kitokotsiksĭxistotok.
text_for_embed: Matthew 8:2 — Ki, satsĭk, nĭnuau leper otsittotaakaie ki otsĭt'atsĭmmĭmmokaie, Id otsĭt'anikaie, Nin'a, atsi'tatomĭniki kitokotsiksĭxistotok.

text: Ki Jesus itsau'ksikĭnstsiakiu, ki itsĭxen'iuaie, ki an'iu, nitak'anĭstutsip; ksĭksĭt'. Ki soksiksĭk'siuaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 8:3 — Ki Jesus itsau'ksikĭnstsiakiu, ki itsĭxen'iuaie, ki an'iu, nitak'anĭstutsip; ksĭksĭt'. Ki soksiksĭk'siuaie.

text: Ki Jesus anĭstsiuaie, Sat'sĭt, pinaiitsinikos matap'pi; mĭs'taput, annĭs'tsĭnnosattsĭs natoi'apiekuŭn, ki aniiik' otan'ipik Moses ĭssa'kumŭtskotoat mŏks'ksĭniĭsau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 8:4 — Ki Jesus anĭstsiuaie, Sat'sĭt, pinaiitsinikos matap'pi; mĭs'taput, annĭs'tsĭnnosattsĭs natoi'apiekuŭn, ki aniiik' otan'ipik Moses ĭssa'kumŭtskotoat mŏks'ksĭniĭsau.

text: Ki Jesus otsito'taipiĭssi Capernaum, eĕn'aken'ai otsĭtto'taakaie, ki otau'kŏmŏnikaie,
text_for_embed: Matthew 8:5 — Ki Jesus otsito'taipiĭssi Capernaum, eĕn'aken'ai otsĭtto'taakaie, ki otau'kŏmŏnikaie,

text: Ki otan'ikaie Nin'a, anrŏk' nitapotomokŏk noko'ai itsĭs'tokhaitsiu, ai'papuyiu, eks'kaaipuĭnŭm.
text_for_embed: Matthew 8:6 — Ki otan'ikaie Nin'a, anrŏk' nitapotomokŏk noko'ai itsĭs'tokhaitsiu, ai'papuyiu, eks'kaaipuĭnŭm.

text: Ki Jesus an'ĭstsiuaie, nitak'ittappo nitak'okuttutoau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 8:7 — Ki Jesus an'ĭstsiuaie, nitak'ittappo nitak'okuttutoau.

text: Eĕnaken'ai an'ĭstsiuaie, Nin'a, nimat'sipumapspa kŏkĭtsipĭssi noko'ai: kakse'puyit, ki annŏk' nitapotomokŏk ak'okuttutoau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 8:8 — Eĕnaken'ai an'ĭstsiuaie, Nin'a, nimat'sipumapspa kŏkĭtsipĭssi noko'ai: kakse'puyit, ki annŏk' nitapotomokŏk ak'okuttutoau.

text: Nĕsto'a nitap'otomoki, ki eĕn'akex nitap'otomokiau; ki nitan'ĭstau am'ok mĭs'taput, ki ai'ĭstapu; ki nitan'ĭstau stsĭk'i, puk'siput ki ai'paksipu; ki annŏk' nitap'otomokŏk nitan'ĭstau, am'oi ŭnnianĭs'tutsit, ki au'anĭstutsimaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 8:9 — Nĕsto'a nitap'otomoki, ki eĕn'akex nitap'otomokiau; ki nitan'ĭstau am'ok mĭs'taput, ki ai'ĭstapu; ki nitan'ĭstau stsĭk'i, puk'siput ki ai'paksipu; ki annŏk' nitap'otomokŏk nitan'ĭstau, am'oi ŭnnianĭs'tutsit, ki au'anĭstutsimaie.

text: Jesus otokh'tsĭmsaie, skai'etŭkkiu, ki an'ĭstsiuax anniks'isk matap'pixk ipokiuo'ixk, Kitau'mŭnĭstopuau manĭst'omŭkopi otaumai'tŭksĭnni nimatŭnĭstokonip'ats Israel ĭstauŏsĭn'im.
text_for_embed: Matthew 8:10 — Jesus otokh'tsĭmsaie, skai'etŭkkiu, ki an'ĭstsiuax anniks'isk matap'pixk ipokiuo'ixk, Kitau'mŭnĭstopuau manĭst'omŭkopi otaumai'tŭksĭnni nimatŭnĭstokonip'ats Israel ĭstauŏsĭn'im.

text: Ki kitan'ĭstopuau akai'tappii umutautstsipi apinŏk'kuyi ki otsĭt'tistŭkkŏpipi ak'ŭtotoiau, ki akopokau'pimiuax Abraham ki Isaac ki Jacob spots' im ĭstsĭn'naiisĭnni.
text_for_embed: Matthew 8:11 — Ki kitan'ĭstopuau akai'tappii umutautstsipi apinŏk'kuyi ki otsĭt'tistŭkkŏpipi ak'ŭtotoiau, ki akopokau'pimiuax Abraham ki Isaac ki Jacob spots' im ĭstsĭn'naiisĭnni.

text: Ki nĭn'naiisĭnni ĭstokos'ix ak'satŭpiksĭstsiauax ski'natsii; annim asain'sĭnni ki satse'kĭnan ak'itstsiian.
text_for_embed: Matthew 8:12 — Ki nĭn'naiisĭnni ĭstokos'ix ak'satŭpiksĭstsiauax ski'natsii; annim asain'sĭnni ki satse'kĭnan ak'itstsiian.

text: Jesus an'ĭstsiuaie eĕnaken'ai mĭs'taput, kanĭst'aumaitŭkkipi kitakŭnĭsttutoko ki annŏk' otap'otomokŏk itsok'okuttutoau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 8:13 — Jesus an'ĭstsiuaie eĕnaken'ai mĭs'taput, kanĭst'aumaitŭkkipi kitakŭnĭsttutoko ki annŏk' otap'otomokŏk itsok'okuttutoau.

text: Ki Jesus otsĭtsipĭssaie Peter oko'aiaie, nannuyiuaie otokem'ani o'ksĭstsiaie itsĭs'tokhaitsiĭnaie, ai'okhtokĭm pŭs'tsĭmesĭnni.
text_for_embed: Matthew 8:14 — Ki Jesus otsĭtsipĭssaie Peter oko'aiaie, nannuyiuaie otokem'ani o'ksĭstsiaie itsĭs'tokhaitsiĭnaie, ai'okhtokĭm pŭs'tsĭmesĭnni.

text: Ki kaien'ĭmaie otsĭssi, ki pŭs'tsĭmesĭnni itskĭmaie: ki itsipuau', ki ito'yiuax,
text_for_embed: Matthew 8:15 — Ki kaien'ĭmaie otsĭssi, ki pŭs'tsĭmesĭnni itskĭmaie: ki itsipuau', ki ito'yiuax,

text: Autŭkkus'si ito'tsĭpotuyiauaie akai'tappiiau sauum'itsistaawx pakh'tokĭnattsiikiauax: ki otse'poawsĭnni itsa'tŭpiksĭstsiuax staawx, ki ikut'tutuyiuax ikŏnai'okhtokosix:
text_for_embed: Matthew 8:16 — Autŭkkus'si ito'tsĭpotuyiauaie akai'tappiiau sauum'itsistaawx pakh'tokĭnattsiikiauax: ki otse'poawsĭnni itsa'tŭpiksĭstsiuax staawx, ki ikut'tutuyiuax ikŏnai'okhtokosix:

text: Mŏks'enŭpanĭstosi otan'ipiaie Esias prophet, ki an'iu, Osto'i mat'sĭmĕsts kĭtsauŭt' tsikotsapsĭnunĭsts, ki ipa'tomĕsts kitokh'tokosĭnunĭsts.
text_for_embed: Matthew 8:17 — Mŏks'enŭpanĭstosi otan'ipiaie Esias prophet, ki an'iu, Osto'i mat'sĭmĕsts kĭtsauŭt' tsikotsapsĭnunĭsts, ki ipa'tomĕsts kitokh'tokosĭnunĭsts.

text: Jesus otsĭnno'ŏssax akai'tappiiĭx oto'tŭksipuyimokax, ikŏk'itsĭmau mŏk'opŭmmosau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 8:18 — Jesus otsĭnno'ŏssax akai'tappiiĭx oto'tŭksipuyimokax, ikŏk'itsĭmau mŏk'opŭmmosau.

text: Ki tukskŭmĭni aisĭnaki'ĭna itoto'yĭnaie ki an'ĭstsiuaie, Nin'a kitak'ittappopi nitak'opokiuo.
text_for_embed: Matthew 8:19 — Ki tukskŭmĭni aisĭnaki'ĭna itoto'yĭnaie ki an'ĭstsiuaie, Nin'a kitak'ittappopi nitak'opokiuo.

text: Jesus an'ĭstsiuaie, ota'tuyix au'ŏttsimaniau, ki paiu'tax au'yiiiau; ki Nĭn'nau okku'yi matsĭstokhotom'atsaie otokŏn'.
text_for_embed: Matthew 8:20 — Jesus an'ĭstsiuaie, ota'tuyix au'ŏttsimaniau, ki paiu'tax au'yiiiau; ki Nĭn'nau okku'yi matsĭstokhotom'atsaie otokŏn'.

text: Ki stsĭk'i otŭsksĭnĭmats'aie an'ĭstsiuaie Nin'a, nŏk'otomitappo nŏk'akitsŏsi nĭn'a.
text_for_embed: Matthew 8:21 — Ki stsĭk'i otŭsksĭnĭmats'aie an'ĭstsiuaie Nin'a, nŏk'otomitappo nŏk'akitsŏsi nĭn'a.

text: Ki Jesus an'ĭstsiuaie, sŭppa'kit; ki enix ŭnanĭstak'itsŏsauax enix.
text_for_embed: Matthew 8:22 — Ki Jesus an'ĭstsiuaie, sŭppa'kit; ki enix ŭnanĭstak'itsŏsauax enix.

text: Ki otsŭppopĭs'si akh'iosatsĭs, otŭs'ksĭnĭmatsax ipokitsŭppo'piiax.
text_for_embed: Matthew 8:23 — Ki otsŭppopĭs'si akh'iosatsĭs, otŭs'ksĭnĭmatsax ipokitsŭppo'piiax.

text: Ki satsit iek'opaikĭmskau, ki ai'sikopaikĭmskau akh'iosatsĭs; ki ai'okau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 8:24 — Ki satsit iek'opaikĭmskau, ki ai'sikopaikĭmskau akh'iosatsĭs; ki ai'okau.

text: Ki otŭs'ksĭnĭmatsax otsĭt'totaakikax ki otsitsiksekenokikax, ki an'ĭstsiikiauaie, Nin'a kŏmotse'piokĭnan: nitaks'ĭnetspĭnan.
text_for_embed: Matthew 8:25 — Ki otŭs'ksĭnĭmatsax otsĭt'totaakikax ki otsitsiksekenokikax, ki an'ĭstsiikiauaie, Nin'a kŏmotse'piokĭnan: nitaks'ĭnetspĭnan.

text: Ki an'ĭstsiuax kumauk'sikopupuauaisks kitsenŭkumaitŭkkipuan? Itŭmit'sipuau, ki ai'sĭtsĭpsattomĕsts sopu'ĭsts ki pai'kĭmskaiĭsts; ki ikŏnau' maitsiĕsts.
text_for_embed: Matthew 8:26 — Ki an'ĭstsiuax kumauk'sikopupuauaisks kitsenŭkumaitŭkkipuan? Itŭmit'sipuau, ki ai'sĭtsĭpsattomĕsts sopu'ĭsts ki pai'kĭmskaiĭsts; ki ikŏnau' maitsiĕsts.

text: Ki nĭn'ax skai'etŭkkiau, ki an'iau, Tsŏkhtanĭstap'ĭnanŏkhtauts, sopu'ĭsts ki omŭk' sikĭmi manĭstse'tokĕsts?
text_for_embed: Matthew 8:27 — Ki nĭn'ax skai'etŭkkiau, ki an'iau, Tsŏkhtanĭstap'ĭnanŏkhtauts, sopu'ĭsts ki omŭk' sikĭmi manĭstse'tokĕsts?

text: Ki otopŭmmo'si Gergesenes ĭstauŏsĭn'im ito'tatsemiauaie natsitappii sauumitsistaawx pakh'tokĭnattsiikiax, aken'imanĭsts itsŭx'iax, eks'kainixiikiax, matap'pi matokottotsitsko'pats.
text_for_embed: Matthew 8:28 — Ki otopŭmmo'si Gergesenes ĭstauŏsĭn'im ito'tatsemiauaie natsitappii sauumitsistaawx pakh'tokĭnattsiikiax, aken'imanĭsts itsŭx'iax, eks'kainixiikiax, matap'pi matokottotsitsko'pats.

text: Ki satsit, aisokse'puyiau, ki an'iau, Tsaakanĭstappikitsĭmattopĭnan, ksĕsto'ă ki nĕstŭnan, Jesus, Ap'ĭstotokiuă okku'yi? Kikŭt'tautotopa kŏkkĭtsikĭmatsĭstotoksĭnan otsauomo'tosi itaiksĭstsikumiopi kŏk'kĭtsikĭmatsĭstotoksĭnan?
text_for_embed: Matthew 8:29 — Ki satsit, aisokse'puyiau, ki an'iau, Tsaakanĭstappikitsĭmattopĭnan, ksĕsto'ă ki nĕstŭnan, Jesus, Ap'ĭstotokiuă okku'yi? Kikŭt'tautotopa kŏkkĭtsikĭmatsĭstotoksĭnan otsauomo'tosi itaiksĭstsikumiopi kŏk'kĭtsikĭmatsĭstotoksĭnan?

text: Ki Pĭstsĭksi'pio akaiĕm ak'sĭnix itau'yiau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 8:30 — Ki Pĭstsĭksi'pio akaiĕm ak'sĭnix itau'yiau.

text: Ki sauum'itsistaawx au'kŏmŏnĭstsiauaie ki an'ĭstsiauaie, saiai'pixĭkĭnaniki, nŏk'itsipĭsĭnaniau ak'sĭnix.
text_for_embed: Matthew 8:31 — Ki sauum'itsistaawx au'kŏmŏnĭstsiauaie ki an'ĭstsiauaie, saiai'pixĭkĭnaniki, nŏk'itsipĭsĭnaniau ak'sĭnix.

text: Ki an'ĭstsiuax kŭkku'. Ki otsŭksax, ak'sĭnix itsipim'iax: ki, satsit, kŏnak'sĭnix itsĭn'aukskasiau inno'tsĭstŭppakui, ki omŭk'sikĭmi suioks'kasattomiau, ki inets'iau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 8:32 — Ki an'ĭstsiuax kŭkku'. Ki otsŭksax, ak'sĭnix itsipim'iax: ki, satsit, kŏnak'sĭnix itsĭn'aukskasiau inno'tsĭstŭppakui, ki omŭk'sikĭmi suioks'kasattomiau, ki inets'iau.

text: Ki anniks'ĭsk matap'pixk ŭsks'kŭmiĭskax itsĭs'tŭpaukskasiau, ki akap'ioyĭs itsipim'iau ki ai'itsĭnikŏttsiauax, ki anniks'ĭsk matap'pixk pakhtokkĭnattsixk sauum'itsistaawx mats'itsĭnnikŏttsiauax.
text_for_embed: Matthew 8:33 — Ki anniks'ĭsk matap'pixk ŭsks'kŭmiĭskax itsĭs'tŭpaukskasiau, ki akap'ioyĭs itsipim'iau ki ai'itsĭnikŏttsiauax, ki anniks'ĭsk matap'pixk pakhtokkĭnattsixk sauum'itsistaawx mats'itsĭnnikŏttsiauax.

text: Ki, sat'sĭt, Kŏnai'tappix ikŏnai'sŭxkitsĭmiau akap'ioyĭs mŏkittotatsemŏsau Jesus: ki otsĭnno'ŏssauaie, au'kŏmŏnĭstsiauaie mŏks'ĭstapusaie otau'ŏssuai.
text_for_embed: Matthew 8:34 — Ki, sat'sĭt, Kŏnai'tappix ikŏnai'sŭxkitsĭmiau akap'ioyĭs mŏkittotatsemŏsau Jesus: ki otsĭnno'ŏssauaie, au'kŏmŏnĭstsiauaie mŏks'ĭstapusaie otau'ŏssuai.

text: KI itsŭppo'piu akh'iosatsĭs, ki ito'pŭmmo ki otauŭtakap'ioyim ito'to.
text_for_embed: Matthew 9:1 — KI itsŭppo'piu akh'iosatsĭs, ki ito'pŭmmo ki otauŭtakap'ioyim ito'to.

text: Ki, sat'sit, itotsĭp'iauaie nĭn'nau, ai'pakhpuyiu, ĭstokhai'tsiu ŭksĭn': Ki Jesus otsĭnĭs'saie otaumai'tŭksuaiax anĭstsiuaie ai'pakhpuyiuă, Noko'a, ŏkh'sitŭkkĭt; kitsauum'itsitappiisĭsts ĭsksĭnip'iau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 9:2 — Ki, sat'sit, itotsĭp'iauaie nĭn'nau, ai'pakhpuyiu, ĭstokhai'tsiu ŭksĭn': Ki Jesus otsĭnĭs'saie otaumai'tŭksuaiax anĭstsiuaie ai'pakhpuyiuă, Noko'a, ŏkh'sitŭkkĭt; kitsauum'itsitappiisĭsts ĭsksĭnip'iau.

text: Ki, sat'sit, stsĭk'ix ai'sĭnakix ĭstai'au am'o (nin'nau) makapie'puyiu.
text_for_embed: Matthew 9:3 — Ki, sat'sit, stsĭk'ix ai'sĭnakix ĭstai'au am'o (nin'nau) makapie'puyiu.

text: Ki Jesus ĭsksĭnĭm'ĕsts otŭs'tapuauĕsts ki an'iu, kumauk'itsitatopuauaisks maka'pi ku'skĕttsipŏppuauĕsts?
text_for_embed: Matthew 9:4 — Ki Jesus ĭsksĭnĭm'ĕsts otŭs'tapuauĕsts ki an'iu, kumauk'itsitatopuauaisks maka'pi ku'skĕttsipŏppuauĕsts?

text: Tsĭm'a ksĭstspa'pi, kŏk'ansi, kit sauum' itsitappiisĭstsĭsksĭnip'iau; ki kŏk'anĭsi, Nipuat' ki auŏkat'?
text_for_embed: Matthew 9:5 — Tsĭm'a ksĭstspa'pi, kŏk'ansi, kit sauum' itsitappiisĭstsĭsksĭnip'iau; ki kŏk'anĭsi, Nipuat' ki auŏkat'?

text: Ki kŏks'ksĭniisuai Nin'a okku'yi ikŏts'ksĭnĭmĕsts sauum'itsitappiisĭsts annom' ksŏkkum (itŭm'anĭstsiuaie aipakhpuyii) Nipuat', matsit' kitŭk'sĭn, koko'ai is'taput.
text_for_embed: Matthew 9:6 — Ki kŏks'ksĭniisuai Nin'a okku'yi ikŏts'ksĭnĭmĕsts sauum'itsitappiisĭsts annom' ksŏkkum (itŭm'anĭstsiuaie aipakhpuyii) Nipuat', matsit' kitŭk'sĭn, koko'ai is'taput.

text: Ki itsipuau' ki oko'ai itsitap'po.
text_for_embed: Matthew 9:7 — Ki itsipuau' ki oko'ai itsitap'po.

text: Ki akai'tappiii otsĭnĭs'sax, skai'etŭkkiau, ki a'tsĭmmĭmmiauaie Ap'ĭstotokiua annŏk' ikotsiu'ŏk matap'pix otŭmap'sĭnni.
text_for_embed: Matthew 9:8 — Ki akai'tappiii otsĭnĭs'sax, skai'etŭkkiau, ki a'tsĭmmĭmmiauaie Ap'ĭstotokiua annŏk' ikotsiu'ŏk matap'pix otŭmap'sĭnni.

text: Ki Jesus otaumatto'si, nannuyiuaie nĭn'nau, an'ĭstau Matthew, itaupii'ĭnai itai'ponitatopiaie, ki an'ĭstsiuaie Sŭppa'kĭt. Ki itsipuau' ki pokio'attsiuaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 9:9 — Ki Jesus otaumatto'si, nannuyiuaie nĭn'nau, an'ĭstau Matthew, itaupii'ĭnai itai'ponitatopiaie, ki an'ĭstsiuaie Sŭppa'kĭt. Ki itsipuau' ki pokio'attsiuaie.

text: Ki ŭn'niitsiu Jesus otsitsĭps'taupĭssi nap'ioyĭs, otau'yĭssi, sat'sĭt akai'tappiiau publicanix ki sauum'itsitappix, itsito'taipimiau ki ipokau'pimiauax (Jesus) ki otŭs'ksĭnĭmatsax.
text_for_embed: Matthew 9:10 — Ki ŭn'niitsiu Jesus otsitsĭps'taupĭssi nap'ioyĭs, otau'yĭssi, sat'sĭt akai'tappiiau publicanix ki sauum'itsitappix, itsito'taipimiau ki ipokau'pimiauax (Jesus) ki otŭs'ksĭnĭmatsax.

text: Ki Pharisees otsĭnno'ŏssax, itŭnĭs'tsiauax otŭsksĭnĭmats'axaie. Kitsĭn'aimoau maukopoks'oyimiax publicanix ki sauum'itsitappix?
text_for_embed: Matthew 9:11 — Ki Pharisees otsĭnno'ŏssax, itŭnĭs'tsiauax otŭsksĭnĭmats'axaie. Kitsĭn'aimoau maukopoks'oyimiax publicanix ki sauum'itsitappix?

text: Jesus otokh'tsĭsaie, an'ĭstsiuax, anniks'ĭsk matap'pixk ikut'totoaxk matsĭmmŭki tappi'uaxau assokinakki, anniks'ĭsk matap'pixk ai'okhtokosixk kĭmŭk'ĭttappiiau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 9:12 — Jesus otokh'tsĭsaie, an'ĭstsiuax, anniks'ĭsk matap'pixk ikut'totoaxk matsĭmmŭki tappi'uaxau assokinakki, anniks'ĭsk matap'pixk ai'okhtokosixk kĭmŭk'ĭttappiiau.

text: Is'tapuk, ŭs'ksĭnĭk manĭstap'ipi, nitŏkh'sitsip kĭm'apiisĭnni, ki nimatŏkhsitsipats ikĭt'stŭksĭnni: tŭk'ka nimat'ŭtotopa nŏk'ainikŏttosau mokŏm'otsitappix mŏks'isauaitsitasau, sauum'itsitappix nimut'oto.
text_for_embed: Matthew 9:13 — Is'tapuk, ŭs'ksĭnĭk manĭstap'ipi, nitŏkh'sitsip kĭm'apiisĭnni, ki nimatŏkhsitsipats ikĭt'stŭksĭnni: tŭk'ka nimat'ŭtotopa nŏk'ainikŏttosau mokŏm'otsitappix mŏks'isauaitsitasau, sauum'itsitappix nimut'oto.

text: John otŭs'ksĭnĭmatsax otsitŭm'ittotaakax, ki an'iau, Tsanĭstapiu'ats nimutsauau'yipĭnan nestŭn'an ki Pharisees, ki kĭtŭsksĭnĭmatsax kŭttaisauauyiu'axau?
text_for_embed: Matthew 9:14 — John otŭs'ksĭnĭmatsax otsitŭm'ittotaakax, ki an'iau, Tsanĭstapiu'ats nimutsauau'yipĭnan nestŭn'an ki Pharisees, ki kĭtŭsksĭnĭmatsax kŭttaisauauyiu'axau?

text: Ki Jesus anĭstsiuax kŭttaukotau'yesiuaxau man'okkemiuŏk oko'ai ĭstokos'ix, itsa'kiitawpĭssi man'okkemiuŏk? Ki annists'isk ksĭstsiku'ĭsts ak'otoiau man'okkemiuŏk otai' akitotoawpĭstskaie, ki akotŭmsauau'yiau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 9:15 — Ki Jesus anĭstsiuax kŭttaukotau'yesiuaxau man'okkemiuŏk oko'ai ĭstokos'ix, itsa'kiitawpĭssi man'okkemiuŏk? Ki annists'isk ksĭstsiku'ĭsts ak'otoiau man'okkemiuŏk otai' akitotoawpĭstskaie, ki akotŭmsauau'yiau.

text: Kimatanipsospuau makap'isokŏsists; annik' psak'sĭnik aksoksipinikau ki saku'apĭnikan aksistŭpaipinikau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 9:16 — Kimatanipsospuau makap'isokŏsists; annik' psak'sĭnik aksoksipinikau ki saku'apĭnikan aksistŭpaipinikau.

text: Matap'pix matomaisŭppasuyĭnĭmĕsts mani'ĭsts mĭn'iokkeĭsts ŭkautokeĭssuyĭnĭsts, ŏks'kakŭmipinikau ŭk'autokeĭssuyĭnĭsts, ki mĭn'iokke ak'saikĭmsskau, ki aks'iksistsuyinasiau: Manĭn'iokkeĭsts itsŭppa'suyĭnĭmiau man'otokeĭssuyĭnists ki ai'aketŏkhsiau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 9:17 — Matap'pix matomaisŭppasuyĭnĭmĕsts mani'ĭsts mĭn'iokkeĭsts ŭkautokeĭssuyĭnĭsts, ŏks'kakŭmipinikau ŭk'autokeĭssuyĭnĭsts, ki mĭn'iokke ak'saikĭmsskau, ki aks'iksistsuyinasiau: Manĭn'iokkeĭsts itsŭppa'suyĭnĭmiau man'otokeĭssuyĭnists ki ai'aketŏkhsiau.

text: Otsakiaisĭtsĭp'sattosax annists'ĭsk epo'awsĭsts, tukskŭm'ĭni eenakin'ai itoto'iĭnai ki a'tsĭmmĭmmiuaie, ki an'iu, Nitŭn'na ŭk'ainiu; puk'siput ki kotsĭs'i tsĭxen'ĭs, ki aks'ipui tappiiu.
text_for_embed: Matthew 9:18 — Otsakiaisĭtsĭp'sattosax annists'ĭsk epo'awsĭsts, tukskŭm'ĭni eenakin'ai itoto'iĭnai ki a'tsĭmmĭmmiuaie, ki an'iu, Nitŭn'na ŭk'ainiu; puk'siput ki kotsĭs'i tsĭxen'ĭs, ki aks'ipui tappiiu.

text: Ki Jesus itsipuau', ki itopokom'iuaie, ki otŭsksĭnĭmatsax mat'opokomiauaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 9:19 — Ki Jesus itsipuau', ki itopokom'iuaie, ki otŭsksĭnĭmatsax mat'opokomiauaie.

text: Ki sat'sit ake'uă, au'atŭnikau ŭsksaumawksaikĭmskau otok'tokossĭnni na'tsikoputtuyi stuyi'ĭsts, itsŭp'paatsiuaie, ki itsĭx'enĭmaie opekakŭn'ĭmaniaie:
text_for_embed: Matthew 9:20 — Ki sat'sit ake'uă, au'atŭnikau ŭsksaumawksaikĭmskau otok'tokossĭnni na'tsikoputtuyi stuyi'ĭsts, itsŭp'paatsiuaie, ki itsĭx'enĭmaie opekakŭn'ĭmaniaie:

text: Tŭk'ka, ĭs'tau, ksen'ĭmĭniki opekakŭn'ĭmani, nĭtak'okuttotoko.
text_for_embed: Matthew 9:21 — Tŭk'ka, ĭs'tau, ksen'ĭmĭniki opekakŭn'ĭmani, nĭtak'okuttotoko.

text: Ki Jesus ito'tŭkkau; ki otsĭnno'ŏssaie, itŭni'u, Nitŭn'na, ŏkh'sitŭkkit, kitaumai'tŭksĭnni kumut'okuttotoko. Ki ake'uă annik' itokut'totoau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 9:22 — Ki Jesus ito'tŭkkau; ki otsĭnno'ŏssaie, itŭni'u, Nitŭn'na, ŏkh'sitŭkkit, kitaumai'tŭksĭnni kumut'okuttotoko. Ki ake'uă annik' itokut'totoau.

text: Ki Jesus otsĭtto'taipiisi eenakin'ai oko'ai, ki otsĭnno'ŏssax au'yesĭx ki matap'pix eĭs'tsekĭniau,
text_for_embed: Matthew 9:23 — Ki Jesus otsĭtto'taipiisi eenakin'ai oko'ai, ki otsĭnno'ŏssax au'yesĭx ki matap'pix eĭs'tsekĭniau,

text: An'ĭstsiuax, anĭs'tapaauk, ake'kuŭn matseniu'ats, ai'okau. Ki itai'ĭmiauaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 9:24 — An'ĭstsiuax, anĭs'tapaauk, ake'kuŭn matseniu'ats, ai'okau. Ki itai'ĭmiauaie.

text: Ki otsĭs'tŭpskoŏsax matap'pix, itsipim, ki ito'tsĭmaie, otsĭs'aie, ki ake'kuŭn itsipuau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 9:25 — Ki otsĭs'tŭpskoŏsax matap'pix, itsipim, ki ito'tsĭmaie, otsĭs'aie, ki ake'kuŭn itsipuau.

text: Ki otap'ĭstutsipi, annik' auŏsĭn'ik, motŭs'ksĭnĭpaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 9:26 — Ki otap'ĭstutsipi, annik' auŏsĭn'ik, motŭs'ksĭnĭpaie.

text: Ki Jesus otsĭstŭpaumatta'atossi, na'tokŭmi naps' tsix nĭn'ax ipokiuo'iax, ki aisokse'puyiax ki an'iau, David okkui', Kĭm'okĭnan.
text_for_embed: Matthew 9:27 — Ki Jesus otsĭstŭpaumatta'atossi, na'tokŭmi naps' tsix nĭn'ax ipokiuo'iax, ki aisokse'puyiax ki an'iau, David okkui', Kĭm'okĭnan.

text: Ki otsĭtsipĭs'si nap'ioyĭs, naps'tsix itoto'yiauaie: ki Jesus an'ĭstsiuax kikŭtau'maitsipuan nŏk'okotŭnĭstutsĭs? An'ĭstsiiauaie A, Nin'a.
text_for_embed: Matthew 9:28 — Ki otsĭtsipĭs'si nap'ioyĭs, naps'tsix itoto'yiauaie: ki Jesus an'ĭstsiuax kikŭtau'maitsipuan nŏk'okotŭnĭstutsĭs? An'ĭstsiiauaie A, Nin'a.

text: Itŭm'itsĭxeniuax oŏps'puauax, ki itŭni'u, kanĭsto'maitsipuai, ŭnnianĭstsĭs'.
text_for_embed: Matthew 9:29 — Itŭm'itsĭxeniuax oŏps'puauax, ki itŭni'u, kanĭsto'maitsipuai, ŭnnianĭstsĭs'.

text: Ki itsikau'opiii oŏps'puauax: ki Jesus saiemiuax mŏkstanĭs'tosax matap'pix.
text_for_embed: Matthew 9:30 — Ki itsikau'opiii oŏps'puauax: ki Jesus saiemiuax mŏkstanĭs'tosax matap'pix.

text: Ki osto'auai, otsĭs'tapusau ikŏnai'tsĭnnikoyiauax matap'pix annik'auŏsĭn'ik.
text_for_embed: Matthew 9:31 — Ki osto'auai, otsĭs'tapusau ikŏnai'tsĭnnikoyiauax matap'pix annik'auŏsĭn'ik.

text: Ki otsŭksax, sat'sit ito'tsĭpiauaie kŭttaiai'puyiua sauum'itsistaaw pakto'kĭnattsiuaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 9:32 — Ki otsŭksax, sat'sit ito'tsĭpiauaie kŭttaiai'puyiua sauum'itsistaaw pakto'kĭnattsiuaie.

text: Ki sannm'itsistaaw otsai'piksĭstŏssaie, kŭttaiai'puyină itse'puyiu: ki kŏnaitappix skai'etŭkkiau, ki an'iau, matsĭkainip'ats Israel ĭstauŏsĭn'im.
text_for_embed: Matthew 9:33 — Ki sannm'itsistaaw otsai'piksĭstŏssaie, kŭttaiai'puyină itse'puyiu: ki kŏnaitappix skai'etŭkkiau, ki an'iau, matsĭkainip'ats Israel ĭstauŏsĭn'im.

text: Ki Pharisees an'iau sauum'itsistaawx otsĭn'aimoauai itai'saipiksĭstsiuax sauum'itsistaawx.
text_for_embed: Matthew 9:34 — Ki Pharisees an'iau sauum'itsistaawx otsĭn'aimoauai itai'saipiksĭstsiuax sauum'itsistaawx.

text: Ki Jesus itap'auauŏkau kŏnau'akapioyĭsts, ki inŭk'akapioyĭsts, ki itŭs'ksĭnĭmatstokiu ota'toiapioyimoauĕsts, ki ai'semokiu nin'naiisĭnni ĭstŏkhs'itsĭniksĭnni, ki ŏk'kuttutsĭmĕsts matap'pix otokŏnai'oktokosuauĕsts ki otokŏnau'atŭnikauĕsts.
text_for_embed: Matthew 9:35 — Ki Jesus itap'auauŏkau kŏnau'akapioyĭsts, ki inŭk'akapioyĭsts, ki itŭs'ksĭnĭmatstokiu ota'toiapioyimoauĕsts, ki ai'semokiu nin'naiisĭnni ĭstŏkhs'itsĭniksĭnni, ki ŏk'kuttutsĭmĕsts matap'pix otokŏnai'oktokosuauĕsts ki otokŏnau'atŭnikauĕsts.

text: Ki otsĭnno'ŏssaie otappiisĭn'na, kaiĭm'iuaie, tŭkka ŭs'tsĭmsiu, aneto' manistau'anetopiax emŭk'ikĭnax saiits'tsĭssi ŭsks'kŭmokiuă.
text_for_embed: Matthew 9:36 — Ki otsĭnno'ŏssaie otappiisĭn'na, kaiĭm'iuaie, tŭkka ŭs'tsĭmsiu, aneto' manistau'anetopiax emŭk'ikĭnax saiits'tsĭssi ŭsks'kŭmokiuă.

text: Itŭman'ĭstsiuax otŭsksĭnĭmatsax, akauo'yi insĭn'manĭsts, ki ap'otŭkkix unna'tosĭmiau;
text_for_embed: Matthew 9:37 — Itŭman'ĭstsiuax otŭsksĭnĭmatsax, akauo'yi insĭn'manĭsts, ki ap'otŭkkix unna'tosĭmiau;

text: Atsĭm'oiikŭttok ĭnsĭm'manĭsts ĭstsĭn'nau mŏk'itŭpskoŏsax otĭnsĭmmanĭsts apotŭkkix.
text_for_embed: Matthew 9:38 — Atsĭm'oiikŭttok ĭnsĭm'manĭsts ĭstsĭn'nau mŏk'itŭpskoŏsax otĭnsĭmmanĭsts apotŭkkix.

text: OTSIPUK'SŬPINNIKŎTŬSAX na'tsikoputtsiau otŭsksĭnĭmatsax, ikotsiu'ax otŭma'sĭnni mŏk'saipiksĭstosauax sauum'itsistaax, ki mok'ŏkuttutsĭsax amian'ĭstokhtokosĭsts ki amian'ĭstatŭnikĕsts.
text_for_embed: Matthew 10:1 — OTSIPUK'SŬPINNIKŎTŬSAX na'tsikoputtsiau otŭsksĭnĭmatsax, ikotsiu'ax otŭma'sĭnni mŏk'saipiksĭstosauax sauum'itsistaax, ki mok'ŏkuttutsĭsax amian'ĭstokhtokosĭsts ki amian'ĭstatŭnikĕsts.

text: Na'tsikoputtsixk itokŏt'tsiuax otsĭn'ikŏsoauĕsts am'ostsiaukiĕsts; Matom'itappiu, Simon, mat'anistau Peter, ki Andrew oskŭn: James, Zebedee okku'i ki John oskŭn';
text_for_embed: Matthew 10:2 — Na'tsikoputtsixk itokŏt'tsiuax otsĭn'ikŏsoauĕsts am'ostsiaukiĕsts; Matom'itappiu, Simon, mat'anistau Peter, ki Andrew oskŭn: James, Zebedee okku'i ki John oskŭn';

text: Philip, ki Bartholemew; Thomas, ki Matthew, annŏk' publicanŏk; James, Alphæus okku'i. Ki Lebbæus, mat'anistau Thaddæus;
text_for_embed: Matthew 10:3 — Philip, ki Bartholemew; Thomas, ki Matthew, annŏk' publicanŏk; James, Alphæus okku'i. Ki Lebbæus, mat'anistau Thaddæus;

text: Simon, Canaanite; Ki Judas Iscariot annŏk' aien'ŭpanistsiuŏkaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 10:4 — Simon, Canaanite; Ki Judas Iscariot annŏk' aien'ŭpanistsiuŏkaie.

text: Anniks'isk natsikoputsixk Jesus itokŏt'tsiuax ki saiem'iuax ki an'ĭstsiuax, Gentiles oksoku'auĕsts pinitap'pok, ki Samaritans otakap'ioyimoauests pinŭt'sĭtsipik:
text_for_embed: Matthew 10:5 — Anniks'isk natsikoputsixk Jesus itokŏt'tsiuax ki saiem'iuax ki an'ĭstsiuax, Gentiles oksoku'auĕsts pinitap'pok, ki Samaritans otakap'ioyimoauests pinŭt'sĭtsipik:

text: Ki Israel oko'au otomŭk'ikĭnaumix ats'ax ĭs'tapuk.
text_for_embed: Matthew 10:6 — Ki Israel oko'au otomŭk'ikĭnaumix ats'ax ĭs'tapuk.

text: Ki auau'ŏkainoniki sem'okik, ki anik', spots'im ĭstsĭn'naiisĭnni aststsiu'.
text_for_embed: Matthew 10:7 — Ki auau'ŏkainoniki sem'okik, ki anik', spots'im ĭstsĭn'naiisĭnni aststsiu'.

text: Ai'oktokosix kut'tutokau, leperix ĭssin'nomokau, enix' nipua'atsokau, sauum'itsistaawx sai'aipiksĭstokau; Kitsiksist'okoko, ksistoko'tŭkkik.
text_for_embed: Matthew 10:8 — Ai'oktokosix kut'tutokau, leperix ĭssin'nomokau, enix' nipua'atsokau, sauum'itsistaawx sai'aipiksĭstokau; Kitsiksist'okoko, ksistoko'tŭkkik.

text: Gold ki silver ki brass pinitsŭp'pitŭkkik kitsitai'sŭpopumatsopuauĕsts,
text_for_embed: Matthew 10:9 — Gold ki silver ki brass pinitsŭp'pitŭkkik kitsitai'sŭpopumatsopuauĕsts,

text: Assuia'tsĭman pinots'ik aumatto'ainoainiki, pinots'ikau na'tokaists spĭks'isokŏsĭsts, ki a'tsikists, ki otoats'ists; ap'otŭkkiuã ak'otsĭmaie otso'ŏsĭn.
text_for_embed: Matthew 10:10 — Assuia'tsĭman pinots'ik aumatto'ainoainiki, pinots'ikau na'tokaists spĭks'isokŏsĭsts, ki a'tsikists, ki otoats'ists; ap'otŭkkiuã ak'otsĭmaie otso'ŏsĭn.

text: Annik' akap'ioyĭsk kĭtai'akitsipipika sŭppo'ŏttsesatsĭk annok' oks'apsiuok; ki annim' stau'pik kitsauomai'sŭkskitsĭssuai.
text_for_embed: Matthew 10:11 — Annik' akap'ioyĭsk kĭtai'akitsipipika sŭppo'ŏttsesatsĭk annok' oks'apsiuok; ki annim' stau'pik kitsauomai'sŭkskitsĭssuai.

text: Ki pim'ĭnnoainiki nap'ioyĭs, ksematsĭm'attok.
text_for_embed: Matthew 10:12 — Ki pim'ĭnnoainiki nap'ioyĭs, ksematsĭm'attok.

text: Ki ŏkhs'issi nap'ioyĭs ŭnnianĭstsito'tos kitsĭn'nŭstseisuauĕsts; ki sauŏkhs'ĭssi ŭnnianĭstsska'atok kitsĭn'nŭstseisuauĕsts.
text_for_embed: Matthew 10:13 — Ki ŏkhs'issi nap'ioyĭs ŭnnianĭstsito'tos kitsĭn'nŭstseisuauĕsts; ki sauŏkhs'ĭssi ŭnnianĭstsska'atok kitsĭn'nŭstseisuauĕsts.

text: Ki annŏk' kikŭt'tautokŏk, ki kŭt'tauotsĭmikŏk kitse'poawsĭsts, sŭkskitsĭm'ĭnnoainiki annik' akap'ioyĭsk sostsĭk'asattok.
text_for_embed: Matthew 10:14 — Ki annŏk' kikŭt'tautokŏk, ki kŭt'tauotsĭmikŏk kitse'poawsĭsts, sŭkskitsĭm'ĭnnoainiki annik' akap'ioyĭsk sostsĭk'asattok.

text: Kitau'mŭnĭstopuau akŏk'itsĭmaiksĭstsikuĭk Sodom ki Gomorrha ak'skĭtstom annik' akap'ioyĭsk.
text_for_embed: Matthew 10:15 — Kitau'mŭnĭstopuau akŏk'itsĭmaiksĭstsikuĭk Sodom ki Gomorrha ak'skĭtstom annik' akap'ioyĭsk.

text: Sat'sĭk emŭk'ikĭnax mĭs'tŭpskoawkiapis'ix neto'yik kanĭstsĭs'tŭpskopuau: mokŏk'ik manĭstsokŏkipi pitse'ksĭnax, ki ĭkkĭnaps'ik manĭstĭk'kĭnapspi kŭkku'ix,
text_for_embed: Matthew 10:16 — Sat'sĭk emŭk'ikĭnax mĭs'tŭpskoawkiapis'ix neto'yik kanĭstsĭs'tŭpskopuau: mokŏk'ik manĭstsokŏkipi pitse'ksĭnax, ki ĭkkĭnaps'ik manĭstĭk'kĭnapspi kŭkku'ix,

text: Ki ŭsks'kŭmokau matap'pix; kitakaumŭts'kaukoau akŏk'itsĭmani, ki otatoi'apioyimoauĕsts kitakitaipstŭsĭstsipĭs'okoau;
text_for_embed: Matthew 10:17 — Ki ŭsks'kŭmokau matap'pix; kitakaumŭts'kaukoau akŏk'itsĭmani, ki otatoi'apioyimoauĕsts kitakitaipstŭsĭstsipĭs'okoau;

text: Kinĭn'ax ki omŭx'ĭnax kitakittŭpĭp'iokoai, nĕsto'a kumut'aiakaitŭpipiokoai, kŏkkite'nŭpanĭstosau ki Gentiles.
text_for_embed: Matthew 10:18 — Kinĭn'ax ki omŭx'ĭnax kitakittŭpĭp'iokoai, nĕsto'a kumut'aiakaitŭpipiokoai, kŏkkite'nŭpanĭstosau ki Gentiles.

text: Ki aumŭts'kaukuĭnnoainiki pinstak kŏkŭnĭstse'puyĭsuai; annik' kitak'okokoau kitai'akanipuai.
text_for_embed: Matthew 10:19 — Ki aumŭts'kaukuĭnnoainiki pinstak kŏkŭnĭstse'puyĭsuai; annik' kitak'okokoau kitai'akanipuai.

text: Kimats'epuyipuau, Kĭn'oau osta'aw ksĕsto'au itsĭpstai'puyiu.
text_for_embed: Matthew 10:20 — Kimats'epuyipuau, Kĭn'oau osta'aw ksĕsto'au itsĭpstai'puyiu.

text: Ki umu'pappiipi akumŭts'kaiuaie umu'pappiipi mŏks'eĭnsi, ki nĭn' a akumŭts'kaiuaie okku'i; ki pokax aksenŭpanĭstaiau un'oauax ki oksĭs'toauax mŏks'enitŏsauax.
text_for_embed: Matthew 10:21 — Ki umu'pappiipi akumŭts'kaiuaie umu'pappiipi mŏks'eĭnsi, ki nĭn' a akumŭts'kaiuaie okku'i; ki pokax aksenŭpanĭstaiau un'oauax ki oksĭs'toauax mŏks'enitŏsauax.

text: Ki kŏnai' tappix kumut'akaukĭmokoaiau nĕsto'i; ki annŏk' eikak'imauŏk umuts'ipaitappiuaspi akitsikŏmotse'piauaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 10:22 — Ki kŏnai' tappix kumut'akaukĭmokoaiau nĕsto'i; ki annŏk' eikak'imauŏk umuts'ipaitappiuaspi akitsikŏmotse'piauaie.

text: Kĭm'atsĭstototsenoainiki tuks'kai akap'ioyĭs, mĭs'tŭpokskasik stsĭk'i: kitau'mŭnĭstopuau kimatakokŏnitotopuau Israel ĭstokŏnau'akapioyists otsauomai'akotosi Nĭn'au okku'i.
text_for_embed: Matthew 10:23 — Kĭm'atsĭstototsenoainiki tuks'kai akap'ioyĭs, mĭs'tŭpokskasik stsĭk'i: kitau'mŭnĭstopuau kimatakokŏnitotopuau Israel ĭstokŏnau'akapioyists otsauomai'akotosi Nĭn'au okku'i.

text: Ŭsksĭnĭmats'au matskĭtsĭmiu'ats otŭsksĭnĭmats'tokiuă, ki apotŭk'kiuă matskĭtsĭmiu'ats otsĭn'aim.

text_for_embed: Matthew 12:44 — Itŭmau'aniu nitak'ătsko noko'ai numut'sŭx; ki oto'si ikon'ĭm nam'itaitsiiu, namokh'ipaie, ki a'natsĭstutsipaie.

text: Ki itŭm'itappo ki mat'tuyiuax ikĭt'sikŭmiax sta'awx, itsĭs'tŭpokapsiax, ki itsipim'inx ki itoko'attomiax: ki otsako'itappiisĭnni eikĭs'tŭpokapiuaie ototom'itappiisĭnni. Neto'i ak'anĭstsiuaie ot'okapitappiisĭnna.
text_for_embed: Matthew 12:45 — Ki itŭm'itappo ki mat'tuyiuax ikĭt'sikŭmiax sta'awx, itsĭs'tŭpokapsiax, ki itsipim'inx ki itoko'attomiax: ki otsako'itappiisĭnni eikĭs'tŭpokapiuaie ototom'itappiisĭnni. Neto'i ak'anĭstsiuaie ot'okapitappiisĭnna.

text: Otsa'kiaisitsĭpsattosax matap'pix, Sat'sĭt, Oksĭs'tsi, ki omu'pappiipix săuauts'im itai'puyiax, ai'puĭnŭmiau mŏk'sĭtsĭpsattŏsauaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 12:46 — Otsa'kiaisitsĭpsattosax matap'pix, Sat'sĭt, Oksĭs'tsi, ki omu'pappiipix săuauts'im itai'puyiax, ai'puĭnŭmiau mŏk'sĭtsĭpsattŏsauaie.

text: Tuks'kŭm an'istsiuaie, Sat'sĭt, Kiksĭs'ta ki kumu'păppiipix sauauts'im itai'puyiau, ki ai'puĭnŭmiau kŏksiĭsĭpsaiisau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 12:47 — Tuks'kŭm an'istsiuaie, Sat'sĭt, Kiksĭs'ta ki kumu'păppiipix sauauts'im itai'puyiau, ki ai'puĭnŭmiau kŏksiĭsĭpsaiisau.

text: Ki anni'ĭsk otan'ikĭsk, an'istsiuaie, Tŭkka' niksĭs'ta? Tŭkka' numu'păppiipix?
text_for_embed: Matthew 12:48 — Ki anni'ĭsk otan'ikĭsk, an'istsiuaie, Tŭkka' niksĭs'ta? Tŭkka' numu'păppiipix?

text: Ki itas'kotuyiuax otsĭs' otŭs'ksĭnĭmatsax ki an'iu Sŭm'mokau niksĭs'tsi ki numu'păppiipix!
text_for_embed: Matthew 12:49 — Ki itas'kotuyiuax otsĭs' otŭs'ksĭnĭmatsax ki an'iu Sŭm'mokau niksĭs'tsi ki numu'păppiipix!

text: Annŏk' ai'aksĭstutsĭmŏknĭni Spots' im otsitsi'tani aie, osto'i numu'păppiipa, nĕskŭn', nit'akem, ki niksĭs'ta.
text_for_embed: Matthew 12:50 — Annŏk' ai'aksĭstutsĭmŏknĭni Spots' im otsitsi'tani aie, osto'i numu'păppiipa, nĕskŭn', nit'akem, ki niksĭs'ta.

text: ETO'IK ksĭstsiku'ik Jesus it sŭks' ki tsĭm nap'ioyĭs, ki omŭk'sikĭmi ĭssoots'i itakau' piu.
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:1 — ETO'IK ksĭstsiku'ik Jesus it sŭks' ki tsĭm nap'ioyĭs, ki omŭk'sikĭmi ĭssoots'i itakau' piu.

text: Isto'tuitappiix oto'taakax, ki akh'iosasĭs itsĭtsŭppo'piu, ki itakau'piu; ki ĭsto'tuitap-piix ikŏn'itŭssuipuyiau ĭssoots'i.
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:2 — Isto'tuitappiix oto'taakax, ki akh'iosasĭs itsĭtsŭppo'piu, ki itakau'piu; ki ĭsto'tuitap-piix ikŏn'itŭssuipuyiau ĭssoots'i.

text: Ki an'ĭstsiuax akauo'iau parables ki an'iu, Sat'sit, aisŭppipum'auă itui'sŭppipummau:
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:3 — Ki an'ĭstsiuax akauo'iau parables ki an'iu, Sat'sit, aisŭppipum'auă itui'sŭppipummau:

text: Ki otai'sŭppipummŏssi, moksoku'yi stsĭk'ĭsts itsĭn'nĭssiĕsts, ki paiu'tax itotoiax'ĕsts ki itau'attomiaxĕsts.
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:4 — Ki otai'sŭppipummŏssi, moksoku'yi stsĭk'ĭsts itsĭn'nĭssiĕsts, ki paiu'tax itotoiax'ĕsts ki itau'attomiaxĕsts.

text: Stsik'ĭsts okotoksskui itsĭn'nĭssiĕsts otsĭts'inŭxksŏkkuaspi; ki otsai'spixksŏkkuaspi itsĭk'kŭmsŭskiiau:
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:5 — Stsik'ĭsts okotoksskui itsĭn'nĭssiĕsts otsĭts'inŭxksŏkkuaspi; ki otsai'spixksŏkkuaspi itsĭk'kŭmsŭskiiau:

text: Oto'tŭmĭskŏpsi natos'i, itse'tsĭnitsiau; ki otsau'okŏtseksau itopo'kŏttsiau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:6 — Oto'tŭmĭskŏpsi natos'i, itse'tsĭnitsiau; ki otsau'okŏtseksau itopo'kŏttsiau.

text: Stsĭk'ists itsĭn'nĭssiiau ksĭssi'ix: ki ksĭssi'ix itsŭskiiau ki ito'satsiiauax:
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:7 — Stsĭk'ists itsĭn'nĭssiiau ksĭssi'ix: ki ksĭssi'ix itsŭskiiau ki ito'satsiiauax:

text: Stsĭk'ĭsts ŏkhs'ksŏkkui itsĭn'nĭssiau, kiitsĭn'asiau, stsĭk'ists kepĭp'pui, stsĭk'ists nai'ĭppui stsĭk'ists niĭp'pui.
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:8 — Stsĭk'ĭsts ŏkhs'ksŏkkui itsĭn'nĭssiau, kiitsĭn'asiau, stsĭk'ists kepĭp'pui, stsĭk'ists nai'ĭppui stsĭk'ists niĭp'pui.

text: Annŏk' ito'kiuŏk, ŭnanĭstokh'tsĭms.
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:9 — Annŏk' ito'kiuŏk, ŭnanĭstokh'tsĭms.

text: Ki; ŭsksĭnĭmats'ax ito'toyiauaie, ki an'ĭstsiauaie, Kumauk'sĭtsĭpsattaiĭsksixau parables?
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:10 — Ki; ŭsksĭnĭmats'ax ito'toyiauaie, ki an'ĭstsiauaie, Kumauk'sĭtsĭpsattaiĭsksixau parables?

text: Nokŭt'anĭstsiuax, kitokokoau kŏk'itsksĭniisuai spots'im istsĭn'naiisĭnni itse'kipi, ki osto'auai matokotau'axau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:11 — Nokŭt'anĭstsiuax, kitokokoau kŏk'itsksĭniisuai spots'im istsĭn'naiisĭnni itse'kipi, ki osto'auai matokotau'axau.

text: Annŏk' nan'naniuŏk, ak'okotauaie, ki akakai'naniu: annŏk kŭttainan'iiuŏk, otsinanattopi ak'otsipaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:12 — Annŏk' nan'naniuŏk, ak'okotauaie, ki akakai'naniu: annŏk kŭttainan'iiuŏk, otsinanattopi ak'otsipaie.

text: Ŭn'nikaie numut'ŭnĭstsĭtsĭpsattaiau parables, ĭssŭppĭs'au mŏksta'apsau; okh'tsĭmsau mŏkstau'okhtsĭmsau, mŏkstai'ĭsksĭnnisau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:13 — Ŭn'nikaie numut'ŭnĭstsĭtsĭpsattaiau parables, ĭssŭppĭs'au mŏksta'apsau; okh'tsĭmsau mŏkstau'okhtsĭmsau, mŏkstai'ĭsksĭnnisau.

text: Aien'ŭpanĭstom'ĕsts Esaias, otan'ipi, okh'tsimeniki kitak'okhtsim, ki kimat'akoksĭnipa; ki sŭppi'niki kitakŭts'api, ki kimat'aksĭnipa:
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:14 — Aien'ŭpanĭstom'ĕsts Esaias, otan'ipi, okh'tsimeniki kitak'okhtsim, ki kimat'akoksĭnipa; ki sŭppi'niki kitakŭts'api, ki kimat'aksĭnipa:

text: Am'o o'tappiisĭnna u'skĕttsipŏppĭsts mi'ĕsts, ki okhtok'oauĕsts matomaipumokhtsĭmiu'axau, ki oŏps'puauax naps'tsiiax; mŏksta'apsax moŏps'pix, mŏksta'okhtsĭmsĕsts mokhtok'ĭsts, mŏkstau'okhtsĭmsĕsts mu' skĕttsipŏppists, mŏkstaisauai'tsitasau, nok'staukuttutuawsau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:15 — Am'o o'tappiisĭnna u'skĕttsipŏppĭsts mi'ĕsts, ki okhtok'oauĕsts matomaipumokhtsĭmiu'axau, ki oŏps'puauax naps'tsiiax; mŏksta'apsax moŏps'pix, mŏksta'okhtsĭmsĕsts mokhtok'ĭsts, mŏkstau'okhtsĭmsĕsts mu' skĕttsipŏppists, mŏkstaisauai'tsitasau, nok'staukuttutuawsau.

text: Atsĭm'siau koŏps'puauax, aiapiau; ki kokhtok'ĭsts, ai'okhtsĭmiau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:16 — Atsĭm'siau koŏps'puauax, aiapiau; ki kokhtok'ĭsts, ai'okhtsĭmiau.

text: Kit au'mŭnĭstopuau, akaiĕm'ix prophetix ki mokŏm'otsitappix ai'puĭnŭmiau mŏk'satsĭsauĕsts annists'isk kitai'nipuauĭstsk ki matsiĭnĭm'axauĕsts; ki mŏk'okhtsisauĕsts annists'isk kitai'okhtsipuauĭstsk, ki matokhtsĭm'axauĕsts.
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:17 — Kit au'mŭnĭstopuau, akaiĕm'ix prophetix ki mokŏm'otsitappix ai'puĭnŭmiau mŏk'satsĭsauĕsts annists'isk kitai'nipuauĭstsk ki matsiĭnĭm'axauĕsts; ki mŏk'okhtsisauĕsts annists'isk kitai'okhtsipuauĭstsk, ki matokhtsĭm'axauĕsts.

text: Okhtok ai'sŭpipummauă parable.
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:18 — Okhtok ai'sŭpipummauă parable.

text: Ma tap' pi okhtsĭs'si nĭn'naiisĭnni istse'poawsĭn, ki sauo'kŏmotokhtsĭssi, itŭm'ipuksipu Sauum'itsitappiuă ki ito'kasattomaie annik' itsŭp'ipumattopik u'skĕttsipŏppi. Annŏk'auk mat'sĭmaie ĭstsŭpipum'ani moksoku'i.
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:19 — Ma tap' pi okhtsĭs'si nĭn'naiisĭnni istse'poawsĭn, ki sauo'kŏmotokhtsĭssi, itŭm'ipuksipu Sauum'itsitappiuă ki ito'kasattomaie annik' itsŭp'ipumattopik u'skĕttsipŏppi. Annŏk'auk mat'sĭmaie ĭstsŭpipum'ani moksoku'i.

text: Annŏk' mat'sĭmŏk ĭstsŭpipum'ani ok'otokskui, ai'okhtsĭmiu epo'awsĭnu, ki otse'tametŭksĭnni mat'sĭmaie;
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:20 — Annŏk' mat'sĭmŏk ĭstsŭpipum'ani ok'otokskui, ai'okhtsĭmiu epo'awsĭnu, ki otse'tametŭksĭnni mat'sĭmaie;

text: Mat'auŭtsitstsipa kŏk'seksi, ki matakisŭmsu'ats; ikikĭn'etŭksĭnni ki ŭkksĭstutŭk'sĭnni otos'au, atsim'epoawsĭnni ŭn'nikaie ito'toiau, ĭsts'kĭmskŭkiu.
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:21 — Mat'auŭtsitstsipa kŏk'seksi, ki matakisŭmsu'ats; ikikĭn'etŭksĭnni ki ŭkksĭstutŭk'sĭnni otos'au, atsim'epoawsĭnni ŭn'nikaie ito'toiau, ĭsts'kĭmskŭkiu.

text: Annŏk' mat'sĭmŏk ĭstsŭpipum'ani ksĭssi'ix, ai'okhtsĭmiu atsĭm'epoawsin; ki annok' pai'tappiisĭnni ĭstap'aitsitani, ki spŭkĭs'sists ito'satstomiauaie atsĭm'epoawsĭnni, ki matsinasiu'ats.
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:22 — Annŏk' mat'sĭmŏk ĭstsŭpipum'ani ksĭssi'ix, ai'okhtsĭmiu atsĭm'epoawsin; ki annok' pai'tappiisĭnni ĭstap'aitsitani, ki spŭkĭs'sists ito'satstomiauaie atsĭm'epoawsĭnni, ki matsinasiu'ats.

text: Annŏk' mat'sĭmŏk ĭstsŭpipum'ani ŏkhs'ksŏkkui, ai'okhtsĭmiu Atsĭm'epoawsinni, ki mokŏm'otokhtsĭmaie; ki itsin'asiu, stsikix, kepĭp'puyi, stsik'ix nai'ĭppuyi, stsĭk'ix niip'puyi.
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:23 — Annŏk' mat'sĭmŏk ĭstsŭpipum'ani ŏkhs'ksŏkkui, ai'okhtsĭmiu Atsĭm'epoawsinni, ki mokŏm'otokhtsĭmaie; ki itsin'asiu, stsikix, kepĭp'puyi, stsik'ix nai'ĭppuyi, stsĭk'ix niip'puyi.

text: Stsik'i parable an'ĭstsiuax, ki an'iu, Spots'ĭm'ĭstsinnaiisĭnni netum'anĭstsiu Nĭn'au, annŏk' ai'sŭpipumauŏk ŏkh'sisŭppipum'ani otsĭn'sĭmman;
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:24 — Stsik'i parable an'ĭstsiuax, ki an'iu, Spots'ĭm'ĭstsinnaiisĭnni netum'anĭstsiu Nĭn'au, annŏk' ai'sŭpipumauŏk ŏkh'sisŭppipum'ani otsĭn'sĭmman;

text: otai'okasax otap'automokix, okatum'i ito'toyiuaie, ki ŏkh'sisŭpipumani ipa'soksŭp'pipumau makap'sŭpipumani, ki itsĭs'tapu.
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:25 — otai'okasax otap'automokix, okatum'i ito'toyiuaie, ki ŏkh'sisŭpipumani ipa'soksŭp'pipumau makap'sŭpipumani, ki itsĭs'tapu.

text: Ki otsŭs'kĭssi mattuyĭs, ki otsĭn'assi, itŭmĭn'akuo makap'sŭpipumani.
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:26 — Ki otsŭs'kĭssi mattuyĭs, ki otsĭn'assi, itŭmĭn'akuo makap'sŭpipumani.

text: Ki Nin'au otapautomokix otsito'taakax ki an'ĭstsiauaie, Nin'a, Kikŭt'taiĭnsĭmattop'a ŏkhsisŭpipumani kĭtsĭnsĭmman? Tsema ito'to makap'sŭpipumani?
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:27 — Ki Nin'au otapautomokix otsito'taakax ki an'ĭstsiauaie, Nin'a, Kikŭt'taiĭnsĭmattop'a ŏkhsisŭpipumani kĭtsĭnsĭmman? Tsema ito'to makap'sŭpipumani?

text: An'istsiuax, Katum'a otap'ĭstntŭksĭnaie. Ap'automokix otan'ikax kikŭt'ŏkhsitŭkkipa nŏk'ittotosĭnan nŏk'sauotsĭsĭnaniau?
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:28 — An'istsiuax, Katum'a otap'ĭstntŭksĭnaie. Ap'automokix otan'ikax kikŭt'ŏkhsitŭkkipa nŏk'ittotosĭnan nŏk'sauotsĭsĭnaniau?

text: Ki an'iu, Sa; sauau'tsĭmĭnoainikiau, makap'sŭpipnmani, kŏkskakŭm'sanotsipnaii ŏkh'sisŭpipumani.
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:29 — Ki an'iu, Sa; sauau'tsĭmĭnoainikiau, makap'sŭpipnmani, kŏkskakŭm'sanotsipnaii ŏkh'sisŭpipumani.

text: Unnianĭst'sŭskĭsan mŏk'itotosi pokiak'sĭnni: Ki pokiak'sĭnni oto'si, nitak'otŭmanistaiau ai'pokiakix, matom'omoipotokan makap'sŭpipumani, ki ĭs'ksipikan kŏk'ksĭetsĭnsĭssuaiau; ki ĭstŭp'omoipotokan napaiĕn'insĭmman nitapaiĕn'iokoai.
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:30 — Unnianĭst'sŭskĭsan mŏk'itotosi pokiak'sĭnni: Ki pokiak'sĭnni oto'si, nitak'otŭmanistaiau ai'pokiakix, matom'omoipotokan makap'sŭpipumani, ki ĭs'ksipikan kŏk'ksĭetsĭnsĭssuaiau; ki ĭstŭp'omoipotokan napaiĕn'insĭmman nitapaiĕn'iokoai.

text: Stsik'i parable an'ĭstsiuax, ki an'iu, Spots' im istsĭn'naiisĭnni netŭm'anĭstsiu mustard ĭstsĭn'sĭmman, annik' mat'sĭmŏk nĭnau, ki ai'sŭpipumau otsĭn'sĭmman;
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:31 — Stsik'i parable an'ĭstsiuax, ki an'iu, Spots' im istsĭn'naiisĭnni netŭm'anĭstsiu mustard ĭstsĭn'sĭmman, annik' mat'sĭmŏk nĭnau, ki ai'sŭpipumau otsĭn'sĭmman;

text: Itsĭs'tŭpskaiinŭkotsiuaie kŏnai'ĭnsĭmmanĭsts; ki sŭs'kiĭssi, itsĭs'tŭpomŭkkuiau insĭm'mansts, ki itsĭs'tsĭsasiu, ki paiu'tax itotoiau ki itoko'attomiax ĭsto'kŭniksĭsts.
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:32 — Itsĭs'tŭpskaiinŭkotsiuaie kŏnai'ĭnsĭmmanĭsts; ki sŭs'kiĭssi, itsĭs'tŭpomŭkkuiau insĭm'mansts, ki itsĭs'tsĭsasiu, ki paiu'tax itotoiau ki itoko'attomiax ĭsto'kŭniksĭsts.

text: Stsik'i parable an'ĭstsiuax; Spots' im ĭstsĭn'naiisĭnni nitŭm'anĭstsin itai'kopŭtstaupi, annik' mat'sĭmŏk ake'u, ki kaias'attom niuks' kŭmi omŭk'okosix, napaiĕn itui'tsiau, ki ikŏnai'kopŭtstopiau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:33 — Stsik'i parable an'ĭstsiuax; Spots' im ĭstsĭn'naiisĭnni nitŭm'anĭstsin itai'kopŭtstaupi, annik' mat'sĭmŏk ake'u, ki kaias'attom niuks' kŭmi omŭk'okosix, napaiĕn itui'tsiau, ki ikŏnai'kopŭtstopiau.

text: Am'ostsk Jesus ikŏnai'sĭtsĭpsattsiuăsts matap'pix parables itai'sĭtsĭpsattsiu; ki sauomai'sĭtsĭpsĭssi parable matomaisĭtsipsatsiuatsax:
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:34 — Am'ostsk Jesus ikŏnai'sĭtsĭpsattsiuăsts matap'pix parables itai'sĭtsĭpsattsiu; ki sauomai'sĭtsĭpsĭssi parable matomaisĭtsipsatsiuatsax:

text: Mŏksenŭp'anĭstossi Prophet otanipi, ki an'iu, nimutaksipa'kuiaki parables; nitakse'poattopiau annists'isk kai'sattop'istsk ksŏk'kumă sauomap'ăstotoawsi.
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:35 — Mŏksenŭp'anĭstossi Prophet otanipi, ki an'iu, nimutaksipa'kuiaki parables; nitakse'poattopiau annists'isk kai'sattop'istsk ksŏk'kumă sauomap'ăstotoawsi.

text: Ki Jesus aiĭs'tŭpskuyiuax matap'pix, ki itsit'sipim nap'ioyis: ki otŭsksĭnĭmats ax otsitota'akax, ki an'iau noksksĭnĭm'atsokĭnan parable makap'itaisŭppipumaupi ĭnsĭm'man.
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:36 — Ki Jesus aiĭs'tŭpskuyiuax matap'pix, ki itsit'sipim nap'ioyis: ki otŭsksĭnĭmats ax otsitota'akax, ki an'iau noksksĭnĭm'atsokĭnan parable makap'itaisŭppipumaupi ĭnsĭm'man.

text: Nokŭt'anĭstsiuax, Annŏk' itai'sŭpipumauŏk ŏkh'si ĭnsĭmmani Nĭn'au okku'yi am'ĭni;
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:37 — Nokŭt'anĭstsiuax, Annŏk' itai'sŭpipumauŏk ŏkh'si ĭnsĭmmani Nĭn'au okku'yi am'ĭni;

text: Insĭm'man konai'tappiua; ŏkh'si ĭnsĭmmani, nĭn'naiisĭnni ĭsto'kos'ix; ki makap'iĭnsĭmmani, Sauum'itsitappiuă o'kosix;
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:38 — Insĭm'man konai'tappiua; ŏkh'si ĭnsĭmmani, nĭn'naiisĭnni ĭsto'kos'ix; ki makap'iĭnsĭmmani, Sauum'itsitappiuă o'kosix;

text: Katum'a annŏk' ai'sŭppipumattomĕsts, Sauum'itsitappiuă itamiu; pokiak'sĭnni ksŏkkum aiksiuo'si; ki aipo'kiakix, atsĭm'otokatatsĭsau,
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:39 — Katum'a annŏk' ai'sŭppipumattomĕsts, Sauum'itsitappiuă itamiu; pokiak'sĭnni ksŏkkum aiksiuo'si; ki aipo'kiakix, atsĭm'otokatatsĭsau,

text: Manĭsts'aumoipitŭkkipiau makap'ĭnsĭmmanĭsts ki manĭstse'tsĭnĭtspiau; ak'ŭnĭststsiu aiksiuo'si annom' ksŏk'kum.
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:40 — Manĭsts'aumoipitŭkkipiau makap'ĭnsĭmmanĭsts ki manĭstse'tsĭnĭtspiau; ak'ŭnĭststsiu aiksiuo'si annom' ksŏk'kum.

text: Nĭn'au okku'i aks'ĭstŭpskuyiuax otatsĭm'otokatatsix, ki ak'omoipotsĭmiauĕsts ikŏnau'kapiĭsts ki anniks'isk matap'pixk, sauum'itsitappiiau ak'omoipotoyiuax;
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:41 — Nĭn'au okku'i aks'ĭstŭpskuyiuax otatsĭm'otokatatsix, ki ak'omoipotsĭmiauĕsts ikŏnau'kapiĭsts ki anniks'isk matap'pixk, sauum'itsitappiiau ak'omoipotoyiuax;

text: Ki akitsĭpst'apiksĭstsiauax omŭx'tsi; annim' ak'itstsiau a sain'sĭnni, ki satse'kĭnani.
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:42 — Ki akitsĭpst'apiksĭstsiauax omŭx'tsi; annim' ak'itstsiau a sain'sĭnni, ki satse'kĭnani.

text: Mokŏm'otsitappix akotŭmĭk'kŭnasuyeiau, manistsĭk'kŭnasuyipi nato' si, un'oauai otsĭn'naiisĭnni, akotsĭk' kŭnasuyiauaie. Annŏk' itokh'iuŏk ŭnanistokh'tsĭms.
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:43 — Mokŏm'otsitappix akotŭmĭk'kŭnasuyeiau, manistsĭk'kŭnasuyipi nato' si, un'oauai otsĭn'naiisĭnni, akotsĭk' kŭnasuyiauaie. Annŏk' itokh'iuŏk ŭnanistokh'tsĭms.

text: Stsĭki, Spots'im istsĭn'naiisĭnni nitŭm'anĭstsiu treasure kaias'attomaie insĭm'man; kon'ĭssi nĭn'au, mat'aiksasattomaie, kĭ otsetam'etŭksĭnni itsĭs'tapu ki ipum'attopiĕsts otokŏnai'nanĭsts, ki ipum'attomaie annik' ĭnsĭm'manĭk.
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:44 — Stsĭki, Spots'im istsĭn'naiisĭnni nitŭm'anĭstsiu treasure kaias'attomaie insĭm'man; kon'ĭssi nĭn'au, mat'aiksasattomaie, kĭ otsetam'etŭksĭnni itsĭs'tapu ki ipum'attopiĕsts otokŏnai'nanĭsts, ki ipum'attomaie annik' ĭnsĭm'manĭk.

text: Stsik'i, Spotsim ĭstsĭn'naiisĭnni nitŭm'anĭstsiu awkh'pumapiekuŭn otap'sŭmmŏssi ŏkh'six pearls:
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:45 — Stsik'i, Spotsim ĭstsĭn'naiisĭnni nitŭm'anĭstsiu awkh'pumapiekuŭn otap'sŭmmŏssi ŏkh'six pearls:

text: Kon'ĭssi tuks'kŭmi pearl akai'ĭxkĭmasiu, itsĭs'tapu, ki ipum'attopiĕsts otokŏnai'nanĭsts ki ipum'attau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:46 — Kon'ĭssi tuks'kŭmi pearl akai'ĭxkĭmasiu, itsĭs'tapu, ki ipum'attopiĕsts otokŏnai'nanĭsts ki ipum'attau.

text: Stsĭk'i, spots' im ĭstsĭn'naiisinni nitŭm'aniststsiu itau'mikaupi, annŏk itsuia'pĭxĭmŏkaie omŭk'sikĭmi, ki itomian'ĭstomoipitŭkkiu:
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:47 — Stsĭk'i, spots' im ĭstsĭn'naiisinni nitŭm'aniststsiu itau'mikaupi, annŏk itsuia'pĭxĭmŏkaie omŭk'sikĭmi, ki itomian'ĭstomoipitŭkkiu:

text: Itui'tsĭssaie, itopĭts'ŭsskŏpattomiauaie ĭssoots'i, ki ito'piiau, ki ŏkh'six itaisŭppitsi'iau ĭskix; ki makaps'ix istsĭs'tapiksĭstsiiau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:48 — Itui'tsĭssaie, itopĭts'ŭsskŏpattomiauaie ĭssoots'i, ki ito'piiau, ki ŏkh'six itaisŭppitsi'iau ĭskix; ki makaps'ix istsĭs'tapiksĭstsiiau.

text: Ak'otŭmanĭstsiu aiksiuos'i ksŏk'kum: atsĭm'otokatatsix ak'sipuksŭpsŭxiau, ki akai'aketaipiksĭstsiiau Sauum'itsitappix ki mokŏm'otsitappix;
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:49 — Ak'otŭmanĭstsiu aiksiuos'i ksŏk'kum: atsĭm'otokatatsix ak'sipuksŭpsŭxiau, ki akai'aketaipiksĭstsiiau Sauum'itsitappix ki mokŏm'otsitappix;

text: Ki akitsipst'apiksĭstsiiau (sauum'itsitappix) omŭx'tsii; annim' ak'itstsiau a saĭn'sĭnni ki satse'kĭnani.
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:50 — Ki akitsipst'apiksĭstsiiau (sauum'itsitappix) omŭx'tsii; annim' ak'itstsiau a saĭn'sĭnni ki satse'kĭnani.

text: Jesus an'ĭstsiuax kikai'okhtsĭmipuauastsau annists'isk? An'ĭstsiauaie, A, nĭn'an.
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:51 — Jesus an'ĭstsiuax kikai'okhtsĭmipuauastsau annists'isk? An'ĭstsiauaie, A, nĭn'an.

text: Itŭm' anĭstsiuax Annŏk' ai'sĭnakiuŏk ŭsksĭnĭmats'au spots'im istsĭn'naiisĭnni, nitŭm'aniststsiu nĭn'au, iko'yiuŏk, sauauts'ĭmĕsts treasure manists' ki ŭk'aisĭsts.
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:52 — Itŭm' anĭstsiuax Annŏk' ai'sĭnakiuŏk ŭsksĭnĭmats'au spots'im istsĭn'naiisĭnni, nitŭm'aniststsiu nĭn'au, iko'yiuŏk, sauauts'ĭmĕsts treasure manists' ki ŭk'aisĭsts.

text: Ki itŭnĭsts'tsiu, Jesus otaiksiu'attosĕsts annĭsts'isk parables, itsĭstŭpa'atomaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:53 — Ki itŭnĭsts'tsiu, Jesus otaiksiu'attosĕsts annĭsts'isk parables, itsĭstŭpa'atomaie.

text: Ki otsito'tosi otau'ŭtauŏsĭni otat'oiapioyimoai itsipst'ŭsksĭnĭmatsiuax, ki ek'skaietŭkkiau, ki, an'iau, Tse'ma itotsĭm'atsĕsts am'ok mokŏk'sĭnik, ki am'ostsk ot'omŭkapĭstutŭksists?
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:54 — Ki otsito'tosi otau'ŭtauŏsĭni otat'oiapioyimoai itsipst'ŭsksĭnĭmatsiuax, ki ek'skaietŭkkiau, ki, an'iau, Tse'ma itotsĭm'atsĕsts am'ok mokŏk'sĭnik, ki am'ostsk ot'omŭkapĭstutŭksists?

text: Kŭttomai'sauamiu'ats ai'satsakiuă okku'i? Kŭttomaisauainikŏttsiu'ats Oksĭstsi, Mary? Ki omu'pappiipix kŭttomaisauainikŏttsiu'atsax James, ki Joses, ki Simon, ki Judas?
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:55 — Kŭttomai'sauamiu'ats ai'satsakiuă okku'i? Kŭttomaisauainikŏttsiu'ats Oksĭstsi, Mary? Ki omu'pappiipix kŭttomaisauainikŏttsiu'atsax James, ki Joses, ki Simon, ki Judas?

text: Ki ot'akemix okŭttomaisaiiokŏnopokomok'atsax? Am'o Nĭn'au, Tse'ma itotsĭm'atsĕsts annists'ĭsk?
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:56 — Ki ot'akemix okŭttomaisaiiokŏnopokomok'atsax? Am'o Nĭn'au, Tse'ma itotsĭm'atsĕsts annists'ĭsk?

text: Ki itś'tsskĭmskŭkiax osto'i. Ki Jesus an'ĭstsiuax, prophet itŭs'tsakŏttau, sauomai'tapposiĕsts otau'ŏsĭni ki otauŭt'okoai.
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:57 — Ki itś'tsskĭmskŭkiax osto'i. Ki Jesus an'ĭstsiuax, prophet itŭs'tsakŏttau, sauomai'tapposiĕsts otau'ŏsĭni ki otauŭt'okoai.

text: Otsauomai'tuksuai ŭn'nikaie itsauomapĭstutŭkkiu annim' akatio'yiĕsts ŭkkŭk'umapotŭksĭsts.
text_for_embed: Matthew 13:58 — Otsauomai'tuksuai ŭn'nikaie itsauomapĭstutŭkkiu annim' akatio'yiĕsts ŭkkŭk'umapotŭksĭsts.

text: ANNIK' Herod tetrarch okhtsĭm'attomĕsts Jesus otap'ĭstutsipists,
text_for_embed: Matthew 14:1 — ANNIK' Herod tetrarch okhtsĭm'attomĕsts Jesus otap'ĭstutsipists,

text: Ki an'ĭstsiuax otap'otomokix am'omauk John Baptist; enio'sĭnni mat'sipuau; ŭn'nikaie ŭkkŭk'umapotŭksists itap'ĭtutsimĕsts.
text_for_embed: Matthew 14:2 — Ki an'ĭstsiuax otap'otomokix am'omauk John Baptist; enio'sĭnni mat'sipuau; ŭn'nikaie ŭkkŭk'umapotŭksists itap'ĭtutsimĕsts.

text: Herod ŭkai'eĕniuaie John, ki aiĭs'ksipĭstsiuaie, ki itsok'iuaie osto'iaie Herodias, us Philip otokeman'ĭnaai.
text_for_embed: Matthew 14:3 — Herod ŭkai'eĕniuaie John, ki aiĭs'ksipĭstsiuaie, ki itsok'iuaie osto'iaie Herodias, us Philip otokeman'ĭnaai.

text: Tŭk'ka John an'ĭstsiuaie matŏkhsiu'ats kŏk'otoŏssi.
text_for_embed: Matthew 14:4 — Tŭk'ka John an'ĭstsiuaie matŏkhsiu'ats kŏk'otoŏssi.

text: Ki otai'aksenitossaie, stun'nuyiuax matap' pix, tŭk'ka ĭsksĭnnu'yiuaxauaie prophet.
text_for_embed: Matthew 14:5 — Ki otai'aksenitossaie, stun'nuyiuax matap' pix, tŭk'ka ĭsksĭnnu'yiuaxauaie prophet.

text: Ki otai'totstsĭssi Herod otsit'sipokaiipi, Herodias otŭn'ni itŭt'sikipiu, ki itsŭp'ĭstutuyiuaie Herod.
text_for_embed: Matthew 14:6 — Ki otai'totstsĭssi Herod otsit'sipokaiipi, Herodias otŭn'ni itŭt'sikipiu, ki itsŭp'ĭstutuyiuaie Herod.

text: Itsiksĭs'toatsiuaie atoŭn'ĭssĭnni mŏk'ittokotossaie otan'ĭstopiaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 14:7 — Itsiksĭs'toatsiuaie atoŭn'ĭssĭnni mŏk'ittokotossaie otan'ĭstopiaie.

text: Ki oksĭs'tsi otsĭs'tok, ki an'iu, John Baptist otokŏn' ĭstsŭp'potoat omŭk'okos ki annom' ĭstoko'kit.
text_for_embed: Matthew 14:8 — Ki oksĭs'tsi otsĭs'tok, ki an'iu, John Baptist otokŏn' ĭstsŭp'potoat omŭk'okos ki annom' ĭstoko'kit.

text: Ki omŭx'ina itsĭk'oketŭkkiu: ki otŭtoanĭs'si ki otopokau'yemix, ŭn'nikaie itani'u mŏk'okotŏsaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 14:9 — Ki omŭx'ina itsĭk'oketŭkkiu: ki otŭtoanĭs'si ki otopokau'yemix, ŭn'nikaie itani'u mŏk'okotŏsaie.

text: Ki itŭp'skŏkiu, ki itsi'kawkokĭtsiauaie John itsĭpsts'okiawpiaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 14:10 — Ki itŭp'skŏkiu, ki itsi'kawkokĭtsiauaie John itsĭpsts'okiawpiaie.

text: Ki otokŏn'itsipuk'sipĭppotopaie, omŭk'okos itsŭp'potopaie, ki ikotauai'e ake'kuŭn: ki ito'tsĭppotuyiuaie oksĭs'tsi.
text_for_embed: Matthew 14:11 — Ki otokŏn'itsipuk'sipĭppotopaie, omŭk'okos itsŭp'potopaie, ki ikotauai'e ake'kuŭn: ki ito'tsĭppotuyiuaie oksĭs'tsi.

text: Ki otŭs'ksĭnĭmatsax itoto'iau ki mat'sĭmiau mostŭm' i, ki ai'akotomiau, ki i'tappoiau ki itŭnĭs'tsiiau Jesus.
text_for_embed: Matthew 14:12 — Ki otŭs'ksĭnĭmatsax itoto'iau ki mat'sĭmiau mostŭm' i, ki ai'akotomiau, ki i'tappoiau ki itŭnĭs'tsiiau Jesus.

text: Jesus otokh'tsĭmsi, itsĭs'tŭpaatomaie akli'iosatsĭs itsui'akhiosiu, ki ksĭs'tapsksŏkkum itŭpanĭstappo'aie: ki matap'pix otokh'tsĭsau itsiksiuopokiuo'iauaie, otakap'ioyimoauĕsts sŭx'iau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 14:13 — Jesus otokh'tsĭmsi, itsĭs'tŭpaatomaie akli'iosatsĭs itsui'akhiosiu, ki ksĭs'tapsksŏkkum itŭpanĭstappo'aie: ki matap'pix otokh'tsĭsau itsiksiuopokiuo'iauaie, otakap'ioyimoauĕsts sŭx'iau.

text: Ki Jesus itopĭtsĭssa'atomaie, ki nan'nuyiuax akai'tappix, ki kaiĭm'iuax, ki ikut'tutuyiuax otai'oktokosimoauax.
text_for_embed: Matthew 14:14 — Ki Jesus itopĭtsĭssa'atomaie, ki nan'nuyiuax akai'tappix, ki kaiĭm'iuax, ki ikut'tutuyiuax otai'oktokosimoauax.

text: Ki otai'ĭstŭkkŏpsi, otŭs'ksĭnĭmatsax otsitota'akax, ki an'ĭstsiauaie, annom' ksĭs'tapsksŏkkumasiu, ki au'mŭtŭputŭkku; o'tappiisĭnna ŭnnĭstŭps'skos, mŏk'ittapposi akap'ioyĭsts, mŏk'opumattosi aau'ŏsĭn.
text_for_embed: Matthew 14:15 — Ki otai'ĭstŭkkŏpsi, otŭs'ksĭnĭmatsax otsitota'akax, ki an'ĭstsiauaie, annom' ksĭs'tapsksŏkkumasiu, ki au'mŭtŭputŭkku; o'tappiisĭnna ŭnnĭstŭps'skos, mŏk'ittapposi akap'ioyĭsts, mŏk'opumattosi aau'ŏsĭn.

text: Ki Jesus an'ĭstsiuax, matokuiĭstapu'iauats; kotok' mŏks'auattopiau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 14:16 — Ki Jesus an'ĭstsiuax, matokuiĭstapu'iauats; kotok' mŏks'auattopiau.

text: Ki an'ĭstsiauaie, annom' nitsinan'anĭsts nĭsittu'yi ke'tanĭsts ki na'tokŭmi mammix'.
text_for_embed: Matthew 14:17 — Ki an'ĭstsiauaie, annom' nitsinan'anĭsts nĭsittu'yi ke'tanĭsts ki na'tokŭmi mammix'.

text: An'iu, puk'sipĭppotokikau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 14:18 — An'iu, puk'sipĭppotokikau.

text: Ki an'ĭstsiuax kŏnai'tappix mŏk'opasax mattu'yikui; ki mat'sĭmĕsts nĭsittu'yĭsts ke'tanĭsts ki na'tokŭmi mam mix', ki, otspisŭp'si itatsĭm'etsĭmĕsts, ki itau'minotsimĕsts; ki ikotsiu'ax otŭs'ksĭnĭmatsax ke'tanists, ki otŭs'ksĭnĭmatsax ikotsiu'ăsts o'tappiisĭnna.
text_for_embed: Matthew 14:19 — Ki an'ĭstsiuax kŏnai'tappix mŏk'opasax mattu'yikui; ki mat'sĭmĕsts nĭsittu'yĭsts ke'tanĭsts ki na'tokŭmi mam mix', ki, otspisŭp'si itatsĭm'etsĭmĕsts, ki itau'minotsimĕsts; ki ikotsiu'ax otŭs'ksĭnĭmatsax ke'tanists, ki otŭs'ksĭnĭmatsax ikotsiu'ăsts o'tappiisĭnna.

text: Ki ikŏnau'yiau, ki itoku'yiau: ki mat'sĭmĕsts iau pi'nikĕsts itstsi'ĭsts na'tsikoputtuyi ĭsksĭmmatŭk'iĭssokaiĭsts.
text_for_embed: Matthew 14:20 — Ki ikŏnau'yiau, ki itoku'yiau: ki mat'sĭmĕsts iau pi'nikĕsts itstsi'ĭsts na'tsikoputtuyi ĭsksĭmmatŭk'iĭssokaiĭsts.

text: Ki aiiniks'ĭsk au'yixk nĭsitsi' omŭk'sikepĭppix nĭn'ax, ki akex, ki pokax'.
text_for_embed: Matthew 14:21 — Ki aiiniks'ĭsk au'yixk nĭsitsi' omŭk'sikepĭppix nĭn'ax, ki akex, ki pokax'.

text: Ki Jesus eikak'imatsiuax otŭs'ksĭnĭnatsax mŏkĭt'sŭppopĭsax akh'iosatsĭs, mŏkotom'apŭmmosax, otsakiaiĭs'tŭpskoŏsaie tappiisĭn'na.
text_for_embed: Matthew 14:22 — Ki Jesus eikak'imatsiuax otŭs'ksĭnĭnatsax mŏkĭt'sŭppopĭsax akh'iosatsĭs, mŏkotom'apŭmmosax, otsakiaiĭs'tŭpskoŏsaie tappiisĭn'na.

text: Ki otsĭs'tŭpskoŏsax otappiisĭn'nă, itsitamĭsso' nitum'mo mŏkatsimoiikasi; ki otau'tŭkkussi itsĭttau'piu.
text_for_embed: Matthew 14:23 — Ki otsĭs'tŭpskoŏsax otappiisĭn'nă, itsitamĭsso' nitum'mo mŏkatsimoiikasi; ki otau'tŭkkussi itsĭttau'piu.

text: Ki akli'iosatsĭs ai'itŭtsikioo, ki ipawkh'paikimskawp: tŭk'ka, umut'totsŭppopi.
text_for_embed: Matthew 14:24 — Ki akli'iosatsĭs ai'itŭtsikioo, ki ipawkh'paikimskawp: tŭk'ka, umut'totsŭppopi.

text: Ki nĭssoo'yi ĭskska'tŭksĭnni koku'yi Jesus itsitappo'ax, omŭk'sikĭmi itokh'itauauŏkau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 14:25 — Ki nĭssoo'yi ĭskska'tŭksĭnni koku'yi Jesus itsitappo'ax, omŭk'sikĭmi itokh'itauauŏkau.

text: Ki otŭs'ksĭnimatsax otsĭnno'ossauaie umuttokhitauau'okani omŭk'sikimi, ap'aitsitaiau, ki an'iau, Sta'awina; ki oko'pusuai itokum'iau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 14:26 — Ki otŭs'ksĭnimatsax otsĭnno'ossauaie umuttokhitauau'okani omŭk'sikimi, ap'aitsitaiau, ki an'iau, Sta'awina; ki oko'pusuai itokum'iau.

text: Ki Jesus kaiĭp'sĭtsĭpsatsiuax, ki an'iu, Ŏkh'sitŭkkik; nitam'i; Piniko'puk.
text_for_embed: Matthew 14:27 — Ki Jesus kaiĭp'sĭtsĭpsatsiuax, ki an'iu, Ŏkh'sitŭkkik; nitam'i; Piniko'puk.

text: Ki Peter nokŭt'anĭstsiuaie, Nin'a kŭm'ămieniki ani'kit ksĕsto'a nŏk'itotosi nŏk'itsitŭpauauŏkasi omŭk'sikĭmi.
text_for_embed: Matthew 14:28 — Ki Peter nokŭt'anĭstsiuaie, Nin'a kŭm'ămieniki ani'kit ksĕsto'a nŏk'itotosi nŏk'itsitŭpauauŏkasi omŭk'sikĭmi.

text: Ki an'iu, Puk'siput. Ki Peter otĭnnĭsa'atossi akh'iosatsis, itokh'itauauŏkau omŭk'sikĭmi mŏk'ittapposi Jesus.
text_for_embed: Matthew 14:29 — Ki an'iu, Puk'siput. Ki Peter otĭnnĭsa'atossi akh'iosatsis, itokh'itauauŏkau omŭk'sikĭmi mŏk'ittapposi Jesus.

text: Ki otsĭnĭs'si eik'sopuyi, itsiko'pum: ki otaumutŭp'sŭppopiisi omŭk'sikĭmi ita'sainiepuyiu, ki au'aniu Nin'a, Kŏmotse'piokit.
text_for_embed: Matthew 14:30 — Ki otsĭnĭs'si eik'sopuyi, itsiko'pum: ki otaumutŭp'sŭppopiisi omŭk'sikĭmi ita'sainiepuyiu, ki au'aniu Nin'a, Kŏmotse'piokit.

text: Ki Jesus itŭp'sauksikĭns'tsakiuaie ki itsĕn'iuaie, ki an'ĭstsiuaie, ksĕsto'a enŭkaumai'tŭkkiua, kumauk'saietŭkkiks?
text_for_embed: Matthew 14:31 — Ki Jesus itŭp'sauksikĭns'tsakiuaie ki itsĕn'iuaie, ki an'ĭstsiuaie, ksĕsto'a enŭkaumai'tŭkkiua, kumauk'saietŭkkiks?

text: Otsito'tosau akh'iosatsis, itsiksĭst'sopu.
text_for_embed: Matthew 14:32 — Otsito'tosau akh'iosatsis, itsiksĭst'sopu.

text: Anniks'isk itsŭp'popixk akh'iosatsĭs itoto'iauaie ki atsĭmmĭm'miauaie ki an'iaiu, E'mŭmi kitam'i Ap'istotok'iuă okku'i.
text_for_embed: Matthew 14:33 — Anniks'isk itsŭp'popixk akh'iosatsĭs itoto'iauaie ki atsĭmmĭm'miauaie ki an'iaiu, E'mŭmi kitam'i Ap'istotok'iuă okku'i.

text: Ki otau'pŭmmossau, itoto'iau Gennesaret ĭstau'ŏssĭni.
text_for_embed: Matthew 14:34 — Ki otau'pŭmmossau, itoto'iau Gennesaret ĭstau'ŏssĭni.

text: Ki annim' ĭstsĭn'ax, ots'ksĭnuoŏssau, itŭp'skŭkiau kŏnŭs'ksŏkkum sa'akapotsi, ki itotsĭp'iauaie ikŏnai'oktokosix:
text_for_embed: Matthew 14:35 — Ki annim' ĭstsĭn'ax, ots'ksĭnuoŏssau, itŭp'skŭkiau kŏnŭs'ksŏkkum sa'akapotsi, ki itotsĭp'iauaie ikŏnai'oktokosix:

text: Ki kitai'akokoto spots' im istsĭn'naiisĭnni itotai'kauaipixĭxtŭkiopi; ksŏk'kum kitai'akomianĭstomopipi, spots'im ak'itomopipo; ksŏk' kum kitai'akomianĭstapotsippi spots'im ak'itapotsip.

text: Itŭmanĭstsiuax otŭsksĭnĭmats'ax Iststsi'ki matap'pi makopokiuo'ŏssi nĕsto'a, ŭnnianĭst'auŭtsikĭmatsĭstotos, ki ŭnnianĭstto'tsĭs otauai'staksĭnni, ki ŭnnianĭstopokiuos nĕsto'a.

text: Annŏk'aiakitsikŏmotsepiosiuok opai'tappiisĭnni, akatstomaie': ki annŏk' itai'akatstomŏk opai'tappiisĭnni, nĕstoi umutak'atstomaie, ai'akokonimaie.

text: Kit au'mŭnĭstopuau stsik'ix annom' itai'puyiau, mataksattotsĭm'axau eĭno'sĭnni otsauomai'noŏsau nĭn'au okku'i otsĭn'aipuksipusi mŏks'ĭnaiisi.
