text_for_embed: Matthew 18:5 — Ki annŏk' ak'autuyiuŏk tuks'kai inŭk'sipokaiĭstotosiĭsk, nĕsto'i nitau'tok.

text: Ki annŏk'ĭstsskĭm'skŭkiats'iuŏk tuks'kŭmi anniks'ĭsk inŭk'sipokaxk nitau'maitokixk, ŏkh'siu pikiak'iokotoki kĭn'attossaie, ki inets'ĭssi omŭk'sikĭmi.
text_for_embed: Matthew 18:6 — Ki annŏk'ĭstsskĭm'skŭkiats'iuŏk tuks'kŭmi anniks'ĭsk inŭk'sipokaxk nitau'maitokixk, ŏkh'siu pikiak'iokotoki kĭn'attossaie, ki inets'ĭssi omŭk'sikĭmi.

text: Istsskĭm'skŭksĭnni it'okapiu ksŏkkum, Istsskĭm'skŭksĭsts ak'itotoiau; ki annŏk' nĭn'auŏk paiuk'sipĭppotomŏk ĭstsskĭm'skŭksĭnni, aks'ksĭnĭmaie maka'pi!
text_for_embed: Matthew 18:7 — Istsskĭm'skŭksĭnni it'okapiu ksŏkkum, Istsskĭm'skŭksĭsts ak'itotoiau; ki annŏk' nĭn'auŏk paiuk'sipĭppotomŏk ĭstsskĭm'skŭksĭnni, aks'ksĭnĭmaie maka'pi!

text: Ŭn'nikaie kotsĭs' ki kokŏt'si ĭstsskĭmskŭkiats'otsenikiau, kŏksĭnit'au, ki mĭs'tŭpapiksĭstaiau: itŏkh'siu kŏk'kitsipĭssi opai' tappiisĭnni kŏks'ĭstsekaiisi ki kŏk'opokŏksi, kŏkstaitŭp'apixĭkŏsi kŭttaiaiapunstsiuasi ki kitai'akokŏtsĭsts ki kitai'akŏtsĭsts.
text_for_embed: Matthew 18:8 — Ŭn'nikaie kotsĭs' ki kokŏt'si ĭstsskĭmskŭkiats'otsenikiau, kŏksĭnit'au, ki mĭs'tŭpapiksĭstaiau: itŏkh'siu kŏk'kitsipĭssi opai' tappiisĭnni kŏks'ĭstsekaiisi ki kŏk'opokŏksi, kŏkstaitŭp'apixĭkŏsi kŭttaiaiapunstsiuasi ki kitai'akokŏtsĭsts ki kitai'akŏtsĭsts.

text: Ki koŏps'pi ĭstsskĭm'skŭkiatsotseniki, sauau'tos, ki mĭs'tŭpapiksĭstsĭs: itŏkh'siu kŏk'kitsipĭssi opai'tappiisĭnni tuks'kŭm moŏps'pa; kŏkstaitŭp'apixĭkosi kŭt'taiaiapunstsiuasii, ki kitaiakoŏpspix.
text_for_embed: Matthew 18:9 — Ki koŏps'pi ĭstsskĭm'skŭkiatsotseniki, sauau'tos, ki mĭs'tŭpapiksĭstsĭs: itŏkh'siu kŏk'kitsipĭssi opai'tappiisĭnni tuks'kŭm moŏps'pa; kŏkstaitŭp'apixĭkosi kŭt'taiaiapunstsiuasii, ki kitaiakoŏpspix.

text: Mokŏk'ik kŏk'stauksĭstotoawsi tuks'kumă am'oksk inŭks'tsĭmix: kitan'ĭstopuau spots'im oto'tokatatsuauax ŭsks'skatsĭmiau Nin'a ostoksĭs'aie spotsim otsitau'pipi
text_for_embed: Matthew 18:10 — Mokŏk'ik kŏk'stauksĭstotoawsi tuks'kumă am'oksk inŭks'tsĭmix: kitan'ĭstopuau spots'im oto'tokatatsuauax ŭsks'skatsĭmiau Nin'a ostoksĭs'aie spotsim otsitau'pipi

text: Nĭn'au okkui ito'to mŏkitsikŏmotse'piŏsaie annŏk' at'stauŏk.
text_for_embed: Matthew 18:11 — Nĭn'au okkui ito'to mŏkitsikŏmotse'piŏsaie annŏk' at'stauŏk.

text: Tsa kitŭs'tapuau? Nin'an minan'attŭssi kepĭp'pi emŭk'ikĭnax ki tuks'kŭmi itŭnĭs'tapu, kŭttomisauŭsskĭtsĭmiu'axau piksĭp'pi piksi'koputsi, ki kŭttomisauaitappo'ats netum'moĭsts, ki kŭttomisauapsŭmmiuats annŏk' nittŭppu'ŏk?
text_for_embed: Matthew 18:12 — Tsa kitŭs'tapuau? Nin'an minan'attŭssi kepĭp'pi emŭk'ikĭnax ki tuks'kŭmi itŭnĭs'tapu, kŭttomisauŭsskĭtsĭmiu'axau piksĭp'pi piksi'koputsi, ki kŭttomisauaitappo'ats netum'moĭsts, ki kŭttomisauapsŭmmiuats annŏk' nittŭppu'ŏk?

text: Ki ikŭm'okonoŏssaie, kitau'mŭnĭstopuau manĭstse'tametŭkkipiax piksĭp'pi piksi'koputsi otsaiĭs'tapusax itsĭs'tŭpskaietametŭkkiu annŏk' ikon'ĭmauŏk.
text_for_embed: Matthew 18:13 — Ki ikŭm'okonoŏssaie, kitau'mŭnĭstopuau manĭstse'tametŭkkipiax piksĭp'pi piksi'koputsi otsaiĭs'tapusax itsĭs'tŭpskaietametŭkkiu annŏk' ikon'ĭmauŏk.

text: Neto'i omat'sitsitanats Kin'ă spots'im tuks'kŭmi anniks'isk inŭx'tsimixk mŏk'saiinakuaiĭssau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 18:14 — Neto'i omat'sitsitanats Kin'ă spots'im tuks'kŭmi anniks'isk inŭx'tsimixk mŏk'saiinakuaiĭssau.

text: Stsik'i, kumu'pappiipi sauo'kŏmotsĭstototseniki, matan'ĭstsĭs otsauo'kŏmotsitappiisĭnni, ksĕsto'a ki osto'i namĭs tsitappiik; okh'totseniki kitse'motsau kumu'pappiipi.
text_for_embed: Matthew 18:15 — Stsik'i, kumu'pappiipi sauo'kŏmotsĭstototseniki, matan'ĭstsĭs otsauo'kŏmotsitappiisĭnni, ksĕsto'a ki osto'i namĭs tsitappiik; okh'totseniki kitse'motsau kumu'pappiipi.

text: Ki saiiokh'totseniki, tuks'kŭm tsŏktau na'tokumix pokitappomĭsau, kŏnai'poawsĭsts mŏks'eikosau, otokh'tsĭsau natsitappix, tsoktau nioks'kaitappix.
text_for_embed: Matthew 18:16 — Ki saiiokh'totseniki, tuks'kŭm tsŏktau na'tokumix pokitappomĭsau, kŏnai'poawsĭsts mŏks'eikosau, otokh'tsĭsau natsitappix, tsoktau nioks'kaitappix.

text: Ki sauokli'toŭsax, anĭstsĭs'church: ki sauŏkh'tsĭssi church, ŭnnianists'is sai'etŭkkiuă ki publican.
text_for_embed: Matthew 18:17 — Ki sauokli'toŭsax, anĭstsĭs'church: ki sauŏkh'tsĭssi church, ŭnnianists'is sai'etŭkkiuă ki publican.

text: Kitau'mŭnĭstopuau, kitsit'aiipipi ksŏk'kum, akitaiipip spots'im: ki kitsitapotsippi ksŏkkum, akŭtsitapotsip spots'im.
text_for_embed: Matthew 18:18 — Kitau'mŭnĭstopuau, kitsit'aiipipi ksŏk'kum, akitaiipip spots'im: ki kitsitapotsippi ksŏkkum, akŭtsitapotsip spots'im.

text: Kimat'anĭstopuau, netum'anistsitsitainoainiki kitak'aukŏmŏnisuai, Nin'a spots'im aks'ĭstutomoyiuaxaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 18:19 — Kimat'anĭstopuau, netum'anistsitsitainoainiki kitak'aukŏmŏnisuai, Nin'a spots'im aks'ĭstutomoyiuaxaie.

text: Natokŭmi tsoktau nioks'kŭmi nitsĭn'ikŏsim itsitomo'oaupi nĭt'sitaitŭtsikiaupi.
text_for_embed: Matthew 18:20 — Natokŭmi tsoktau nioks'kŭmi nitsĭn'ikŏsim itsitomo'oaupi nĭt'sitaitŭtsikiaupi.

text: Peter itŭmitotoaie, ki an'ĭstsiuaie, Tsanetso'awtau numu'pappiipa nŏksauumitsĭstu-tuyĭssi, ki nŏks'ksĭnnoŏssi? Akokitsikaiasts?
text_for_embed: Matthew 18:21 — Peter itŭmitotoaie, ki an'ĭstsiuaie, Tsanetso'awtau numu'pappiipa nŏksauumitsĭstu-tuyĭssi, ki nŏks'ksĭnnoŏssi? Akokitsikaiasts?

text: Jesus an'ĭstsiuaie, Kimatanĭstopa ikĭt'sikaiĕsts, ikitsikippuiĕsts ikit'sikaiĕsts.
text_for_embed: Matthew 18:22 — Jesus an'ĭstsiuaie, Kimatanĭstopa ikĭt'sikaiĕsts, ikitsikippuiĕsts ikit'sikaiĕsts.

text: Spots'im ĭstsĭn'naiisĭnni nitum'anĭstsiu omŭx'ĭna annŏk' ak'okŏkitsĭmaiauŏk otsitappim'ix.
text_for_embed: Matthew 18:23 — Spots'im ĭstsĭn'naiisĭnni nitum'anĭstsiu omŭx'ĭna annŏk' ak'okŏkitsĭmaiauŏk otsitappim'ix.

text: Ki otau'mŭtŭpŭkstŭkkisi tuks'kŭm ot'sittotsippotokaie, ke'pi omŭk'sikepĭppoyi mix'kĭmix otai'akokotopixaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 18:24 — Ki otau'mŭtŭpŭkstŭkkisi tuks'kŭm ot'sittotsippotokaie, ke'pi omŭk'sikepĭppoyi mix'kĭmix otai'akokotopixaie.

text: Otsai'itstsĭssi mŏkokotŏsai'e, Otsĭn'aim an'iĭnaie mŏk'apikosaie, ki otokem'an ki o'kosix ki otokŏnai'nanĭsts, ki mŏkotoku'yĭsax mĭx'kimix.
text_for_embed: Matthew 18:25 — Otsai'itstsĭssi mŏkokotŏsai'e, Otsĭn'aim an'iĭnaie mŏk'apikosaie, ki otokem'an ki o'kosix ki otokŏnai'nanĭsts, ki mŏkotoku'yĭsax mĭx'kimix.

text: Otsitappimi itopĭstuksĭsano'piĭnaie ki atsĭmmĭmmi'ĭnaie ki an'iĭnaie Nin'a, pinane'tŭkkit ki kitaksŭpanĭs'tsokoto.
text_for_embed: Matthew 18:26 — Otsitappimi itopĭstuksĭsano'piĭnaie ki atsĭmmĭmmi'ĭnaie ki an'iĭnaie Nin'a, pinane'tŭkkit ki kitaksŭpanĭs'tsokoto.

text: Ki annŏk' matap'piuŏk otsĭn'aim kaiĭm'iuaie ki paio'toyiuaie ki ŭnnim iks'ksĭnnuyiuaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 18:27 — Ki annŏk' matap'piuŏk otsĭn'aim kaiĭm'iuaie ki paio'toyiuaie ki ŭnnim iks'ksĭnnuyiuaie.

text: Ki neto'ŏk matap'piuŏk sŭx'iu, ki tukskŭm'i otopok'apotŭkkimix ikon'oyiuaie otai'akokok'isk kepĭp'pii a'pŭnasainix; ki een'iuaie, ki paiu'tsĭniuaie ki an'iu, Ponitat' kitai'akokokipix.
text_for_embed: Matthew 18:28 — Ki neto'ŏk matap'piuŏk sŭx'iu, ki tukskŭm'i otopok'apotŭkkimix ikon'oyiuaie otai'akokok'isk kepĭp'pii a'pŭnasainix; ki een'iuaie, ki paiu'tsĭniuaie ki an'iu, Ponitat' kitai'akokokipix.

text: Ki otopokapotŭkkim'i itoipĭstuksĭsanopiĭnaie, ki aukŏm'ŏnĭstsiuaie, ki an'iu, pinane'tŭkkit ki kitaksŭpanĭstsokoto.
text_for_embed: Matthew 18:29 — Ki otopokapotŭkkim'i itoipĭstuksĭsanopiĭnaie, ki aukŏm'ŏnĭstsiuaie, ki an'iu, pinane'tŭkkit ki kitaksŭpanĭstsokoto.

text: Ki matŏkhsitŭkkiu'ats; ki itappo' ki itsipsts'tapiksĭstsiuaie itai'okiakiopi, otsauomaisŭpanĭstsiponitasaie mŏkstaisŭksaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 18:30 — Ki matŏkhsitŭkkiu'ats; ki itappo' ki itsipsts'tapiksĭstsiuaie itai'okiakiopi, otsauomaisŭpanĭstsiponitasaie mŏkstaisŭksaie.

text: Otopok'apotŭkkimix otsĭnĭs'sax eks'kaĭkikĭnĕtŭkkiau, ki ito'toiau, ki otsĭn'aimoauai aiitsĭnikuyiauĕsts.
text_for_embed: Matthew 18:31 — Otopok'apotŭkkimix otsĭnĭs'sax eks'kaĭkikĭnĕtŭkkiau, ki ito'toiau, ki otsĭn'aimoauai aiitsĭnikuyiauĕsts.

text: Ki otsĭn'aim otsĭn'nikŏttossaie, an'ĭstsiuaie, Sauum'itapotŭkkiuă, kitai'akokokipix kitsĭn'omokitan'ikipi:
text_for_embed: Matthew 18:32 — Ki otsĭn'aim otsĭn'nikŏttossaie, an'ĭstsiuaie, Sauum'itapotŭkkiuă, kitai'akokokipix kitsĭn'omokitan'ikipi:

text: Kanĭs'tsikĭmopi kumauk'sauanistsikĭmaisks kitopokap'otŭkkimokă?
text_for_embed: Matthew 18:33 — Kanĭs'tsikĭmopi kumauk'sauanistsikĭmaisks kitopokap'otŭkkimokă?

text: Ki otsin'aim ĭstse'tŭkki'ĭnai, ki itsitŭpumŭts'kaiuaie pu'ĭnaitappix otsauomai'sŭppiponitassaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 18:34 — Ki otsin'aim ĭstse'tŭkki'ĭnai, ki itsitŭpumŭts'kaiuaie pu'ĭnaitappix otsauomai'sŭppiponitassaie.

text: Neto'i Nin'a spots'im kitak'anĭstotokoau saiisin'ĭminoainiki ku'sskĕtsipŏpuauĕsts kumut'aukĭmaupuai kumu'pappiipix.
text_for_embed: Matthew 18:35 — Neto'i Nin'a spots'im kitak'anĭstotokoau saiisin'ĭminoainiki ku'sskĕtsipŏpuauĕsts kumut'aukĭmaupuai kumu'pappiipix.

text: KI Jesus annists'isk epo'awsĭsts otaiksiu'attosĕsts Galilee itsĭstŭpa'atomaie. Ki Judæa istssoots'ists, Jordan mĭs'taputsim, itoto':
text_for_embed: Matthew 19:1 — KI Jesus annists'isk epo'awsĭsts otaiksiu'attosĕsts Galilee itsĭstŭpa'atomaie. Ki Judæa istssoots'ists, Jordan mĭs'taputsim, itoto':

text: Ki akai'tappix ipokiuo'iauaie; ki annim' ikut'totoyiuax.
text_for_embed: Matthew 19:2 — Ki akai'tappix ipokiuo'iauaie; ki annim' ikut'totoyiuax.

text: Pharisees itoto'iauaie, ki as'saksksĭnnuyiauaie ki an'ĭstsiauaie, ŏkhsiu'ats nĭn'au kŏnai' nŭkŭnĭstapĭsts mŏk'anĭstŭpskoŏsaie otokem'an?
text_for_embed: Matthew 19:3 — Pharisees itoto'iauaie, ki as'saksksĭnnuyiauaie ki an'ĭstsiauaie, ŏkhsiu'ats nĭn'au kŏnai' nŭkŭnĭstapĭsts mŏk'anĭstŭpskoŏsaie otokem'an?

text: Ki nokŭt'anĭstsiuax kikŭtanĭstop'ats sinak'sĭn, annŏk istsitsap'ĭstutuyiuŏkax ap'ĭstutuyiuax nĭn'au ki ake'u.
text_for_embed: Matthew 19:4 — Ki nokŭt'anĭstsiuax kikŭtanĭstop'ats sinak'sĭn, annŏk istsitsap'ĭstutuyiuŏkax ap'ĭstutuyiuax nĭn'au ki ake'u.

text: Ŭn'nikaie nĭn'au itai'akskitsiu ax un'ni ki oksĭs'tsi, ki ai'akŭkomĭmmiu otokem'an: ki akitum'anĭstoksisakumiau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 19:5 — Ŭn'nikaie nĭn'au itai'akskitsiu ax un'ni ki oksĭs'tsi, ki ai'akŭkomĭmmiu otokem'an: ki akitum'anĭstoksisakumiau.

text: Ŭn'nikaie matsĭstokŭm'axau, itse'tumanĭstoksisakumiau. Ap'ĭstotokiua otsipo'totopĭsts, pinits'tsĭs matap'pi mŏkai'aketotosĕsts.
text_for_embed: Matthew 19:6 — Ŭn'nikaie matsĭstokŭm'axau, itse'tumanĭstoksisakumiau. Ap'ĭstotokiua otsipo'totopĭsts, pinits'tsĭs matap'pi mŏkai'aketotosĕsts.

text: An'ĭstsiauaie, niauk'anii Moses ŏk'okotŏsi sinak'sin, ki ŏk'ŭnĭstŭpskoawsi?
text_for_embed: Matthew 19:7 — An'ĭstsiauaie, niauk'anii Moses ŏk'okotŏsi sinak'sin, ki ŏk'ŭnĭstŭpskoawsi?

text: An'ĭstsiuax Moses, kumut'sipotomokoau kitse'usskĕttsipŏppisuai, kŏkotŭnĭstŭp'skoŏssuai kotokem'anoauax; ki istsitsi'i matŭtŭnĭstsiu'ats.
text_for_embed: Matthew 19:8 — An'ĭstsiuax Moses, kumut'sipotomokoau kitse'usskĕttsipŏppisuai, kŏkotŭnĭstŭp'skoŏssuai kotokem'anoauax; ki istsitsi'i matŭtŭnĭstsiu'ats.

text: Ki kitanĭstopuau annŏk' akŭnĭstŭp'skuyiuŏk otokem'an, sauau'ŏkotasaie, ki otai'kaokemaitaii stsĭk'i itau'ŏkotau: ki annŏk' ikem'attauŏk itŭp'skoauŏk, itau'ŏkotau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 19:9 — Ki kitanĭstopuau annŏk' akŭnĭstŭp'skuyiuŏk otokem'an, sauau'ŏkotasaie, ki otai'kaokemaitaii stsĭk'i itau'ŏkotau: ki annŏk' ikem'attauŏk itŭp'skoauŏk, itau'ŏkotau.

text: Otŭs ksĭnimatsax anĭstsiauaie Ŭnnianĭsts'ĭssau nin'au ki otokem'an, matŏkhsiu'ats mŏk'okemsi.
text_for_embed: Matthew 19:10 — Otŭs ksĭnimatsax anĭstsiauaie Ŭnnianĭsts'ĭssau nin'au ki otokem'an, matŏkhsiu'ats mŏk'okemsi.

text: Ki an'ĭstsiuax kŏnai'tappix matokot'otsimaxaie annik' epo'awsĭnik, anniks'isk iko'taxk nittsĭmiauaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 19:11 — Ki an'ĭstsiuax kŏnai'tappix matokot'otsimaxaie annik' epo'awsĭnik, anniks'isk iko'taxk nittsĭmiauaie.

text: Itstsi'i iuai'itax itsipo'kaiiau; ki stsĭk'ix matappix iuai'itsiauax, ki stsĭk'ix iuai'itastotosiau, Spots' im istsĭnnaisĭnni umut'uaiĭtastotospiau. Annŏk' ikot'totsĭmŏk ŭnnianĭstots'ĭsaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 19:12 — Itstsi'i iuai'itax itsipo'kaiiau; ki stsĭk'ix matappix iuai'itsiauax, ki stsĭk'ix iuai'itastotosiau, Spots' im istsĭnnaisĭnni umut'uaiĭtastotospiau. Annŏk' ikot'totsĭmŏk ŭnnianĭstots'ĭsaie.

text: Inŭk'sipokax itotsipotoaii mŏkĭttokhitsikĭns'tsaksax, ki mŏkitatsĭmoiikasi: ki ŭsksĭnĭmats'ax an'ĭstsiauax unnai'e.
text_for_embed: Matthew 19:13 — Inŭk'sipokax itotsipotoaii mŏkĭttokhitsikĭns'tsaksax, ki mŏkitatsĭmoiikasi: ki ŭsksĭnĭmats'ax an'ĭstsiauax unnai'e.

text: Ki Jesus an'iu, Pokĭtsĭm'mokau inŭk'sipokax ki pinanĭs'tokau nŏkstai'puksipaaiĭsau. Ŭn'nianĭstaps'iau spots' im istsĭn'naiisĭnni.
text_for_embed: Matthew 19:14 — Ki Jesus an'iu, Pokĭtsĭm'mokau inŭk'sipokax ki pinanĭs'tokau nŏkstai'puksipaaiĭsau. Ŭn'nianĭstaps'iau spots' im istsĭn'naiisĭnni.

text: Ki itokhitsikĭns'tsakiuax, ki itsĭs'tŭpaatomaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 19:15 — Ki itokhitsikĭns'tsakiuax, ki itsĭs'tŭpaatomaie.

text: Ki, sŭppĭt, tuks'kŭmi itsitotoiĭnaie ki an'iu, Ŏkhsĭn'ai, tsanĭstap'iua nŏk'ŏkhsĭstutsipi, nŏkkuinan'si ŭsk'sipaitappiisĭnni?
text_for_embed: Matthew 19:16 — Ki, sŭppĭt, tuks'kŭmi itsitotoiĭnaie ki an'iu, Ŏkhsĭn'ai, tsanĭstap'iua nŏk'ŏkhsĭstutsipi, nŏkkuinan'si ŭsk'sipaitappiisĭnni?

text: Ki an'ĭstsiuaie, Kumauk'ainikŭk'iks ŏkh'si? Matŭtsitstsipa ŏkhsi, nitŭks'kŭm, Ap'ĭstotokiuă, itŏkh'siu: makitsipim'eniki opai'tappiisĭnni, sat'sitĕsts okŏk'itsĭmanĭsts.
text_for_embed: Matthew 19:17 — Ki an'ĭstsiuaie, Kumauk'ainikŭk'iks ŏkh'si? Matŭtsitstsipa ŏkhsi, nitŭks'kŭm, Ap'ĭstotokiuă, itŏkh'siu: makitsipim'eniki opai'tappiisĭnni, sat'sitĕsts okŏk'itsĭmanĭsts.

text: An'ĭstsiuaie Tsĭstsĭmă? Jesus an'iu, kimataksenik'ipa, kimatakau'ŏkotapa, kimataksikŏmos'pa, kimatakitŭp'saiepitspa.
text_for_embed: Matthew 19:18 — An'ĭstsiuaie Tsĭstsĭmă? Jesus an'iu, kimataksenik'ipa, kimatakau'ŏkotapa, kimataksikŏmos'pa, kimatakitŭp'saiepitspa.

text: Ŭkomĭm'mĭsau kĭn'a ki kiksĭs'ta; ki, kitak'anĭstŭkomĭmmau kitopokau'pimau kanĭstŭk'omĭmmospi.

text: Man'ikŏppi an'ĭstsiuaie. Nĭtokŏnŭs' satsipiau am'ostsk nitsŏk'umapiisi. Tsanĭstap'iua nikŭt'tomŭssatsipi?

text: Jesus an'istsiuaie maksŭpanĭs'tsĭminiki matap'ikŏttoat kitsinan'ipi ki ko'tsĭsau kĭm'atapsix, ki kitak'okuinani treasure spots'im: ki puk'siput, pokiuot' nĕsto'a.

text: Ki man'ikŏppi otokh'tsĭm'si annik' epo'awsĭnik, itsĭkikĭn'iĭstapu: tŭk'ka ek'akauoi otsinan'ists.

text: Jesus itŭm'anĭstsiuax otŭsksĭnĭmats'ax, kitau'mŭnĭstopuau, ako'tsapsiuă ak'skotoitsipim spots'im ĭstsĭn'naiisĭnni.

text: Ki kimat'anĭstopuau aks'ĭstŭpiksĭstspapiu'camel mŏkotsisŭppoksŭx atŭnau'ksis ĭstakŭn'ikai, ki mataksiksĭstspapĭu'ats ako'tsapsiuă mŏk'itsipĭssi spots'im istsĭn'naiisĭnni.
text_for_embed: Matthew 19:24 — Ki kimat'anĭstopuau aks'ĭstŭpiksĭstspapiu'camel mŏkotsisŭppoksŭx atŭnau'ksis ĭstakŭn'ikai, ki mataksiksĭstspapĭu'ats ako'tsapsiuă mŏk'itsipĭssi spots'im istsĭn'naiisĭnni.

text: Otŭsksĭnĭmatsax otokh'tsĭmsax ek'skaietŭkkiau, ki an'iau, Tŭkka' akokotsikŏmotse'piau?

text: Ki Jesus ŭs'sŭmmiuax, ki an'ĭstsiuax matap'pix matokotsĭstutsĭm'axau; Ap'istotokiuă ikotokŏn'apĭstutsimĕsts.

text: Peter itŭm'anĭstsiuaie, sat' sit, nitokŏnŭsskipĭnan ki nitopokiuo'pĭnan ksĕstu'a. Tsa nitakanĭstokuinan'ipĭnan?

text: Ki Jesus an'ĭstsiuax, kitau'mŭnĭstopuau, ksĕsto'au kitopokiuo'puau nesto'a, Nĭn'au okkui otak'ittokhittaupĭssi ots'tsapĭnaiso'pŏtsĭs, ksĕsto'au kitak'ittokh ittau pipuau na'tsikoputtuyists asso'pŏtsĭsts kŏkitokŏk'itsĭmattosau Israel ĭstsĭstsikoputsix matap'pix.

text: Ki anniks'isk skĭm'ixk oko'auĕsts, ki anniks'isk skĭts' ixk umu'pappiipuauax ki ot'akemoauax ki un'oauax, ki oksist'oauax ki otkem'anoauax ki o'kosoauax, kiotsĭn'sĭmmanoauax, nĕsto'i itskĭm' iauĕsts, kepĭp'pi ak'okuyiau, ki akokuinan'attomiau ŭsk'sipaitappiisĭnni.

text: Ki akai'tappix matom'six ak'sakoĭssiau, ki sako'ĭssix ak'otomsiau.

text: SPOTS' IM ĭstsĭn'naiisĭnni netoi'nitsiu nĭn'au, nap'ioyĭs ĭstsĭn'aim, annŏk kŏk'kŏnisuxiuŏk mŏk'anĭstosi ap'autŭkkix, mŏkapotomoyĭsax otsĭn'sĭmman.

text: Ki ŏkh'situkkisax mŏkokuyĭsax tuks'kai ksĭstsikui tŭks'kŭmi apŭn'asaini itŭp'skuyuiax otsĭn'sĭmmani.
text_for_embed: Matthew 20:2 — Ki ŏkh'situkkisax mŏkokuyĭsax tuks'kai ksĭstsikui tŭks'kŭmi apŭn'asaini itŭp'skuyuiax otsĭn'sĭmmani.

text: Ki nioks'kaii itai'ksĭstsikumiopi mat'suxiu, ki stsik'ix nan'nuyiuax nam'itaipuyiax itau'pumopi,
text_for_embed: Matthew 20:3 — Ki nioks'kaii itai'ksĭstsikumiopi mat'suxiu, ki stsik'ix nan'nuyiuax nam'itaipuyiax itau'pumopi,

text: Ki an'ĭstsiuax nokŏt'sitappoak ĭnsĭm'man, ki mokŏm'otsĭssi kitak'okotopuau, ki itappo'iau,
text_for_embed: Matthew 20:4 — Ki an'ĭstsiuax nokŏt'sitappoak ĭnsĭm'man, ki mokŏm'otsĭssi kitak'okotopuau, ki itappo'iau,

text: Nau'yi itai'ksĭstsikumiopi, ki piksu'yi itai'ksĭstukumiopi, mat'sŭxiu, ki netoi' mat'anĭstsiu.
text_for_embed: Matthew 20:5 — Nau'yi itai'ksĭstsikumiopi, ki piksu'yi itai'ksĭstukumiopi, mat'sŭxiu, ki netoi' mat'anĭstsiu.

text: Ki nitsiko'puttuyi itai'ksĭstsikumiopi, itsŭx'iu ki ikon'oyiuax stsĭk'ix nam'itaipuyix, ki an'ĭstsiuax konai'ksĭstsikuyi kumaukai'amitaipuisks annom'?
text_for_embed: Matthew 20:6 — Ki nitsiko'puttuyi itai'ksĭstsikumiopi, itsŭx'iu ki ikon'oyiuax stsĭk'ix nam'itaipuyix, ki an'ĭstsiuax konai'ksĭstsikuyi kumaukai'amitaipuisks annom'?

text: An'istsiauaie mats'itstsipa matap'pi nŏk' anikĭnan. An'ĭstsiuax, Nokŏt'sitappoak ĭnsĭm'man; ki mokŏm'otsĭssi kitak'okuinanipuau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 20:7 — An'istsiauaie mats'itstsipa matap'pi nŏk' anikĭnan. An'ĭstsiuax, Nokŏt'sitappoak ĭnsĭm'man; ki mokŏm'otsĭssi kitak'okuinanipuau.

text: Ki autŭkkus'si, insĭm'man ĭstsĭn'aim an'ĭstsiuaie otap'otomoki, ninikŏt'sĭsau ap'autŭkkix, ki ko'tsisau saiak'inosattaupiau, matom'okotsĭsau sako'ĭssix, ki tŭm'okotsĭsau matom'six.
text_for_embed: Matthew 20:8 — Ki autŭkkus'si, insĭm'man ĭstsĭn'aim an'ĭstsiuaie otap'otomoki, ninikŏt'sĭsau ap'autŭkkix, ki ko'tsisau saiak'inosattaupiau, matom'okotsĭsau sako'ĭssix, ki tŭm'okotsĭsau matom'six.

text: Ki ĭstoto'sau nitsiko'puttuyi itai'ksĭstsikumiopi itaumŭtŭp'apotŭkkix, kŏnai'ĭnax ikŏno'kuyiau apŭn'asaini.
text_for_embed: Matthew 20:9 — Ki ĭstoto'sau nitsiko'puttuyi itai'ksĭstsikumiopi itaumŭtŭp'apotŭkkix, kŏnai'ĭnax ikŏno'kuyiau apŭn'asaini.

text: Ki matom'six ĭsto'sau, ŭs'taiau mŏkoku'yĭsauaie stsĭk'i; ki ikŏno'kuyiau apŭn'asaini.
text_for_embed: Matthew 20:10 — Ki matom'six ĭsto'sau, ŭs'taiau mŏkoku'yĭsauaie stsĭk'i; ki ikŏno'kuyiau apŭn'asaini.

text: Ki otoku'yĭsauaie, itŭpaukape'poawtsiauaie nap'ioyĭs ĭstŏkhsĭn'ai,
text_for_embed: Matthew 20:11 — Ki otoku'yĭsauaie, itŭpaukape'poawtsiauaie nap'ioyĭs ĭstŏkhsĭn'ai,

text: Ki an' iau, anniks'isk sako'ĭsixk nituk'skau itai'ksĭstsikumiopi itapotŭkkiau, ki kanĭstokotaiau kanĭst'okokipĭnan ki ksĭstsiku'i ĭstsiksĭs'tutsĭssĭnni nitap'autŭkkipĭnan.
text_for_embed: Matthew 20:12 — Ki an' iau, anniks'isk sako'ĭsixk nituk'skau itai'ksĭstsikumiopi itapotŭkkiau, ki kanĭstokotaiau kanĭst'okokipĭnan ki ksĭstsiku'i ĭstsiksĭs'tutsĭssĭnni nitap'autŭkkipĭnan.

text: Ki an'ĭstsiuaie tuks'kŭmi, Napi'a, kimat'omaikĭmatsĭstotopa: kikŭt'tomaiŏkhsitŭkkipa tuks'kŭmi apŭn'asaini?
text_for_embed: Matthew 20:13 — Ki an'ĭstsiuaie tuks'kŭmi, Napi'a, kimat'omaikĭmatsĭstotopa: kikŭt'tomaiŏkhsitŭkkipa tuks'kŭmi apŭn'asaini?

text: Matsit' kitsinan' ki mĭs'taput; nitak'anĭstokotau am'o sako'ĭssiu kanĭst'okotopi.
text_for_embed: Matthew 20:14 — Matsit' kitsinan' ki mĭs'taput; nitak'anĭstokotau am'o sako'ĭssiu kanĭst'okotopi.

text: Kŭttomŏkhsiuats nitsinan' nanĭstsitsitapi nŏk'anĭstutsĭssi? Kŭtaukapiu'ats koŏps'pi, mŏk'ŏkhsĭssi nitsinan'?
text_for_embed: Matthew 20:15 — Kŭttomŏkhsiuats nitsinan' nanĭstsitsitapi nŏk'anĭstutsĭssi? Kŭtaukapiu'ats koŏps'pi, mŏk'ŏkhsĭssi nitsinan'?

text: Ki sako'ĭssix akotom'siau, ki matom'six ak'sakoĭssiau; tŭkka akaiĕm'ix ni'nikŏttaiau, ki un'natosĭmix mat'toaiau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 20:16 — Ki sako'ĭssix akotom'siau, ki matom'six ak'sakoĭssiau; tŭkka akaiĕm'ix ni'nikŏttaiau, ki un'natosĭmix mat'toaiau.

text: Ki Jesus otsitŭpamĭssosi Jerusalem, na'tsikoputtsix otŭs'ksĭnĭmatsax itŭnĭstŭpĭp'iikax, ki an'ĭstsiuax,
text_for_embed: Matthew 20:17 — Ki Jesus otsitŭpamĭssosi Jerusalem, na'tsikoputtsix otŭs'ksĭnĭmatsax itŭnĭstŭpĭp'iikax, ki an'ĭstsiuax,

text: Sat' sit aitŭpamĭssau'op Jerusalem, ki nĭn'au okku'i akitŭpomŭts'kau omŭk'atoiapiekuax ki ai'sĭnakix, ki akŭnĭstokŏkitsĭmŭt'tsiiauaie mŏks'eĭnsaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 20:18 — Sat' sit aitŭpamĭssau'op Jerusalem, ki nĭn'au okku'i akitŭpomŭts'kau omŭk'atoiapiekuax ki ai'sĭnakix, ki akŭnĭstokŏkitsĭmŭt'tsiiauaie mŏks'eĭnsaie.

text: Ki akŭtsitŭp'omŭtskau Gentiles mŏkitapapĭstotoŏssauaie, ki mŏkitstsipĭs'ossauaie, ki mŏkauai'stŏsauaie; otsoks'kaiksĭstsikusi ak'ŭtsipuau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 20:19 — Ki akŭtsitŭp'omŭtskau Gentiles mŏkitapapĭstotoŏssauaie, ki mŏkitstsipĭs'ossauaie, ki mŏkauai'stŏsauaie; otsoks'kaiksĭstsikusi ak'ŭtsipuau.

text: Zebedee oku'ix oksĭs'toauai ipok'itotomiauax oku'ix, ki atsĭmmĭm'miauaie, ki au'kŏmŏnĭstsiauaie tuks'kaii.
text_for_embed: Matthew 20:20 — Zebedee oku'ix oksĭs'toauai ipok'itotomiauax oku'ix, ki atsĭmmĭm'miauaie, ki au'kŏmŏnĭstsiauaie tuks'kaii.

text: Ki an'ĭstsiuaie, Tsa kanĭstsitsitapa? An'ĭstsiu aie. Anit am'ox nitai'akokosĭx mŏkittaupĭsau kitsĭn'naiisĭnni, tuks'kŭma netots'i, ki tuks'kŭma e'aksĭsauotsi.
text_for_embed: Matthew 20:21 — Ki an'ĭstsiuaie, Tsa kanĭstsitsitapa? An'ĭstsiu aie. Anit am'ox nitai'akokosĭx mŏkittaupĭsau kitsĭn'naiisĭnni, tuks'kŭma netots'i, ki tuks'kŭma e'aksĭsauotsi.

text: Jesus an'iu, kimatsksĭnip'uaua kitau'kŏmŏnikipuai, Kikŭtaiakokotsĭmipuau annŏk' kos'ŏk nimutai'aksĭmipŭk? Kikŭtaiakokotŭstapĭnŭkipuau ŭsta'pĭnŭksĭnni nimutai'akŭstapĭnŭkipi? An'ĭstsiauaie, nitokot'ŭnĭstspĭnan.
text_for_embed: Matthew 20:22 — Jesus an'iu, kimatsksĭnip'uaua kitau'kŏmŏnikipuai, Kikŭtaiakokotsĭmipuau annŏk' kos'ŏk nimutai'aksĭmipŭk? Kikŭtaiakokotŭstapĭnŭkipuau ŭsta'pĭnŭksĭnni nimutai'akŭstapĭnŭkipi? An'ĭstsiauaie, nitokot'ŭnĭstspĭnan.

text: An'ĭstsiuax kitak'ŭtsĭmipuau no'kosă, ki kitak'ŭstapĭnŭkipuau ŭsta'pĭnŭksĭnni nimut'akŭstapĭnŭkiipi; ki nimatsinanĕstsau kŏkokotosuai kŏkittaupisuai netots'i ki e'aksĭsauotsi nesto'a, ki anniks'isk matap'pixk Nin'a ŭk'aisŭppŭtsĭstotomoyiuax, otaksinan'oaiau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 20:23 — An'ĭstsiuax kitak'ŭtsĭmipuau no'kosă, ki kitak'ŭstapĭnŭkipuau ŭsta'pĭnŭksĭnni nimut'akŭstapĭnŭkiipi; ki nimatsinanĕstsau kŏkokotosuai kŏkittaupisuai netots'i ki e'aksĭsauotsi nesto'a, ki anniks'isk matap'pixk Nin'a ŭk'aisŭppŭtsĭstotomoyiuax, otaksinan'oaiau.

text: Ke' pix otokh'tsĭmsau ĭstsĭmmĭm'miauax na'tsitappix ipapiĭmmotseiix.
text_for_embed: Matthew 20:24 — Ke' pix otokh'tsĭmsau ĭstsĭmmĭm'miauax na'tsitappix ipapiĭmmotseiix.

text: Ki Jesus ninikŏt'siuax, ki an'istsiuax, kits'ksĭnipuau Gentiles otsĭn'aimoauax otain'aiĭskotokoaiauax ki anniks'isk omŭx'ĭnaxk nokŏtai'naiĭskotokoaiauax.
text_for_embed: Matthew 20:25 — Ki Jesus ninikŏt'siuax, ki an'istsiuax, kits'ksĭnipuau Gentiles otsĭn'aimoauax otain'aiĭskotokoaiauax ki anniks'isk omŭx'ĭnaxk nokŏtai'naiĭskotokoaiauax.

text: Ki mataketŭmanistsiu'ă ksĕsto'au: annŏk' ak'omŭksĭmŏk, ŭnanĭstap'otŭksi;

text: Ki annŏk' kitaks'ĭnnauŭkŏk ŭnanĭstap'otŭksi:

text: Nin'au okku'i matŭtoto'ats mŏk'apotomoŏsaie, mŏk'apotomoŏsi umut'oto, ki mŏk'itatsuaumŭtskotosi akaitappix opai'tappiisĭnni.
text_for_embed: Matthew 20:28 — Nin'au okku'i matŭtoto'ats mŏk'apotomoŏsaie, mŏk'apotomoŏsi umut'oto, ki mŏk'itatsuaumŭtskotosi akaitappix opai'tappiisĭnni.

text: Ki otsĭstŭpaatosau Jericho, akai'tappix ipokiuo'iauaie.

text: Ki satsit, natsitappix naps'tsix pitsiko'-otsim i tau' pix otokh'tsĭsau Jesus umutak'itsskosaie awk'umiau, ki an'iau, kĭm'okinan, Nin'a David okku'i.
text_for_embed: Matthew 20:30 — Ki satsit, natsitappix naps'tsix pitsiko'-otsim i tau' pix otokh'tsĭsau Jesus umutak'itsskosaie awk'umiau, ki an'iau, kĭm'okinan, Nin'a David okku'i.

text: Ki o' tappiisĭn'na ai'semiauax mŏkstaie'puyĭsax: ki matsĭstawk'umiau ki an'iau kĭm'okinan, Nin'a, David okku'i.
text_for_embed: Matthew 20:31 — Ki o' tappiisĭn'na ai'semiauax mŏkstaie'puyĭsax: ki matsĭstawk'umiau ki an'iau kĭm'okinan, Nin'a, David okku'i.

text: Ki Jesus itsipu'yiu, ki nan'nikŏttsiuax, ki an'iu, Tsa kŏk'anĭstutopuau?
text_for_embed: Matthew 20:32 — Ki Jesus itsipu'yiu, ki nan'nikŏttsiuax, ki an'iu, Tsa kŏk'anĭstutopuau?

text: An'ĭstsiauaie, Nin'a mŏksikauopiisaii noŏps'pĭnanix.
text_for_embed: Matthew 20:33 — An'ĭstsiauaie, Nin'a mŏksikauopiisaii noŏps'pĭnanix.

text: Ki Jesus kaiĭm'iuax, ki itsĭksen'iuax oŏps'puauax, ki oŏps'puauax kau'opiau, ki itopokiuo'iauaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 20:34 — Ki Jesus kaiĭm'iuax, ki itsĭksen'iuax oŏps'puauax, ki oŏps'puauax kau'opiau, ki itopokiuo'iauaie.

text: OTSITASTOTOSAU Jerusalem otsitotosau Bethphage, itum'uasuaie Olives an'ĭstop Jesus itŭp'skuyiuax na'tsitappix otŭsksĭnĭmats'ax,
text_for_embed: Matthew 21:1 — OTSITASTOTOSAU Jerusalem otsitotosau Bethphage, itum'uasuaie Olives an'ĭstop Jesus itŭp'skuyiuax na'tsitappix otŭsksĭnĭmats'ax,

text: Ki an'ĭstsiuax, akap'ioyĭs astsi'ĭm ĭstsipi'ĭk, kikitakstŭmkonau ŭsk'omŭkstokiua aks'ĭsksipĭstau, ki o'kosepokai ak'opokitaipuyimiu: apo'tokau ki puk'sipĭppotokĭkau.

text: Ki sĭtsĭpsatsenoainiki matap'pi, kitak'anĭstaiau Nin'a au'anĭstsiuax; ki ak'otŭmŭtsitŭpskuyiuax.

text_for_embed: Matthew 22:4 — Ki mats'itŭpskuyiuax stsĭk'ix otap'otomokix, ki an'ĭstsiuax anĭstok'au anniks'isk ŭm'axk, Sat'sik, nikaw'apastutsip nitso'ŏssĭn: nitap'otskĭnamix ki nitunĭstakhtsimix ŭkainitaiau ŭk'okŏnaiksĭstsiiau: Puksipa'atok okem'sĭnni.

text: Ki ap'etsĭmiauaie, ki oksoku'oauĕsts itappoiau, tuks'kŭmi otsĭn'sĭmman, stsik'i otsit'aumŭtskotŭkkipi:

text_for_embed: Matthew 22:6 — Ki stsĭk'ix mat'tuyiuax otap'otomokix, ki au'ksĭstutuyiuax, ki initsiu'ax.

text: Ki omŭx'ina otokh'tsĭmsi, itsĭs'tsetŭkkiu: ki itŭp'skuyiuax otseĕn'akemix, ki itsaiĭnakuaiĭstutuyiuax anniks'isk inĭk'ixk, ki itsĭn'sĭmaie otakap'ioyimoauaie.

text: Ki an'ĭstsiuaie, Napi'a, Tsa kanĭs'tsipipa kitsauomai'sŭpskŏsattosi ikem'sĭnni istsiso'kŏsĭmi? Ki matsepuyiu'ats.

text: Annik' omŭx'ipuĭnasĭnni ak'itstsiu, istsitsĭs'si ksŏk'kŭm, ki annok' manĭsts'ipuĭnapspi, aksĭs'tŭpŭnĭstsipuĭnapsiu, ki ĭs'sotsk matakotŭmanĭstsipuĭnapsiu'ats.
text_for_embed: Matthew 24:21 — Annik' omŭx'ipuĭnasĭnni ak'itstsiu, istsitsĭs'si ksŏk'kŭm, ki annok' manĭsts'ipuĭnapspi, aksĭs'tŭpŭnĭstsipuĭnapsiu, ki ĭs'sotsk matakotŭmanĭstsipuĭnapsiu'ats.

text: Ki annists'ists ksĭstsiku'ĭsts sauun'natsĭstutsĭsĕsts mat'akitstsipa matap'pi itsikŏmotse'piaiau; aumai'tŭkkixk, osto'auai itunnats'ĭstutsĭmĕsts annists'ĭsts ksĭstsikuĭsts.
text_for_embed: Matthew 24:22 — Ki annists'ists ksĭstsiku'ĭsts sauun'natsĭstutsĭsĕsts mat'akitstsipa matap'pi itsikŏmotse'piaiau; aumai'tŭkkixk, osto'auai itunnats'ĭstutsĭmĕsts annists'ĭsts ksĭstsikuĭsts.

text: Kŭmĭts'tsiki matap'pi kitai'akaniki Sŭm'mĭs, am'auk Christ, ki om'auk; pinau'maitos.
text_for_embed: Matthew 24:23 — Kŭmĭts'tsiki matap'pi kitai'akaniki Sŭm'mĭs, am'auk Christ, ki om'auk; pinau'maitos.

text: Ksĭs'tapsix Christix akitsipuau'iau ki ksĭs'tapsix prophetix, ki akanĭs'tsĭnnŭkiau omŭk'apstosĭsts ki pĭsats'kasĭsts; ki ikŭm'itstsiki aks'ipĭstsiksĭstutuyiauax aumai'tŭkkixk.
text_for_embed: Matthew 24:24 — Ksĭs'tapsix Christix akitsipuau'iau ki ksĭs'tapsix prophetix, ki akanĭs'tsĭnnŭkiau omŭk'apstosĭsts ki pĭsats'kasĭsts; ki ikŭm'itstsiki aks'ipĭstsiksĭstutuyiauax aumai'tŭkkixk.

text: Sat'sik, kikau'anĭstopuau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 24:25 — Sat'sik, kikau'anĭstopuau.

text: Kŭm'anĭstsenikiau sat'sit ksĭs'tapsksŏkkuyi ŭn'amauk; pini'tappoat; Sa'sit, sĭmiap'ioyĭsts ŭn'amauk; pinaumai'tŭkkik.
text_for_embed: Matthew 24:26 — Kŭm'anĭstsenikiau sat'sit ksĭs'tapsksŏkkuyi ŭn'amauk; pini'tappoat; Sa'sit, sĭmiap'ioyĭsts ŭn'amauk; pinaumai'tŭkkik.

text: Ksĭstsikum' manĭsttotsipuksipupi umut'autstsipi apinŏk'kuyi, ki manĭstsitŭpikŭnatspi ame'totsi; netoi' ak'ŭnĭststsiu nĭn'au okku'i otos'aie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 24:27 — Ksĭstsikum' manĭsttotsipuksipupi umut'autstsipi apinŏk'kuyi, ki manĭstsitŭpikŭnatspi ame'totsi; netoi' ak'ŭnĭststsiu nĭn'au okku'i otos'aie.

text: Mĭksĭnii otsits'tsipi, ŭn'nim pi'tax akomooi'iau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 24:28 — Mĭksĭnii otsits'tsipi, ŭn'nim pi'tax akomooi'iau.

text: Annists'ĭsts ksĭstsiku'ĭstsk ĭstsipu'ĭnasĭsts otaiksiuos'au, nato'si akski'ĭnŭm, ki kokum'ikesŭm matakanakĭmauats, ki kŏk'atosix akotots'ĭnĭssiau, ki spots'im otsĭs'kŏpsĭnni akauŭt'apixip:
text_for_embed: Matthew 24:29 — Annists'ĭsts ksĭstsiku'ĭstsk ĭstsipu'ĭnasĭsts otaiksiuos'au, nato'si akski'ĭnŭm, ki kokum'ikesŭm matakanakĭmauats, ki kŏk'atosix akotots'ĭnĭssiau, ki spots'im otsĭs'kŏpsĭnni akauŭt'apixip:

text: Ki Nin'auă okku'i otap'stosĭnni akitsĭnakoaie spots'im: ki ksŏk'kum ĭstokŏnai'tappix ak'otŭmauyesiau, ki aks'ĭnnoyeiau Nĭn'au okku'i spots'im istsĭssoksĭs'tsikuĭsts itsipsts'otosi, otŭmap'sĭnni ki omŭxĭk'kŭnnasĭnni akopoto.
text_for_embed: Matthew 24:30 — Ki Nin'auă okku'i otap'stosĭnni akitsĭnakoaie spots'im: ki ksŏk'kum ĭstokŏnai'tappix ak'otŭmauyesiau, ki aks'ĭnnoyeiau Nĭn'au okku'i spots'im istsĭssoksĭs'tsikuĭsts itsipsts'otosi, otŭmap'sĭnni ki omŭxĭk'kŭnnasĭnni akopoto.

text: Ki ak'itŭpskuyiuax otatsĭm'otokatatsix ak'soksĭkkiax, ki aumai'tŭkkixk akitotomoi'piiauax, nĭssoo'ĭsts sopu'ĭsts ki spots'im umuk'itsipi:
text_for_embed: Matthew 24:31 — Ki ak'itŭpskuyiuax otatsĭm'otokatatsix ak'soksĭkkiax, ki aumai'tŭkkixk akitotomoi'piiauax, nĭssoo'ĭsts sopu'ĭsts ki spots'im umuk'itsipi:

text: Annok', ĭsksĭnik parable omŭx'ĭnĭstsĭs; okŭn'iksi otsa'kiŭkkĭnĭsĭssi, ki otsuio'pokassi, kitsksĭnipuau nepu'yi itasts'tsiu;
text_for_embed: Matthew 24:32 — Annok', ĭsksĭnik parable omŭx'ĭnĭstsĭs; okŭn'iksi otsa'kiŭkkĭnĭsĭssi, ki otsuio'pokassi, kitsksĭnipuau nepu'yi itasts'tsiu;

text: Neto'i maks'ĭnĭmenoainiki annists'isk, ĭsksĭnik, mŏkaststsĭssi, ito'to okh'sepĭstanĭsts.
text_for_embed: Matthew 24:33 — Neto'i maks'ĭnĭmenoainiki annists'isk, ĭsksĭnik, mŏkaststsĭssi, ito'to okh'sepĭstanĭsts.

text: Kitau'mŭnĭstopuau am'oi o'tappiisĭnaii mataksĭstapu'ats otsauomaisŭpanĭs'tsiosau annists'isk.
text_for_embed: Matthew 24:34 — Kitau'mŭnĭstopuau am'oi o'tappiisĭnaii mataksĭstapu'ats otsauomaisŭpanĭs'tsiosau annists'isk.

text: Spots'im ki ksŏk'kum ak'eitsĭnikau, ki nitse'poawsĭsts matakeitsĭnikau'ĕstsau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 24:35 — Spots'im ki ksŏk'kum ak'eitsĭnikau, ki nitse'poawsĭsts matakeitsĭnikau'ĕstsau.

text: Annik' ksĭstsiku'ik ki annik' itai'ksĭstsikumiopik matsksĭnĭm'ats matap'pi, Spots'im ĭstso'tokatatsix matsksĭnĭm'axauaie, Nin'a nits'ksĭnĭmaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 24:36 — Annik' ksĭstsiku'ik ki annik' itai'ksĭstsikumiopik matsksĭnĭm'ats matap'pi, Spots'im ĭstso'tokatatsix matsksĭnĭm'axauaie, Nin'a nits'ksĭnĭmaie.

text: Noe otsiksĭs'tsikumĭsts manistsi'piĕsts, netoi' ak'anĭsttsiiĕsts Nĭn'au okku'i oto'saie
text_for_embed: Matthew 24:37 — Noe otsiksĭs'tsikumĭsts manistsi'piĕsts, netoi' ak'anĭsttsiiĕsts Nĭn'au okku'i oto'saie

text: Otsauomo'kŏnaiokkeuasi ksŏkkum manĭstau'yipiau ki manĭstai'sĭmipiau, manĭstok'kemipiau manĭsta'pikŏttŭkkipiau, itŭp'itsiu annik' ksĭstsikuik, Noe otsit'sŭppopĭssi akh'iosatsĭs.
text_for_embed: Matthew 24:38 — Otsauomo'kŏnaiokkeuasi ksŏkkum manĭstau'yipiau ki manĭstai'sĭmipiau, manĭstok'kemipiau manĭsta'pikŏttŭkkipiau, itŭp'itsiu annik' ksĭstsikuik, Noe otsit'sŭppopĭssi akh'iosatsĭs.

text: Ki matsksĭnĭm'axau otsauomo'kŏnaiokkeuasi ki itsau'inakuaiĭstutuaiau; netoi' ak'anĭstsiu Nĭn'au okku'i oto'saie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 24:39 — Ki matsksĭnĭm'axau otsauomo'kŏnaiokkeuasi ki itsau'inakuaiĭstutuaiau; netoi' ak'anĭstsiu Nĭn'au okku'i oto'saie.

text: Natsitappiix akotŭmitau'piiau insĭm'man: nituks'kŭmi ak'otoau, ki stsĭk'i ak'skĭtau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 24:40 — Natsitappiix akotŭmitau'piiau insĭm'man: nituks'kŭmi ak'otoau, ki stsĭk'i ak'skĭtau.

text: Natsitappiĭx akex' akĭtaipĭk'iakiau; nituks'kŭmi ak'otoau, ki stsĭk'i ak'skĭtau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 24:41 — Natsitappiĭx akex' akĭtaipĭk'iakiau; nituks'kŭmi ak'otoau, ki stsĭk'i ak'skĭtau.

text: Ŭn'nikaie mokŏkik: kimats'ksĭnipuau annik' itai'ksĭstsikumiopik kitsĭn'aimoau otai'akĭtotopik.
text_for_embed: Matthew 24:42 — Ŭn'nikaie mokŏkik: kimats'ksĭnipuau annik' itai'ksĭstsikumiopik kitsĭn'aimoau otai'akĭtotopik.

text: Am'okă ĭsksĭnĭk', Napioyĭs ĭstŏkhsĭn'auă otsksĭnĭm'opi annik' itai'ksĭstsikumiopik otai'akitotosi kŏmos'iepĭtsĭuă ĭs'taiŭskskŭmiuopi, ĭstai'saiepukĭtsetsĭmopi oko'ai ĭstokitsĭm'i mŏkopokse'ĭsaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 24:43 — Am'okă ĭsksĭnĭk', Napioyĭs ĭstŏkhsĭn'auă otsksĭnĭm'opi annik' itai'ksĭstsikumiopik otai'akitotosi kŏmos'iepĭtsĭuă ĭs'taiŭskskŭmiuopi, ĭstai'saiepukĭtsetsĭmopi oko'ai ĭstokitsĭm'i mŏkopokse'ĭsaie.

text: Ŭn'nikaie ŭk'aisŭppuiapĭstotosĭk; kitsit'sisauaitsitatopuai, Nĭn'au okku'i ak'itoto.
text_for_embed: Matthew 24:44 — Ŭn'nikaie ŭk'aisŭppuiapĭstotosĭk; kitsit'sisauaitsitatopuai, Nĭn'au okku'i ak'itoto.

text: Tŭkka' aumai'tŭkki ap'otŭkkiuă, ki mokŏk'i apotŭkkiuă annŏk' otsĭn'aim otĭnaiăts'okŏk oko'ai ĭstsitappim'ix, mŏk'okŏmotokotŏsax otso'ŏsĭnoauĕsts?
text_for_embed: Matthew 24:45 — Tŭkka' aumai'tŭkki ap'otŭkkiuă, ki mokŏk'i apotŭkkiuă annŏk' otsĭn'aim otĭnaiăts'okŏk oko'ai ĭstsitappim'ix, mŏk'okŏmotokotŏsax otso'ŏsĭnoauĕsts?

text: Atsĭm'siu annŏk ap'otŭkkiuŏk, otsĭn'aim oto'saie otak'okonokaie netoi' it'ŭnĭstsĭstutsimaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 24:46 — Atsĭm'siu annŏk ap'otŭkkiuŏk, otsĭn'aim oto'saie otak'okonokaie netoi' it'ŭnĭstsĭstutsimaie.

text: Kitau'mŭnĭstopuau, akokŏnitainaiăts'iuaie otokŏnai'nanĭsts.
text_for_embed: Matthew 24:47 — Kitau'mŭnĭstopuau, akokŏnitainaiăts'iuaie otokŏnai'nanĭsts.

text: Ki annŏk sauum'itapotŭkkiuŏk, makotots'anĭssi u'skĕttsipŏppi ai'sŭmsiu nitsĭn'aim;
text_for_embed: Matthew 24:48 — Ki annŏk sauum'itapotŭkkiuŏk, makotots'anĭssi u'skĕttsipŏppi ai'sŭmsiu nitsĭn'aim;

text: Ki makaumŭtŭpauaiak'iŭssi ot'opokapotŭkkimax, ki makopoks'oyimŭssi ki mak'opoksĭmimŭssi ai'sĭmix;
text_for_embed: Matthew 24:49 — Ki makaumŭtŭpauaiak'iŭssi ot'opokapotŭkkimax, ki makopoks'oyimŭssi ki mak'opoksĭmimŭssi ai'sĭmix;

text: Annŏk' ap'otŭkkiuŏk otsĭn'aim ak'oto annik' kustsiku'ik otsauomŭsks'kŭmosaie, ki annik' itai'ksĭstsikumiopik otsauomŭs'ksĭnniĭssi,
text_for_embed: Matthew 24:50 — Annŏk' ap'otŭkkiuŏk otsĭn'aim ak'oto annik' kustsiku'ik otsauomŭsks'kŭmosaie, ki annik' itai'ksĭstsikumiopik otsauomŭs'ksĭnniĭssi,

text: Ki akaiaketsĭn'iuaie, ki aiakokotsiuaie mŏk'itaupĭssaie otsitau'pipiax ksĭstapokŏmotsităppiansix: annim' ak'itstsiu asain'sĭnni ki satse'kĭnani.
text_for_embed: Matthew 24:51 — Ki akaiaketsĭn'iuaie, ki aiakokotsiuaie mŏk'itaupĭssaie otsitau'pipiax ksĭstapokŏmotsităppiansix: annim' ak'itstsiu asain'sĭnni ki satse'kĭnani.

text: SPOTS' IM ĭstsĭn'naiisĭnni aketum'anĭstsiau ke'pix ake'kuax, anniks'isk mat'tuyixk ot'anakimatsuauĕsts, ki itsux'iau mŏkota'tsemŏsau annŏk' ai'akokemiuŏk.
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:1 — SPOTS' IM ĭstsĭn'naiisĭnni aketum'anĭstsiau ke'pix ake'kuax, anniks'isk mat'tuyixk ot'anakimatsuauĕsts, ki itsux'iau mŏkota'tsemŏsau annŏk' ai'akokemiuŏk.

text: Ki nĭs'itsix mokŏk'iau, ki nĭs'ĭtsix mat'tsapsiau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:2 — Ki nĭs'itsix mokŏk'iau, ki nĭs'ĭtsix mat'tsapsiau.

text: Anniks'isk mat'tsapsixk nito'tsĭmiau ot'anakimatsuauĕsts, ki, mattotŭkkiu'axau okke'anakĭmatsĭs:
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:3 — Anniks'isk mat'tsapsixk nito'tsĭmiau ot'anakimatsuauĕsts, ki, mattotŭkkiu'axau okke'anakĭmatsĭs:

text: Ki mokŏk'ixk ipok'iotscmiau otanakimatsuauĕsts okke'anakĭmatsis, kos'ĭx itsŭp'pitŭkkiau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:4 — Ki mokŏk'ixk ipok'iotscmiau otanakimatsuauĕsts okke'anakĭmatsis, kos'ĭx itsŭp'pitŭkkiau.

text: Annŏk' ai'akokkemiuŏk otai'sŭmsi, ikŏnai'okano'piiau ki ikŏnai'okax.
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:5 — Annŏk' ai'akokkemiuŏk otai'sŭmsi, ikŏnai'okano'piiau ki ikŏnai'okax.

text: Ki itŭt'sikiikokoi ikum'iŭstutsip, sat'sik, ak'okemiuă ai'puksipu; Sŭksĭk' kŏkotatsemŏssuai.
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:6 — Ki itŭt'sikiikokoi ikum'iŭstutsip, sat'sik, ak'okemiuă ai'puksipu; Sŭksĭk' kŏkotatsemŏssuai.

text: Itŭmokŏnaipuau'iau am'ox ake'kuax, ki ikŏn'itaisŭppasuyĭnŭkiau otanakimatsuauĕsts.
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:7 — Itŭmokŏnaipuau'iau am'ox ake'kuax, ki ikŏn'itaisŭppasuyĭnŭkiau otanakimatsuauĕsts.

text: Ki mat'tsapsix an'ĭstsiauax mokŏk'ix, kok'ĭnan kitŏk'keanakĭmatsuai; tŭk'ka, nitan'akimatsĭnanĕsts ŭk'aiitsĭnikaiau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:8 — Ki mat'tsapsix an'ĭstsiauax mokŏk'ix, kok'ĭnan kitŏk'keanakĭmatsuai; tŭk'ka, nitan'akimatsĭnanĕsts ŭk'aiitsĭnikaiau.

text: Ki mokŏk'ix an'ĭstsiauax, Sa; matakakauo'ats ksĕstŭn'un: Is'tapuk aumŭts'kotŭkkix kŏk'opumattosuai.
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:9 — Ki mokŏk'ix an'ĭstsiauax, Sa; matakakauo'ats ksĕstŭn'un: Is'tapuk aumŭts'kotŭkkix kŏk'opumattosuai.

text: Ki otsakiaitapposau mŏk'opumattosau, aiakokemi ito'to; ki anniks'isk sopuiap'ĭstotosĭxk ipok'sipimiauaie okkem'sĭnni: ki ai'okip.
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:10 — Ki otsakiaitapposau mŏk'opumattosau, aiakokemi ito'to; ki anniks'isk sopuiap'ĭstotosĭxk ipok'sipimiauaie okkem'sĭnni: ki ai'okip.

text: Sako'okhtsi mat'tsapsix nokŭt'otoiau ki an'iau, Nin'a, nin'a, kauai'pĭxĭkĭnan.
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:11 — Sako'okhtsi mat'tsapsix nokŭt'otoiau ki an'iau, Nin'a, nin'a, kauai'pĭxĭkĭnan.

text: Ki an'ĭstsiuax, kitau'mŭnĭstopuau kimats'ksĭnopuauats.
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:12 — Ki an'ĭstsiuax, kitau'mŭnĭstopuau kimats'ksĭnopuauats.

text: Ŭn'nikaie mokŏkĭk', tŭk'ka, kimats' ksĭnipuauats annik' ksĭstsiku'ĭk ki annik' itai'ksĭstsikumiopik Nin'au okku'i otai'akĭtotopik.
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:13 — Ŭn'nikaie mokŏkĭk', tŭk'ka, kimats' ksĭnipuauats annik' ksĭstsiku'ĭk ki annik' itai'ksĭstsikumiopik Nin'au okku'i otai'akĭtotopik.

text: Spots'im ĭstsĭn'naiisĭnni netum'anĭstsiu nĭn'au annŏk' piuo'ŏk, ki ninikŏt'tsiuax otap'otomokix, ki ikotsiu'ax otsinan'ĭsts.
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:14 — Spots'im ĭstsĭn'naiisĭnni netum'anĭstsiu nĭn'au annŏk' piuo'ŏk, ki ninikŏt'tsiuax otap'otomokix, ki ikotsiu'ax otsinan'ĭsts.

text: Ki tuks'kai ikotsiu'aie nĭsĭtsi'i itawk'pumaupix ki stsĭk'i na'tokai, ki stsĭk'i nituks'kai; ki kŏnai'tappix itanistokotsiu'ax manĭst'okotsĭstutsipiau; ki itau'matto.
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:15 — Ki tuks'kai ikotsiu'aie nĭsĭtsi'i itawk'pumaupix ki stsĭk'i na'tokai, ki stsĭk'i nituks'kai; ki kŏnai'tappix itanistokotsiu'ax manĭst'okotsĭstutsipiau; ki itau'matto.

text: Annŏk' ikuyiu'ok nĭsĭtsi'i itawk'pumaupix itsĭs'tapu, ki itau'mŭtskotŭkkiu, ki ikuyiu' stsĭk'ix nĭsĭtsix itawk'pumaupix.
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:16 — Annŏk' ikuyiu'ok nĭsĭtsi'i itawk'pumaupix itsĭs'tapu, ki itau'mŭtskotŭkkiu, ki ikuyiu' stsĭk'ix nĭsĭtsix itawk'pumaupix.

text: Ki netoi annŏk' ikuyiu'ŏk na'tokŭmi, ikuyiu' stsĭk'ix na'tokŭmĭx.
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:17 — Ki netoi annŏk' ikuyiu'ŏk na'tokŭmi, ikuyiu' stsĭk'ix na'tokŭmĭx.

text: Ki annŏk' ikuyiu'ŏk nituks'kŭmi itsĭs'tapu, ki itatŭn'akiu ksŏk'kum, ki ai'ksasattomaie otsĭn'aim otsĭxkĭmim'iaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:18 — Ki annŏk' ikuyiu'ŏk nituks'kŭmi itsĭs'tapu, ki itatŭn'akiu ksŏk'kum, ki ai'ksasattomaie otsĭn'aim otsĭxkĭmim'iaie.

text: Otai'sŭmmosi, am'ox ap'otŭkkix otsĭn'aimoauai itoto'yiĭnai, ki ipokoks'tŭkimiuax.
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:19 — Otai'sŭmmosi, am'ox ap'otŭkkix otsĭn'aimoauai itoto'yiĭnai, ki ipokoks'tŭkimiuax.

text: Ki annŏk ikuyiu'ŏk nĭsĭtsi'i itawk'pumaupix ito'to ki ito'tsĭpatopiau stsĭk'ix nĭsitsix itawk'pumaupix, ki an'iu, Nin'a, kit'okŏk nĭsitsi'i itawk'pumaupix: Sat'sĭt nitokuinan' matsĭs'ĭtsix.
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:20 — Ki annŏk ikuyiu'ŏk nĭsĭtsi'i itawk'pumaupix ito'to ki ito'tsĭpatopiau stsĭk'ix nĭsitsix itawk'pumaupix, ki an'iu, Nin'a, kit'okŏk nĭsitsi'i itawk'pumaupix: Sat'sĭt nitokuinan' matsĭs'ĭtsix.

text: Otsĭn'aim an'ĭstsiuaie, kitŏkhs'ĭstututŭkki, ŏkhs'apotŭkkiuă ki emŭn'apotŭkkiuă: kitse'mŭnŭssatsipiau un'natosĕsts, kitakĭnai'atso akauo'iĕsts: Kitsĭn'aim otse'tametŭksĭnni ĭstsipi'it.
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:21 — Otsĭn'aim an'ĭstsiuaie, kitŏkhs'ĭstututŭkki, ŏkhs'apotŭkkiuă ki emŭn'apotŭkkiuă: kitse'mŭnŭssatsipiau un'natosĕsts, kitakĭnai'atso akauo'iĕsts: Kitsĭn'aim otse'tametŭksĭnni ĭstsipi'it.

text: Annŏk' iku'yiuŏk natokŭm itawk'pumaupix ito'to ki an'iu, Nin'a, kit'okok natokŭmi itawk'pumaupix: Sat'sit, nimat'okuinani mats'ĭstokai itawk'pumaupix.
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:22 — Annŏk' iku'yiuŏk natokŭm itawk'pumaupix ito'to ki an'iu, Nin'a, kit'okok natokŭmi itawk'pumaupix: Sat'sit, nimat'okuinani mats'ĭstokai itawk'pumaupix.

text: Otsĭn'aim an'ĭstsiuaie, kitŏkhs'ĭstutŭkki, okhs'apotŭkkiuă ki emŭn'apotŭkkiuă; kitse'mŭnŭssatsipiau un'natosĕsts, kitakĭnai'atso akauo'iĕsts: Kitsĭn'aim otse'tametŭksĭnni ĭstsipi'ĭt.
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:23 — Otsĭn'aim an'ĭstsiuaie, kitŏkhs'ĭstutŭkki, okhs'apotŭkkiuă ki emŭn'apotŭkkiuă; kitse'mŭnŭssatsipiau un'natosĕsts, kitakĭnai'atso akauo'iĕsts: Kitsĭn'aim otse'tametŭksĭnni ĭstsipi'ĭt.

text: Annŏk' ikuyiu'ŏk tuks'kŭmi itawk'pumaupi ito'to ki an'iu, Nin'a kits'ksĭno ksĕsto'a kitse'ĭnai, kikŭt'tomaisŭppipumattopi kitai'pokiaki, ki kikŭttomauanit'apixipi kitomoi'pitŭkki;
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:24 — Annŏk' ikuyiu'ŏk tuks'kŭmi itawk'pumaupi ito'to ki an'iu, Nin'a kits'ksĭno ksĕsto'a kitse'ĭnai, kikŭt'tomaisŭppipumattopi kitai'pokiaki, ki kikŭttomauanit'apixipi kitomoi'pitŭkki;

text: Ki nĭtsiko'pum, ki nitsit'tappo ki nitai'ksasattop ksŏk'kum kitsinană itawk'pumaupi: Sat'sit, kĭtsinan.
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:25 — Ki nĭtsiko'pum, ki nitsit'tappo ki nitai'ksasattop ksŏk'kum kitsinană itawk'pumaupi: Sat'sit, kĭtsinan.

text: Otsĭn'aim an'ĭstsiuaie, kitsauum'apotŭkkiuă ki kitsistap'apotŭkkiuă, kitsksĭnoki nitai'pokiaki nikŭttomai'sŭppipumattopi, ki nitomoi'pitŭkki, ni kŭttomauanit'apĭxipi:
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:26 — Otsĭn'aim an'ĭstsiuaie, kitsauum'apotŭkkiuă ki kitsistap'apotŭkkiuă, kitsksĭnoki nitai'pokiaki nikŭttomai'sŭppipumattopi, ki nitomoi'pitŭkki, ni kŭttomauanit'apĭxipi:

text: Kumaukstauokotaiĭsksĭxau au'awtsoomŭtskotŭkkix nitsĭx'kĭmĭmĭx, ki nitsitotopi nŏk'staitokuyitopi nitsinan'ix ki umut'okuyesix.
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:27 — Kumaukstauokotaiĭsksĭxau au'awtsoomŭtskotŭkkix nitsĭx'kĭmĭmĭx, ki nitsitotopi nŏk'staitokuyitopi nitsinan'ix ki umut'okuyesix.

text: Mattomok'aie itawk'pumaupi, ki kotok' annŏk iku'yiuŏk ke'pix itawk'pumaupix.
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:28 — Mattomok'aie itawk'pumaupi, ki kotok' annŏk iku'yiuŏk ke'pix itawk'pumaupix.

text: Anniks'isk iku'yixk ak'okotaiau, ki otaksinanoaiau akauo'i: ki annŏk' itsau'okuyiuŏk ak'otomoau annik' ooko'ŏsĭnik.
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:29 — Anniks'isk iku'yixk ak'okotaiau, ki otaksinanoaiau akauo'i: ki annŏk' itsau'okuyiuŏk ak'otomoau annik' ooko'ŏsĭnik.

text: Ki ĭstŭp'satŭpiksĭstsĭs ap'otŭkkĭuă itsau'okuyiuă ski'natsii: ak'itstsiu asain'sĭnni ki satse'kĭnani.
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:30 — Ki ĭstŭp'satŭpiksĭstsĭs ap'otŭkkĭuă itsau'okuyiuă ski'natsii: ak'itstsiu asain'sĭnni ki satse'kĭnani.

text: Otak'ĭtotosi Nin'au okku'i otstsa'pĭnasĭnni ipokom'ŏssau otokŏnatsĭm'otokatatsĭx, ak'otŭmotokhitaupiu otsĭstsapĭsso'pŏtsĭs:
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:31 — Otak'ĭtotosi Nin'au okku'i otstsa'pĭnasĭnni ipokom'ŏssau otokŏnatsĭm'otokatatsĭx, ak'otŭmotokhitaupiu otsĭstsapĭsso'pŏtsĭs:

text: Ki akokŏnipotamoi'piaiau ikŏnai'okauaua: ki aiakanĭstaiaketaipĭksĭstaiau emŭk'ikĭnaikuŭn manistai'aketaipiksĭstopiax emŭk'ikĭnax ki apomŭk'ikĭnax:
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:32 — Ki akokŏnipotamoi'piaiau ikŏnai'okauaua: ki aiakanĭstaiaketaipĭksĭstaiau emŭk'ikĭnaikuŭn manistai'aketaipiksĭstopiax emŭk'ikĭnax ki apomŭk'ikĭnax:

text: Ki akotŭpĭpiuax emŭk'ikĭnax onet'otsĭs ki ap'omŭkikĭnax otse'aksĭssauotsĭs.
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:33 — Ki akotŭpĭpiuax emŭk'ikĭnax onet'otsĭs ki ap'omŭkikĭnax otse'aksĭssauotsĭs.

text: Omŭx'ina akotŭm'anĭstsiuax anniks'isk onetotsĭs itau'pixk, Puk'sipuk, Nin'a otatsims'imix, ki nĭn'naiisĭnni matsĭk' annik' kitapĭstutomokiiik, otsauomap'astutoŏssi ksŏk'kum.
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:34 — Omŭx'ina akotŭm'anĭstsiuax anniks'isk onetotsĭs itau'pixk, Puk'sipuk, Nin'a otatsims'imix, ki nĭn'naiisĭnni matsĭk' annik' kitapĭstutomokiiik, otsauomap'astutoŏssi ksŏk'kum.

text: Nitse'nots, ki kit'okokipuau aau'ŏsĭn; nitse'naki, ki kitsit'tutokokipuau: nitsi'piitappi, ki kito'tokipuau:
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:35 — Nitse'nots, ki kit'okokipuau aau'ŏsĭn; nitse'naki, ki kitsit'tutokokipuau: nitsi'piitappi, ki kito'tokipuau:

text: Nimatsĭstotospa, ki kitsĭs'totosatskokipuau; nitokh'tokos, ki kitsĭpĭs'kotokipuau; itai'okiakiopi nitsitau'pi, ki kitsittotaakipuau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:36 — Nimatsĭstotospa, ki kitsĭs'totosatskokipuau; nitokh'tokos, ki kitsĭpĭs'kotokipuau; itai'okiakiopi nitsitau'pi, ki kitsittotaakipuau.

text: Mokŏm'otsitappix akotŭm'anĭstsiauaie, Nin'a, tsanistsi'i kit sits' In o pin an kitau'nots, ki kits is' so pi Q an? Ki kitse'naki, ki kitiitakopinan.
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:37 — Mokŏm'otsitappix akotŭm'anĭstsiauaie, Nin'a, tsanistsi'i kit sits' In o pin an kitau'nots, ki kits is' so pi Q an? Ki kitse'naki, ki kitiitakopinan.

text: Tsanĭstsi'i kitsĭts'ĭnopĭnan, kitsi'piitappiisi ki kito'tosĭnĭn? Ki kimatsĭstotospa, ki kitsĭstotos'atskopĭnan?
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:38 — Tsanĭstsi'i kitsĭts'ĭnopĭnan, kitsi'piitappiisi ki kito'tosĭnĭn? Ki kimatsĭstotospa, ki kitsĭstotos'atskopĭnan?

text: Tsanĭstsi'i kitsĭts'ĭnopĭnan kitai'okhtokos, ki kitsitau'pĭssi itai'okiakiopi ki kĭtsito'taatosĭnan?
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:39 — Tsanĭstsi'i kitsĭts'ĭnopĭnan kitai'okhtokos, ki kitsitau'pĭssi itai'okiakiopi ki kĭtsito'taatosĭnan?

text: Ki omŭx'ina ak'anĭstsiuax, kitau'mŭnĭstopuau kanistitŭpĭstutsipuai tuks'kŭma inŭx'tsĭma am'ox nĭx'okoax, kitanĭsts'ĭstutomokipuau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:40 — Ki omŭx'ina ak'anĭstsiuax, kitau'mŭnĭstopuau kanistitŭpĭstutsipuai tuks'kŭma inŭx'tsĭma am'ox nĭx'okoax, kitanĭsts'ĭstutomokipuau.

text: Akotŭm'anĭstsiuax anniks'isk ote'aksĭsautsĭs itau'pixk, ĭs'tapuk emŭtskax mŏkseĭnsau, ŭsksustsinasii ĭs'tapuk, ek'aisepŭtsĭstotomoiiauax au'tutsokiuă ki oto'tokatatsix:
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:41 — Akotŭm'anĭstsiuax anniks'isk ote'aksĭsautsĭs itau'pixk, ĭs'tapuk emŭtskax mŏkseĭnsau, ŭsksustsinasii ĭs'tapuk, ek'aisepŭtsĭstotomoiiauax au'tutsokiuă ki oto'tokatatsix:

text: Tŭk'ka, nitau'nots, ki kimatsĭssok'ipuaua: nitse'naki, ki kimat'tutukkokipuaua:
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:42 — Tŭk'ka, nitau'nots, ki kimatsĭssok'ipuaua: nitse'naki, ki kimat'tutukkokipuaua:

text: Nitsi'pitappi, ki kimat'otokipuau: nimats'ĭstotospa, ki kimatsĭstotosats'kokipuaua: nitokh'tokos, ki nitsitau'pi itai'okiakiopi, ki kimat'sipĭskotokipuaua.
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:43 — Nitsi'pitappi, ki kimat'otokipuau: nimats'ĭstotospa, ki kimatsĭstotosats'kokipuaua: nitokh'tokos, ki nitsitau'pi itai'okiakiopi, ki kimat'sipĭskotokipuaua.

text: Osto'auai ak'otŭmanĭstsiiauaie, Nin'a Tsanĭstsi'i kitsĭts'ĭnopĭnan kitau'nots, ki kitse'naksi, ki kit'sipitappisi, ki kitokh'tokosi, ki kitsitaupĭssi itai'okiakiopi kŏkstaikawk'anĭstotŏsĭnan?
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:44 — Osto'auai ak'otŭmanĭstsiiauaie, Nin'a Tsanĭstsi'i kitsĭts'ĭnopĭnan kitau'nots, ki kitse'naksi, ki kit'sipitappisi, ki kitokh'tokosi, ki kitsitaupĭssi itai'okiakiopi kŏkstaikawk'anĭstotŏsĭnan?

text: Ai'akotŭmanĭstsiuax, kitau'mŭnĭstopu au kanĭst'saiitŭpĭstutsipuai tuks'kŭmă inŭxtsĭma amox, kimat'anĭstsĭstutomokipuaua.
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:45 — Ai'akotŭmanĭstsiuax, kitau'mŭnĭstopu au kanĭst'saiitŭpĭstutsipuai tuks'kŭmă inŭxtsĭma amox, kimat'anĭstsĭstutomokipuaua.

text: Ki am'oxi aksĭstŭpitappo'iau ŭsk'sĭtauksĭstototspi: ki mokŏm'otsitappix akittappoiau ŭsk'sipaitappiisĭnni.
text_for_embed: Matthew 25:46 — Ki am'oxi aksĭstŭpitappo'iau ŭsk'sĭtauksĭstototspi: ki mokŏm'otsitappix akittappoiau ŭsk'sipaitappiisĭnni.

text: KI itŭnĭstsiu, Jesus otaiksĭste'poattosĕsts am'ŏsts epo'awsĭsts, itŭn'ĭstsiuax otŭsksĭnĭmatsax,
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:1 — KI itŭnĭstsiu, Jesus otaiksĭste'poattosĕsts am'ŏsts epo'awsĭsts, itŭn'ĭstsiuax otŭsksĭnĭmatsax,

text: Kĭtsksĭnipuau aisto'kŭssi ksĭstsiku'ĭsts ak'itstsiu passover, ki Nĭn'au okka'i itaumŭts'kau mŏk'ĭtsiksĭstoxŏsi.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:2 — Kĭtsksĭnipuau aisto'kŭssi ksĭstsiku'ĭsts ak'itstsiu passover, ki Nĭn'au okka'i itaumŭts'kau mŏk'ĭtsiksĭstoxŏsi.

text: Omŭk'atoiapiekuax, ki aisĭnakix, ki matap'pix otsĭn'aimoauax itŭmitŭpaumooiau sp'a'toiapiekuŭn Caiaphas oko'aii.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:3 — Omŭk'atoiapiekuax, ki aisĭnakix, ki matap'pix otsĭn'aimoauax itŭmitŭpaumooiau sp'a'toiapiekuŭn Caiaphas oko'aii.

text: Ki ai'sĭtsĭpsattseiau mŏk'anistokotsisĭmmiotoŏsauaie Jesus, ki mŏk'itsenitŏsauaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:4 — Ki ai'sĭtsĭpsattseiau mŏk'anistokotsisĭmmiotoŏsauaie Jesus, ki mŏk'itsenitŏsauaie.

text: Ki an'iau, pinĭts'tsĭs oye'tani ĭstsiksĭs'tsikui ŏkskakŭmĭstsikĭniau matap'pix.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:5 — Ki an'iau, pinĭts'tsĭs oye'tani ĭstsiksĭs'tsikui ŏkskakŭmĭstsikĭniau matap'pix.

text: Jesus otsitau'pĭssi Bethany, Simon leper oko'ai otsitsĭpsts'taupĭssi,
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:6 — Jesus otsitau'pĭssi Bethany, Simon leper oko'ai otsitsĭpsts'taupĭssi,

text: Ake'ua itoto'aie, ipa'tŭkkiu alabaster atŭxak'sin puye' itsŭp'patomaie, akai'ĭnxkĭmasiuaie, ki otau'yisaie itsita'suyĭnĭnmaie otokŏn'iaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:7 — Ake'ua itoto'aie, ipa'tŭkkiu alabaster atŭxak'sin puye' itsŭp'patomaie, akai'ĭnxkĭmasiuaie, ki otau'yisaie itsita'suyĭnĭnmaie otokŏn'iaie.

text: Ki otŭksĭnĭmats'ax otsĭnĭs'saxaie, ĭstse'tŭkkiax, ki an'iau mauk'etsĭnikatopi?
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:8 — Ki otŭksĭnĭmats'ax otsĭnĭs'saxaie, ĭstse'tŭkkiax, ki an'iau mauk'etsĭnikatopi?

text: Am'ok ipum'atotopi ĭs'taiekekaiĭxkĭmasiuopi, ki kĭm'atapsix ĭs'tauokotauopiauaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:9 — Am'ok ipum'atotopi ĭs'taiekekaiĭxkĭmasiuopi, ki kĭm'atapsix ĭs'tauokotauopiauaie.

text: Jesus otokh'tsĭmsi, an'ĭstsiuax, kumauk'sauaiksĭxinoauaiisksĭx ake'uă ŏkh'siu nitapĭstutu'yipi.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:10 — Jesus otokh'tsĭmsi, an'ĭstsiuax, kumauk'sauaiksĭxinoauaiisksĭx ake'uă ŏkh'siu nitapĭstutu'yipi.

text: Ksĕsto'au, kĭmatapsix kitŭsk'sauopoksemokoaiau; ki nĕsto'a kimat'ŭsksauopoksemokipuaua.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:11 — Ksĕsto'au, kĭmatapsix kitŭsk'sauopoksemokoaiau; ki nĕsto'a kimat'ŭsksauopoksemokipuaua.

text: Am'ok puye' nostŭm'i otsĭta'suyĭnĭssi itsĭstuts'imaie mŏkĭtsopuiapĭstutuyĭssi nŏkitak'itsasi.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:12 — Am'ok puye' nostŭm'i otsĭta'suyĭnĭssi itsĭstuts'imaie mŏkĭtsopuiapĭstutuyĭssi nŏkitak'itsasi.

text: Kitau'mŭnĭstopuau am'oi ŏkhs'itsĭniksĭnni amianĭstan'ĭstopi kŏnŭs'ksŏkkumă, am'ok, am'o ake'uă otap'ĭstutsipi ak'ŭtanĭstomaie, mŏk'ĭtŭsksĭnoŏsi.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:13 — Kitau'mŭnĭstopuau am'oi ŏkhs'itsĭniksĭnni amianĭstan'ĭstopi kŏnŭs'ksŏkkumă, am'ok, am'o ake'uă otap'ĭstutsipi ak'ŭtanĭstomaie, mŏk'ĭtŭsksĭnoŏsi.

text: Na'tsikoputsix, tuks'kŭmă, anĭstau Judas Iscariot, itappo omŭk'atoiapiekuax,
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:14 — Na'tsikoputsix, tuks'kŭmă, anĭstau Judas Iscariot, itappo omŭk'atoiapiekuax,

text: Ki an'iu, tsanĭstap'pi kitak'okokipuaii, ki nitakitŭp'omutskau ksĕsto'au? Ki nitsi'tuyiauaie niĭp'pii ksĭxĭx'kĭmĭx.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:15 — Ki an'iu, tsanĭstap'pi kitak'okokipuaii, ki nitakitŭp'omutskau ksĕsto'au? Ki nitsi'tuyiauaie niĭp'pii ksĭxĭx'kĭmĭx.

text: Ki annik' itot'apsatsim mŏk'itamŭtskŏsaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:16 — Ki annik' itot'apsatsim mŏk'itamŭtskŏsaie.

text: Ke'tani kŭt'taikopŭtstsii, ĭstotom'iksĭs'tsikui, ŭsksĭnĭmats'ax itoto'iau Jesus, ki an'ĭstsiauaie, Tse'a kit'stapa kŏk'sopuiapĭstutosĭnan kŏk'kĭtsoyĭsi passover?
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:17 — Ke'tani kŭt'taikopŭtstsii, ĭstotom'iksĭs'tsikui, ŭsksĭnĭmats'ax itoto'iau Jesus, ki an'ĭstsiauaie, Tse'a kit'stapa kŏk'sopuiapĭstutosĭnan kŏk'kĭtsoyĭsi passover?

text: Ki an'iu ĭs'tapuk akap'ioyĭs, ki om'ŭmă nĭn'auŭmă anĭstok', Nin'a, an'iu, nitsiksĭstsikum'i aststsi'u: koko'ai nitŭs'ksĭnĭmatsax nitak'opoksoyimaiau passover.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:18 — Ki an'iu ĭs'tapuk akap'ioyĭs, ki om'ŭmă nĭn'auŭmă anĭstok', Nin'a, an'iu, nitsiksĭstsikum'i aststsi'u: koko'ai nitŭs'ksĭnĭmatsax nitak'opoksoyimaiau passover.

text: Ki ŭsksĭnĭmats'ax manĭstan'ĭstopiax itan'ĭsttutsĭmiax; ki itso'poŭtsĭstutsĭmiau passover.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:19 — Ki ŭsksĭnĭmats'ax manĭstan'ĭstopiax itan'ĭsttutsĭmiax; ki itso'poŭtsĭstutsĭmiau passover.

text: Ki otau'tŭkkusi, ipokitau'pimiuax na'tsikoputsix.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:20 — Ki otau'tŭkkusi, ipokitau'pimiuax na'tsikoputsix.

text: Ki otau'yĭsau, an'iu, kitau'mŭnĭstopuau tuks'kŭmă ksĕsto'au kĭtakaumŭts'kauki.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:21 — Ki otau'yĭsau, an'iu, kitau'mŭnĭstopuau tuks'kŭmă ksĕsto'au kĭtakaumŭts'kauki.

text: Ki eks'kaiĭkikĭn'etŭkkiau, ki ikŏnau'mŭtŭpanĭstsiauaie, Nin'a nĕsto'akats?
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:22 — Ki eks'kaiĭkikĭn'etŭkkiau, ki ikŏnau'mŭtŭpanĭstsiauaie, Nin'a nĕsto'akats?

text: Ki an'iu, annŏk okĭt'sĭs nitopoksĭstapĭmakemauok kos'i nitakaumŭts'kauk.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:23 — Ki an'iu, annŏk okĭt'sĭs nitopoksĭstapĭmakemauok kos'i nitakaumŭts'kauk.

text: Nin'au okku'i itanĭsts'itappo nitsĭn'awpi: ak'itŭpokapiu annŏk' nĭn'auŏk imŭts'kaiuŏk Nĭn'au okku'i! Kŭt'taipokaiiuopi annŏk' nĭn'auŏk, ĭs'taŏkhsiuopi.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:24 — Nin'au okku'i itanĭsts'itappo nitsĭn'awpi: ak'itŭpokapiu annŏk' nĭn'auŏk imŭts'kaiuŏk Nĭn'au okku'i! Kŭt'taipokaiiuopi annŏk' nĭn'auŏk, ĭs'taŏkhsiuopi.

text: Judas anni'ĭsk itse'mŭtskaukisk, itŭm'anĭstsiuaie, Nin'a nĕsto'akats? An'ĭstsiuaie, kitan'i.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:25 — Judas anni'ĭsk itse'mŭtskaukisk, itŭm'anĭstsiuaie, Nin'a nĕsto'akats? An'ĭstsiuaie, kitan'i.

text: Ki otau'yĭsau Jesus ito'tsĭmaie ke'tani ki itatsĭm'ĭstutsĭmaie, ki itaumin'ĭmaie, kĭ ikotsiu'ax ŭsksĭnĭmats'ax, ki an'iu, Matsĭk', oyik'; am'oiauk nostŭm'i.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:26 — Ki otau'yĭsau Jesus ito'tsĭmaie ke'tani ki itatsĭm'ĭstutsĭmaie, ki itaumin'ĭmaie, kĭ ikotsiu'ax ŭsksĭnĭmats'ax, ki an'iu, Matsĭk', oyik'; am'oiauk nostŭm'i.

text: Ki mat'tuyiuaie kos'i ki thanks ikotŭk'kiu, ki ikotsiu'ax, ki an'iu kŏnai'sĭmattok;
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:27 — Ki mat'tuyiuaie kos'i ki thanks ikotŭk'kiu, ki ikotsiu'ax, ki an'iu kŏnai'sĭmattok;

text: Am'okauk nitsa'apŭn, mananĭsts'etoksĭnni itŭp'itsiu itsai'kimskau akai'tappix otsauum'itsitappiisuauĕsts mŏk'sinĭsĕsts.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:28 — Am'okauk nitsa'apŭn, mananĭsts'etoksĭnni itŭp'itsiu itsai'kimskau akai'tappix otsauum'itsitappiisuauĕsts mŏk'sinĭsĕsts.

text: Ki kitan'ĭstopuau nimatakŭtsĭmattopa am'ok mĭniokke sauomo'pokitsipstsĭmattomĭnaniki manĭs'si nin'a ots'ĭnnaĭisĭnni.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:29 — Ki kitan'ĭstopuau nimatakŭtsĭmattopa am'ok mĭniokke sauomo'pokitsipstsĭmattomĭnaniki manĭs'si nin'a ots'ĭnnaĭisĭnni.

text: Ki otinik'sau natoi'ĭniksĭnni itŭp'sŭxiau nitum'moyi Olives.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:30 — Ki otinik'sau natoi'ĭniksĭnni itŭp'sŭxiau nitum'moyi Olives.

text: Jesus itŭm'anĭstsiuax, nĕsto'a kĭtak'okŏnŭsskĭmskŭkipuau annok'ă koko'ikă: tŭk'ka, sĭn'aip, nitak'auaiakiau annŏk' ŭsks'kŭmiuŏk emŭk'ikĭnax, ki ot'omŭkikĭnauăsĭnna ĭsto'mŭkikĭnax akŭneto'iau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:31 — Jesus itŭm'anĭstsiuax, nĕsto'a kĭtak'okŏnŭsskĭmskŭkipuau annok'ă koko'ikă: tŭk'ka, sĭn'aip, nitak'auaiakiau annŏk' ŭsks'kŭmiuŏk emŭk'ikĭnax, ki ot'omŭkikĭnauăsĭnna ĭsto'mŭkikĭnax akŭneto'iau.

text: Aiksistatsipuau'eniki kitakitŭpotoma'topuau Galilee.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:32 — Aiksistatsipuau'eniki kitakitŭpotoma'topuau Galilee.

text: Peter an'istsiuaie, ikŭm'okŏnŭstsskĭmskŭkĭssau ksĕsto'a, nimat'akĭstsskĭmskŭkipa.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:33 — Peter an'istsiuaie, ikŭm'okŏnŭstsskĭmskŭkĭssau ksĕsto'a, nimat'akĭstsskĭmskŭkipa.

text: Jesus an'ĭstsiuaie, kitau'mŭnĭsto, Annok' koko'ik otsauomit'awkkumsi nipuau'ă nioks' kai kitakani kimatsksĭnok'ipa.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:34 — Jesus an'ĭstsiuaie, kitau'mŭnĭsto, Annok' koko'ik otsauomit'awkkumsi nipuau'ă nioks' kai kitakani kimatsksĭnok'ipa.

text: Peter an'ĭstsiuaie ŏkskakŭmopoks'eniop, nimat'akanipa kimatsksĭnopa; neto'i ikŏnau'aniiax ŭsksĭnĭmats'ax.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:35 — Peter an'ĭstsiuaie ŏkskakŭmopoks'eniop, nimat'akanipa kimatsksĭnopa; neto'i ikŏnau'aniiax ŭsksĭnĭmats'ax.

text: Jesus itŭmitŭpopokomiuax Gethsemane an'ĭstop, ki an'ĭstsiuax otŭsksĭnĭmatsax, annom' stau'pik, nitakittappo omim' nŏkĭtŭt'tsĭmoiikasi.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:36 — Jesus itŭmitŭpopokomiuax Gethsemane an'ĭstop, ki an'ĭstsiuax otŭsksĭnĭmatsax, annom' stau'pik, nitakittappo omim' nŏkĭtŭt'tsĭmoiikasi.

text: Ki mat'tuyiuax Peter, ki Zebedee otsĭstok'iokuyix, ki itaumŭtŭpĭkikĭn'etukki ki itau'mŭtŭpeikapitsitau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:37 — Ki mat'tuyiuax Peter, ki Zebedee otsĭstok'iokuyix, ki itaumŭtŭpĭkikĭn'etukki ki itau'mŭtŭpeikapitsitau.

text: Itŭm'anĭstsiuax nitsitŭpĭkikĭnetukki e'ĭnsĭnni: annom' stau'pik, ki ŏk'itŭskskatŭkkiop.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:38 — Itŭm'anĭstsiuax nitsitŭpĭkikĭnetukki e'ĭnsĭnni: annom' stau'pik, ki ŏk'itŭskskatŭkkiop.

text: Ki pa'tsiĭstŭpaatsiuax, ki ĭsstokopi'u ostoksĭs', ki itŭt'tsĭmoiikau ki an'iu, Nin'a, ikŭm'okotsitstsĭssi am'oi kos'a ŭnnianistĭs'tŭpipotoŏssi; nimatakitsitan'ats, ksĕsto'a kitak'itsitan.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:39 — Ki pa'tsiĭstŭpaatsiuax, ki ĭsstokopi'u ostoksĭs', ki itŭt'tsĭmoiikau ki an'iu, Nin'a, ikŭm'okotsitstsĭssi am'oi kos'a ŭnnianistĭs'tŭpipotoŏssi; nimatakitsitan'ats, ksĕsto'a kitak'itsitan.

text: Ki matskitoto'ax otŭsksĭnimats'ax, ki ikon'oyiuax oto'kaniax, ki an'ĭstsiuaie Peter, Awx'ats? Kikŭttaukotŭskskŭmmokipa tuks'kai itai'ksĭstsikumiopi?
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:40 — Ki matskitoto'ax otŭsksĭnimats'ax, ki ikon'oyiuax oto'kaniax, ki an'ĭstsiuaie Peter, Awx'ats? Kikŭttaukotŭskskŭmmokipa tuks'kai itai'ksĭstsikumiopi?

text: Mokŏk'etsĭk ki a'tsĭmoiikak, kŏkstaitsipĭssuai ĭssaks'ksĭnŭksĭnni; sta'aw itsitsi'tatomaie ki ĭx'isakuyi matsi'uats.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:41 — Mokŏk'etsĭk ki a'tsĭmoiikak, kŏkstaitsipĭssuai ĭssaks'ksĭnŭksĭnni; sta'aw itsitsi'tatomaie ki ĭx'isakuyi matsi'uats.

text: Ki mats'ĭstapu ki itŭt'tsĭmoiikau, ki an'iu, Nĭn'a, am'oi kos'a sauomot'aisĭmmieniki sauomĭs'tŭpipotomokoeniki, kĭtak'itsitan.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:42 — Ki mats'ĭstapu ki itŭt'tsĭmoiikau, ki an'iu, Nĭn'a, am'oi kos'a sauomot'aisĭmmieniki sauomĭs'tŭpipotomokoeniki, kĭtak'itsitan.

text: Ki mat'oto ki mat'okonoyiuax otsok'asax: tŭk'ka ĭssoksĭm'au oŏps'puauax.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:43 — Ki mat'oto ki mat'okonoyiuax otsok'asax: tŭk'ka ĭssoksĭm'au oŏps'puauax.

text: Ki itskĭtsiuax, ki mats'ĭstapu, ki nioks'kai itŭt'tsĭmoiikau, ki netoi' au'aniu.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:44 — Ki itskĭtsiuax, ki mats'ĭstapu, ki nioks'kai itŭt'tsĭmoiikau, ki netoi' au'aniu.

text: Itŭm'itotoiax otŭsksĭnĭmats'ax ki an'ĭstsĭuax okak' annok, ki issĭk'sĭstsikok: sat'sik aststsiu' itai'ksĭstsikumiopix, ki Nin'au okku'i itŭp'aumŭtskau sauum'itsitappix otsu'auĕsts.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:45 — Itŭm'itotoiax otŭsksĭnĭmats'ax ki an'ĭstsĭuax okak' annok, ki issĭk'sĭstsikok: sat'sik aststsiu' itai'ksĭstsikumiopix, ki Nin'au okku'i itŭp'aumŭtskau sauum'itsitappix otsu'auĕsts.

text: Nipuak', ŏkittăppau'op: annŏk' nitakaumŭts'kaukŏk aststsiu'.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:46 — Nipuak', ŏkittăppau'op: annŏk' nitakaumŭts'kaukŏk aststsiu'.

text: Ki otsa'kiai epuyĭssi, Sat'sik, Judas, na'tsikoputsix tuks'kŭmă ito'to ki akai'tappix ipokom'iauaie inus'stoanix ki sŏksĭs'tsĭsts ipa'tŭkkix, itototoiau omŭk'atoiapiekuax ki matap'pix otsĭn'aimoauax.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:47 — Ki otsa'kiai epuyĭssi, Sat'sik, Judas, na'tsikoputsix tuks'kŭmă ito'to ki akai'tappix ipokom'iauaie inus'stoanix ki sŏksĭs'tsĭsts ipa'tŭkkix, itototoiau omŭk'atoiapiekuax ki matap'pix otsĭn'aimoauax.

text: Ki annŏk' imŭts'kaĭuŏkaie ikotsiu'ax apsto'sinni, ki an'iu, annŏk' nitak'sĭnnauskippauŏk, an'nŏkauk: mi'eenok.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:48 — Ki annŏk' imŭts'kaĭuŏkaie ikotsiu'ax apsto'sinni, ki an'iu, annŏk' nitak'sĭnnauskippauŏk, an'nŏkauk: mi'eenok.

text: Ki ikŏm'itoto Jesus, ki aniu, Hail, Nin'a; ki itsĭn'nauskĭppiuaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:49 — Ki ikŏm'itoto Jesus, ki aniu, Hail, Nin'a; ki itsĭn'nauskĭppiuaie.

text: Ki Jesus an'ĭstsiuaie, Napi'ă, kumauk'sipuksipuksĭks? Itŭmitoto'iauaie ki een'iauaie Jesus, ki mat'tuyiauaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:50 — Ki Jesus an'ĭstsiuaie, Napi'ă, kumauk'sipuksipuksĭks? Itŭmitoto'iauaie ki een'iauaie Jesus, ki mat'tuyiauaie.

text: Ki sat' sit, anniks'isk ipokom'iskaie Jesus, tuks'kŭma itsitŭpikĭns'tsakiuaie otsĭn'usstoan itsau'tuyiuaie, ki sp'a'toiapiekuŭn tuks'kŭmi otap'automok ot'auaiakiokaie, ki kŏk'sĭnĭmaie okhtok'ĭsaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:51 — Ki sat' sit, anniks'isk ipokom'iskaie Jesus, tuks'kŭma itsitŭpikĭns'tsakiuaie otsĭn'usstoan itsau'tuyiuaie, ki sp'a'toiapiekuŭn tuks'kŭmi otap'automok ot'auaiakiokaie, ki kŏk'sĭnĭmaie okhtok'ĭsaie.

text: Jesus itŭm'anĭstsiuaie, kitsĭn'usstoană otsits'tsipi ĭststsi'ĭs; anniks'ĭsk matap'pixk mat'tuyixk inus'stoan, inus'stoan itax'enittaiau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:52 — Jesus itŭm'anĭstsiuaie, kitsĭn'usstoană otsits'tsipi ĭststsi'ĭs; anniks'ĭsk matap'pixk mat'tuyixk inus'stoan, inus'stoan itax'enittaiau.

text: Kit'stapa nŏkŭttokotsitŭp'atsĭmoiikani nin'ă, ki annok' nŏk'okuyĭssi otsĭtsksĭstsikoputsix legionix otatsĭm'otokatatsix?
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:53 — Kit'stapa nŏkŭttokotsitŭp'atsĭmoiikani nin'ă, ki annok' nŏk'okuyĭssi otsĭtsksĭstsikoputsix legionix otatsĭm'otokatatsix?

text: Tsa akokototŭmunĭstsĭstutsipa natoi'sĭnaksĭsts, mŏk'itŭnĭstsĭssi?
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:54 — Tsa akokototŭmunĭstsĭstutsipa natoi'sĭnaksĭsts, mŏk'itŭnĭstsĭssi?

text: Neto'ik itai'ksĭstsikumiopik Jesus an'ĭstsiuax akai'tappix, kikŭt'anĭstsipuksipa'akipuaua kanĭst'sitappopuau kŏmos'iepĭtsi annŏk' pa'tŭkkiuŏk inus'stoax ki sŏksĭs'tsĭsts, kŏk'otoksuai? Anĭs'tsiksĭstsikuĭsts kitopokau'pimopuau omŭk'atoiapioyĭs kŏkŭsksĭnĭmats'opuau ki kimatseen'okipuauă.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:55 — Neto'ik itai'ksĭstsikumiopik Jesus an'ĭstsiuax akai'tappix, kikŭt'anĭstsipuksipa'akipuaua kanĭst'sitappopuau kŏmos'iepĭtsi annŏk' pa'tŭkkiuŏk inus'stoax ki sŏksĭs'tsĭsts, kŏk'otoksuai? Anĭs'tsiksĭstsikuĭsts kitopokau'pimopuau omŭk'atoiapioyĭs kŏkŭsksĭnĭmats'opuau ki kimatseen'okipuauă.

text: Ki am'ostsk ikŏnaiĭstutsipi mŏks'enŭpanĭstosau prophetix osĭnak'suauĕsts. Ikŏnŭsksĭnĭmatsax itŭm'skĭttsiiau ki ai'tsĭmmutaiau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:56 — Ki am'ostsk ikŏnaiĭstutsipi mŏks'enŭpanĭstosau prophetix osĭnak'suauĕsts. Ikŏnŭsksĭnĭmatsax itŭm'skĭttsiiau ki ai'tsĭmmutaiau.

text: Ki anniks'isk een'ixkaie Jesus itŭpĭpiauaie Caiaphas, sp'atoiapiekuŭn, itomoi'piawpiau ai'sĭnakix ki omŭks'ĭmix nĭn'ax.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:57 — Ki anniks'isk een'ixkaie Jesus itŭpĭpiauaie Caiaphas, sp'atoiapiekuŭn, itomoi'piawpiau ai'sĭnakix ki omŭks'ĭmix nĭn'ax.

text: Ki Peter piaapŭtsitŭpa'tseuaie sp'atoiapiekuŭn oko'ai, kiitsipim' ki ipokau'pimiuax ap'otŭkkix mŏkitokŏnai'nĭsi.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:58 — Ki Peter piaapŭtsitŭpa'tseuaie sp'atoiapiekuŭn oko'ai, kiitsipim' ki ipokau'pimiuax ap'otŭkkix mŏkitokŏnai'nĭsi.

text: Annok', omŭk'atoiapiekuax ki omŭks'imix nĭn'ax ki ikŏnau'kŏkitsĭmax, ĭstŭp'iksĭstapenŭpanĭssĭnni ap'satsĭmiau mŏks'enitŏsauaie Jesus;
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:59 — Annok', omŭk'atoiapiekuax ki omŭks'imix nĭn'ax ki ikŏnau'kŏkitsĭmax, ĭstŭp'iksĭstapenŭpanĭssĭnni ap'satsĭmiau mŏks'enitŏsauaie Jesus;

text: Ki matokonim'axau; otsito'tosax akai'tappix aiksĭstapenŭpanix, matokonĭm'axau. Sako'okhtsim ito'toĭau na'tsitappiix ai'tapksĭsenŭpanix,
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:60 — Ki matokonim'axau; otsito'tosax akai'tappix aiksĭstapenŭpanix, matokonĭm'axau. Sako'okhtsim ito'toĭau na'tsitappiix ai'tapksĭsenŭpanix,

text: Ki an'iau, am'o nin'au an'iu nitokot'opŭksĭnip Ap'istotok'iuă otatoi'apioyis ki nitokot'sokapĭstutsip nioks'kai ksĭstsiku'i.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:61 — Ki an'iau, am'o nin'au an'iu nitokot'opŭksĭnip Ap'istotok'iuă otatoi'apioyis ki nitokot'sokapĭstutsip nioks'kai ksĭstsiku'i.

text: Ki Sp'atoi'apiekuŭn itsipuau', ki an'ĭstsiuaie, kitakstaie'puyipa? Tsanĭstapiu'a am'ox kitse'nŭpanipiau?
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:62 — Ki Sp'atoi'apiekuŭn itsipuau', ki an'ĭstsiuaie, kitakstaie'puyipa? Tsanĭstapiu'a am'ox kitse'nŭpanipiau?

text: Ki Jesus matsepuyiu'ats. Ki Sp'atoi'apiekuŭn mat'anĭstsiuaie, kita'tauŭnĭsto Ӑp'istotokiua ipai'tappiiuă, kŏk'aniksĭnan ikŭm'ŭmeniki Christ, Ap'ĭstotokiuă okku'i.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:63 — Ki Jesus matsepuyiu'ats. Ki Sp'atoi'apiekuŭn mat'anĭstsiuaie, kita'tauŭnĭsto Ӑp'istotokiua ipai'tappiiuă, kŏk'aniksĭnan ikŭm'ŭmeniki Christ, Ap'ĭstotokiuă okku'i.

text: Jesus an'istsiuaie, kitsemŭniani; ki kitan'ĭsto sako'okhtsim kitaks'ĭnoauai'ĭni Nin'au okku'i, otsitau'pĭssi otŭmap'sĭnni ĭstset'otsĭsi ki umutsipuk'sipusi Spots'im ĭstsisoksĭs'tsikuĭsts.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:64 — Jesus an'istsiuaie, kitsemŭniani; ki kitan'ĭsto sako'okhtsim kitaks'ĭnoauai'ĭni Nin'au okku'i, otsitau'pĭssi otŭmap'sĭnni ĭstset'otsĭsi ki umutsipuk'sipusi Spots'im ĭstsisoksĭs'tsikuĭsts.

text: Sp'atoi'apiekuŭn itŭmai'pinotsĭmĕsts otsĭstotos'ĭsts ki an'iu, itŭpepo'atomaie Ap'ĭstotokiuă; nitak'otsikipĭnana stsik'ix e'ĕnŭpanix? Sat'sik, kikai'okhtoauau oksĭs'tapinikŏttsimani.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:65 — Sp'atoi'apiekuŭn itŭmai'pinotsĭmĕsts otsĭstotos'ĭsts ki an'iu, itŭpepo'atomaie Ap'ĭstotokiuă; nitak'otsikipĭnana stsik'ix e'ĕnŭpanix? Sat'sik, kikai'okhtoauau oksĭs'tapinikŏttsimani.

text: Tsa kit'stapuauă? An'iau, mŏks'eĭnsi.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:66 — Tsa kit'stapuauă? An'iau, mŏks'eĭnsi.

text: Itŭm'itaisokuttŭttsiauaie ostoksĭs'aie, ki oto'auĕsts itsĭtauaiak'iauaie: ki stsĭk'ix omi'tsĭxikĭnstspuauĕsts itsĭtauaiak'iauaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:67 — Itŭm'itaisokuttŭttsiauaie ostoksĭs'aie, ki oto'auĕsts itsĭtauaiak'iauaie: ki stsĭk'ix omi'tsĭxikĭnstspuauĕsts itsĭtauaiak'iauaie.

text: Ki an'iau, ksĕsto'a Christ e'ĕnŭpanikĭnan, Tŭkka' kĭtauaiak'ioka?
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:68 — Ki an'iau, ksĕsto'a Christ e'ĕnŭpanikĭnan, Tŭkka' kĭtauaiak'ioka?

text: Annok' Peter sauauts'im itau'piu, ĭstokĭtsĭm'i pĭstots'im: ki ake'kuŭn itoto'aie, ki an'iu, ksĕsto'a kitopokom'au Jesus Galilee ĭstsitappim'i.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:69 — Annok' Peter sauauts'im itau'piu, ĭstokĭtsĭm'i pĭstots'im: ki ake'kuŭn itoto'aie, ki an'iu, ksĕsto'a kitopokom'au Jesus Galilee ĭstsitappim'i.

text: Ki paiot'anĭstsiuax matap'pix nimatsksĭnoau'ats nimatsksĭnipa kitan'ipi
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:70 — Ki paiot'anĭstsiuax matap'pix nimatsksĭnoau'ats nimatsksĭnipa kitan'ipi

text: Ki otsitŭp'sŭxsi kĭtsĭm'iapioyĭs, stsĭk'i ake'kuŭn nan'nuyenaie ki an'ĭstsiuax anniks'isk matap'pixk itau'pixk, ani'o nin'au nokŭt'opoksimiuaie Jesus, Nazareth istsitappim'i.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:71 — Ki otsitŭp'sŭxsi kĭtsĭm'iapioyĭs, stsĭk'i ake'kuŭn nan'nuyenaie ki an'ĭstsiuax anniks'isk matap'pixk itau'pixk, ani'o nin'au nokŭt'opoksimiuaie Jesus, Nazareth istsitappim'i.

text: Ki mata'toŭniu, ki an'iu, nimatsksĭn oau'ats nĭn'au.
text_for_embed: Matthew 26:72 — Ki mata'toŭniu, ki an'iu, nimatsksĭn oau'ats nĭn'au.

text: Ki otai'pĭstsĭksisŭmmosi anniks'ĭsk itai'puyixk itoto'iauaie, ki an'ĭstsiauaie Peter, E'mŭniu, ksĕsto'akauk tuks'kŭmă: kitse'poawsĭsts kitse'ĕnŭpaniki.

text_for_embed: Matthew 27:48 — Ki tuks'kŭmă itauks'kasiu ito'tukkiu ai'ksĭppuyĭnip, ki ito'kĭmiuaie ĭstsipoku'yi, ki itstom'aie apai'i, ki ikotsiu'aie mŏksĭmattosaiai'i.

text: Stsĭk'ix an'iau, ki'ka, ŏk'satsip maks'ikŭmipuksipusi mŏksikŏmotse'piĭsaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 27:49 — Stsĭk'ix an'iau, ki'ka, ŏk'satsip maks'ikŭmipuksipusi mŏksikŏmotse'piĭsaie.

text: Jesus ota'atsoksepuyĭssi, itaumŭts'kaiuaie Sta'aw.
text_for_embed: Matthew 27:50 — Jesus ota'atsoksepuyĭssi, itaumŭts'kaiuaie Sta'aw.

text: Ki Sat'sit, omŭk'atoiapioyĭs itsi'koksok'iakiopi ai'aketsĭnikau, spots'im itots'ipinikau; ki ksŏk'kumă itsi'papuyiu, ki ok'otokskuĭsts ai'aketopiiau;
text_for_embed: Matthew 27:51 — Ki Sat'sit, omŭk'atoiapioyĭs itsi'koksok'iakiopi ai'aketsĭnikau, spots'im itots'ipinikau; ki ksŏk'kumă itsi'papuyiu, ki ok'otokskuĭsts ai'aketopiiau;

text: Ki a ken 'i man ists kau'opiiau; ki atsĭm'six anniks'ĭsk ai'okaxk akaiĕm ostŭm'oauĕsts itsipuau'ax,
text_for_embed: Matthew 27:52 — Ki a ken 'i man ists kau'opiiau; ki atsĭm'six anniks'ĭsk ai'okaxk akaiĕm ostŭm'oauĕsts itsipuau'ax,

text: Ki ota'atsipuawsi Jesus, itsux'iau aken'imanĭsts, ki itŭp'ipimiau atsĭmakap'ioyĭsi, ki otsĭnok'oaiau akai'tappiix.
text_for_embed: Matthew 27:53 — Ki ota'atsipuawsi Jesus, itsux'iau aken'imanĭsts, ki itŭp'ipimiau atsĭmakap'ioyĭsi, ki otsĭnok'oaiau akai'tappiix.

text: Annok' eĕnakin'au'ă, ki otopokom'ixk, otopokŭs'satŭkkimaxk Jesus, otsĭnno'ŏsau ksŏk'kumi otsi'papuyiisi, ki otsĭnĭs'sau annists'isk ĭstutsip'ĭstsk, eks'kaikopumiau, ki an'iau am'o emŭn'iŭmiu Ap'ĭstotokiuă okku'i.
text_for_embed: Matthew 27:54 — Annok' eĕnakin'au'ă, ki otopokom'ixk, otopokŭs'satŭkkimaxk Jesus, otsĭnno'ŏsau ksŏk'kumi otsi'papuyiisi, ki otsĭnĭs'sau annists'isk ĭstutsip'ĭstsk, eks'kaikopumiau, ki an'iau am'o emŭn'iŭmiu Ap'ĭstotokiuă okku'i.

text: Ki akai'tappix akex' pie'tsi itŭs'sŭmmiauaie, anniks'isk itotopokiuo'iĭxk Jesus Galilee, ki apotomoyiĭxkaie:
text_for_embed: Matthew 27:55 — Ki akai'tappix akex' pie'tsi itŭs'sŭmmiauaie, anniks'isk itotopokiuo'iĭxk Jesus Galilee, ki apotomoyiĭxkaie:

text: Ki ipokom'iauax Mary Magdalene, ki Mary, James ki Joses oksĭs'toauaii, ki Zebedee okku'ix oksĭs'toauai.
text_for_embed: Matthew 27:56 — Ki ipokom'iauax Mary Magdalene, ki Mary, James ki Joses oksĭs'toauaii, ki Zebedee okku'ix oksĭs'toauai.

text: Otau'tŭkkussi, akotsin'auă Arimathæa istsitappim'i anĭstau Joseph, ito'to, tuks'kŭma Jesus otŭsksĭnĭmats'aie:
text_for_embed: Matthew 27:57 — Otau'tŭkkussi, akotsin'auă Arimathæa istsitappim'i anĭstau Joseph, ito'to, tuks'kŭma Jesus otŭsksĭnĭmats'aie:

text: Itappo' Pilate, ki ikŏm'ŏnĭstomaie Jesus stŭm' i aie. Pilate itŭmŭn'iu mŏkaumŭtskatosaie mostŭm'i.
text_for_embed: Matthew 27:58 — Itappo' Pilate, ki ikŏm'ŏnĭstomaie Jesus stŭm' i aie. Pilate itŭmŭn'iu mŏkaumŭtskatosaie mostŭm'i.

text: Ki Joseph otots'ĭssi mostŭm'i, itsĭsso'monĭmaie ksĭxĭstokh'aipĭstsi,
text_for_embed: Matthew 27:59 — Ki Joseph otots'ĭssi mostŭm'i, itsĭsso'monĭmaie ksĭxĭstokh'aipĭstsi,

text: Ki itsĭpststotomaie otauŭt'sinani aken'iman, maniu'aie, annik' itatŭn'ipik ok'otokskui: ki omŭk'okotoki itŭp'auapĭmiuaie aken'imani ĭstokĭtsĭm'i, ki itsĭstapu.
text_for_embed: Matthew 27:60 — Ki itsĭpststotomaie otauŭt'sinani aken'iman, maniu'aie, annik' itatŭn'ipik ok'otokskui: ki omŭk'okotoki itŭp'auapĭmiuaie aken'imani ĭstokĭtsĭm'i, ki itsĭstapu.

text: Ki Mary Magdalene, ki stsĭk'i Mary, itotau'piauaie aken'imani.
text_for_embed: Matthew 27:61 — Ki Mary Magdalene, ki stsĭk'i Mary, itotau'piauaie aken'imani.

text: Ki annik' ksĭstsiku'ik otŏkhs'apĭstutosau, mat'apinŏkkusi, omŭk'atoiapiekuax ki Pharisees ikŏnitoto'iauaie Pilate,
text_for_embed: Matthew 27:62 — Ki annik' ksĭstsiku'ik otŏkhs'apĭstutosau, mat'apinŏkkusi, omŭk'atoiapiekuax ki Pharisees ikŏnitoto'iauaie Pilate,

text: Ki an'iau, Nin'a, nitŭsksksĭnipĭnan om'ă ai'pĭstsĭksĭstutŭkkiuă otan'ipi, otsakiaitap'piisi, nioks'kai ksĭstsiku'i nitak'aatsipuau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 27:63 — Ki an'iau, Nin'a, nitŭsksksĭnipĭnan om'ă ai'pĭstsĭksĭstutŭkkiuă otan'ipi, otsakiaitap'piisi, nioks'kai ksĭstsiku'i nitak'aatsipuau.

text: Anit' ŏkhs'ĭstutsĭssĭ aken'imani nioks'kai ksĭstsiku'ĭsts, otŭs'ksĭnĭmatsax mŏkstai'sepiotosax, mŏkstai'kŏmosaĭ'ĭsax, mŏkstai'anĭstosauax matap'pix, ŭk'aipuau: ki sako'ipatsĭstutŭksĭnni aks'ĭstŭpskĭts top matom'ipatsĭstutŭksĭnni.
text_for_embed: Matthew 27:64 — Anit' ŏkhs'ĭstutsĭssĭ aken'imani nioks'kai ksĭstsiku'ĭsts, otŭs'ksĭnĭmatsax mŏkstai'sepiotosax, mŏkstai'kŏmosaĭ'ĭsax, mŏkstai'anĭstosauax matap'pix, ŭk'aipuau: ki sako'ipatsĭstutŭksĭnni aks'ĭstŭpskĭts top matom'ipatsĭstutŭksĭnni.

text: Pilate an'ĭstsiuax mattok'au eĕn'akex; ĭs'tapuk, mi'ĭstutsik.
text_for_embed: Matthew 27:65 — Pilate an'ĭstsiuax mattok'au eĕn'akex; ĭs'tapuk, mi'ĭstutsik.

text: Ki itappo' iau, ki mi'ĭstutsĭmiau ake'niman, ĭskskŭm'iauaie ok'otoksŏkh'sepĭstan, ki ĭstsi'iauaie eĕn'akex.
text_for_embed: Matthew 27:66 — Ki itappo' iau, ki mi'ĭstutsĭmiau ake'niman, ĭskskŭm'iauaie ok'otoksŏkh'sepĭstan, ki ĭstsi'iauaie eĕn'akex.

text: ISSĬK'SĬSTSIKUYII ksĭstsiku'i otai'ksiuosaie, otaumŭtŭpapinŏk'kusaie ĭssĭk'atoiksĭstsikui, Mary Magdalene ki stsĭk'i Mary itoto'iau mŏks'ĭniĭsau ake'nimani.
text_for_embed: Matthew 28:1 — ISSĬK'SĬSTSIKUYII ksĭstsiku'i otai'ksiuosaie, otaumŭtŭpapinŏk'kusaie ĭssĭk'atoiksĭstsikui, Mary Magdalene ki stsĭk'i Mary itoto'iau mŏks'ĭniĭsau ake'nimani.

text: Ki, sat'sĭt, ksŏk'kumă ai'papuyiu: tŭk'ka Ap'ĭstotokiua oto'tokatatsĭs spots' im itsĭnnĭsso'iĭnai, ki ito'to ki matskoap'imiuaie ok'otoksokh'sepĭstan ki itop'aiuaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 28:2 — Ki, sat'sĭt, ksŏk'kumă ai'papuyiu: tŭk'ka Ap'ĭstotokiua oto'tokatatsĭs spots' im itsĭnnĭsso'iĭnai, ki ito'to ki matskoap'imiuaie ok'otoksokh'sepĭstan ki itop'aiuaie.

text: Ostoksĭs'si netoinitai'natsiuaie popos'ists, ki kaii'ksĭstotosiu neto'i kon'skui:
text_for_embed: Matthew 28:3 — Ostoksĭs'si netoinitai'natsiuaie popos'ists, ki kaii'ksĭstotosiu neto'i kon'skui:

text: Ki ŭsks'katŭkkix stun'noyiauaie, ki ai'papuyeian netoi'nitsiiau enix'.
text_for_embed: Matthew 28:4 — Ki ŭsks'katŭkkix stun'noyiauaie, ki ai'papuyeian netoi'nitsiiau enix'.

text: Ki oto'tokatatsĭs an'ĭstsiuax a kex', piniko'puk; nits'ksĭnip kitap'ŭssŭmmauau Jesus annŏk' kaiĭs'toksauŏk.
text_for_embed: Matthew 28:5 — Ki oto'tokatatsĭs an'ĭstsiuax a kex', piniko'puk; nits'ksĭnip kitap'ŭssŭmmauau Jesus annŏk' kaiĭs'toksauŏk.

text: Matsĭnakuaiĕm'ats: tŭk'ka, ŭk'aipuau otan'ipi. Puk'sipuk, sat'sĭk otsit'sipi Nĭn'ă.
text_for_embed: Matthew 28:6 — Matsĭnakuaiĕm'ats: tŭk'ka, ŭk'aipuau otan'ipi. Puk'sipuk, sat'sĭk otsit'sipi Nĭn'ă.

text: Ki kĭpi'tappoak, ki anĭstok'ax otŭs'ksĭnĭmatsax otse'ĭnsĭnni ŭkaipua'atomaie; ki, sat'sit, kitse'tomomattaak Galilee; omim' kitak'itsĭnnoauau: sat'sik, kikau'anĭstopuau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 28:7 — Ki kĭpi'tappoak, ki anĭstok'ax otŭs'ksĭnĭmatsax otse'ĭnsĭnni ŭkaipua'atomaie; ki, sat'sit, kitse'tomomattaak Galilee; omim' kitak'itsĭnnoauau: sat'sik, kikau'anĭstopuau.

text: Ki itsikĭp'ĭstupaatomiauaie ake'niman ai'kopumau, ki eks'kaetametŭkkiau; ki auks'kasiau mokitots'ipotosauaie otŭs'ksĭnĭmatsaxaie otse'poawsĭniaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 28:8 — Ki itsikĭp'ĭstupaatomiauaie ake'niman ai'kopumau, ki eks'kaetametŭkkiau; ki auks'kasiau mokitots'ipotosauaie otŭs'ksĭnĭmatsaxaie otse'poawsĭniaie.

text: Ki otsitappo'sauax mŏkitsĭnnikoŏsauax otŭs'ksĭnĭmatsaxaie, sŭm'mĭs, Jesus ito'tatsemiuax ki an'ĭstsiuax All hail! Ki ito'toiauaie ki eĭn'ĭmiauaie okŏt'sĭstsaie, ki ita'tsĭmmĭmmiauaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 28:9 — Ki otsitappo'sauax mŏkitsĭnnikoŏsauax otŭs'ksĭnĭmatsaxaie, sŭm'mĭs, Jesus ito'tatsemiuax ki an'ĭstsiuax All hail! Ki ito'toiauaie ki eĭn'ĭmiauaie okŏt'sĭstsaie, ki ita'tsĭmmĭmmiauaie.

text: Jesus itŭm'itŭnĭstsiuax, Pinikopuk; mĭs'tapuk, anĭstok'au nĭx'okoax mŏk'ittapposau Galilee, ki omim' nitak'itsĭnokiau.
text_for_embed: Matthew 28:10 — Jesus itŭm'itŭnĭstsiuax, Pinikopuk; mĭs'tapuk, anĭstok'au nĭx'okoax mŏk'ittapposau Galilee, ki omim' nitak'itsĭnokiau.

text: Annok' otsa'kiaitapposau, sŭm'mĭs, stsĭk'ix ŭsks'katŭkii itoto'iau akap'ioyĭs, ki aitsĭn'nikoyiauax omŭk'atoiapiekuax nitap'ii.
text_for_embed: Matthew 28:11 — Annok' otsa'kiaitapposau, sŭm'mĭs, stsĭk'ix ŭsks'katŭkii itoto'iau akap'ioyĭs, ki aitsĭn'nikoyiauax omŭk'atoiapiekuax nitap'ii.

text: Kiotokŏnau'moŏsau ki omŭx'ĭnax otokŏnai'puyĭsau, ikotsi'auax eĕn'akex akaiĕm'i itawk'pumaupix,
text_for_embed: Matthew 28:12 — Kiotokŏnau'moŏsau ki omŭx'ĭnax otokŏnai'puyĭsau, ikotsi'auax eĕn'akex akaiĕm'i itawk'pumaupix,

text: Ki an'ĭstsiauax, ŭnnik' otŭs'ksĭmĭmatsax nitsa'kiaiokasĭnan, sepioto'iax ki itsikŏmos'attsiauaie.
text_for_embed: Matthew 28:13 — Ki an'ĭstsiauax, ŭnnik' otŭs'ksĭmĭmatsax nitsa'kiaiokasĭnan, sepioto'iax ki itsikŏmos'attsiauaie.

text: Ki nĭn'a okhtsĭs'saie, nitaksemŭnan ki kitakitsikŏmotse'piopĭnan.
text_for_embed: Matthew 28:14 — Ki nĭn'a okhtsĭs'saie, nitaksemŭnan ki kitakitsikŏmotse'piopĭnan.

text: Mat'toyiauax itawk'pumaupix, ki otsksĭnĭmatseipuauaiax iia'tutsĭmiau ki annik' anĭssĭn'nik Jews sa'kiauanĭstomiax.
text_for_embed: Matthew 28:15 — Mat'toyiauax itawk'pumaupix, ki otsksĭnĭmatseipuauaiax iia'tutsĭmiau ki annik' anĭssĭn'nik Jews sa'kiauanĭstomiax.

text: Nitsi'koputsiax otŭs'ksĭnĭmatsax itappo'iax Galilee nitum'mo, Jesus otan'ĭstopi.
text_for_embed: Matthew 28:16 — Nitsi'koputsiax otŭs'ksĭnĭmatsax itappo'iax Galilee nitum'mo, Jesus otan'ĭstopi.

text: Ki otsĭnno'ŏsauaĭe itatsĭm'mĭmmiauaie: ki stsĭk'ix sai'etŭkkiax.
text_for_embed: Matthew 28:17 — Ki otsĭnno'ŏsauaĭe itatsĭm'mĭmmiauaie: ki stsĭk'ix sai'etŭkkiax.

text: Ki Jesus ito'toax ki ai'sitsĭpsattsiuax, ki an'ĭstsiuax, kŏnau'tŭmapsinni spots'im ki ksŏk'kum nit'okoko.
text_for_embed: Matthew 28:18 — Ki Jesus ito'toax ki ai'sitsĭpsattsiuax, ki an'ĭstsiuax, kŏnau'tŭmapsinni spots'im ki ksŏk'kum nit'okoko.

text: Ŭn'nikaie, ĭs'tapuk, ĭsksĭnĭmats'okau kŏnau'mianĭstsitappii, ŭs'tapĭnokau ninikŏt'tokĕsts otsĭn'ikŏsĭmĕsts kĭn'un, ki okku'i, ki atsĭm'istaaw:
text_for_embed: Matthew 28:19 — Ŭn'nikaie, ĭs'tapuk, ĭsksĭnĭmats'okau kŏnau'mianĭstsitappii, ŭs'tapĭnokau ninikŏt'tokĕsts otsĭn'ikŏsĭmĕsts kĭn'un, ki okku'i, ki atsĭm'istaaw:

text: Isksĭnĭmats'okau mŏk'satsĭsauĕsts kĭtan'ĭstopuauĕsts; ki sat'sit, kitŭsks'opoksemopuau anĭstsiksĭs'tsikuĭsts aiksiuo'si ksŏk'kum.
text_for_embed: Matthew 28:20 — Isksĭnĭmats'okau mŏk'satsĭsauĕsts kĭtan'ĭstopuauĕsts; ki sat'sit, kitŭsks'opoksemopuau anĭstsiksĭs'tsikuĭsts aiksiuo'si ksŏk'kum.
